zh.tag: 将编码代理转变为多阶段安全审计员的技能
zh.what: 这是一个编码代理技能，通过侦察、覆盖导向狩猎、候选验证、结构化输出、独立记录验证和目标中立报告六个阶段，将代理转变为安全审计员。它编排隔离的代理进行漏洞发现，并生成机器可读的发现记录。
zh.content: 仓库包含 SKILL.md 主技能文件，以及针对不同阶段的提示文件如 RECONNAISSANCE.md、HUNTING.md、ATTACK-CLASSES.md，还有针对特定领域的 MEMORY-SAFETY-AND-BINARY.md、AI-AND-LLM.md、WEB-PROTOCOL-AND-AUTH.md、CLIENT-SIDE.md 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，依赖 Node.js 运行验证脚本（如 validate-coverage-ledger.cjs 和 validate-findings.cjs），并遵循 JSON 模式进行结构化输出。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 1434 颗星，总星数达 5126，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 JavaScript 第 9 名。它源自 Cloudflare 的漏洞发现工具链，提供了可复用的安全审计技能，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 安全工程师和渗透测试人员 —— 利用代理自动化多阶段安全审计，提高漏洞发现效率。
AI 代理开发者 —— 集成此技能到编码代理中，增强其安全审计能力。
DevSecOps 团队 —— 在 CI/CD 流程中自动执行安全审计，生成结构化报告。
安全研究人员 —— 基于此技能构建自定义漏洞挖掘工具链。

en.tag: A coding-agent skill that turns your agent into a multi-phase security auditor
en.what: This is a coding-agent skill that turns your agent into a security auditor by orchestrating isolated agents through six phases: reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification, and target-neutral reporting. It produces machine-readable findings with independently verified claims.
en.content: The repo contains SKILL.md as the main skill file, along with phase-specific prompt files like RECONNAISSANCE.md, HUNTING.md, ATTACK-CLASSES.md, and domain-specific files such as MEMORY-SAFETY-AND-BINARY.md, AI-AND-LLM.md, WEB-PROTOCOL-AND-AUTH.md, and CLIENT-SIDE.md.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript, it relies on Node.js for validation scripts (e.g., validate-coverage-ledger.cjs and validate-findings.cjs) and uses JSON schemas for structured output.
en.hot: It gained 1,434 stars today, reaching 5,126 total, and ranked 9th on GitHub Trending (JavaScript). It originated from Cloudflare's vulnerability discovery harness, offering a reusable security audit skill that has attracted significant attention.
uses: Security engineers and penetration testers — automate multi-phase security audits with agents to improve vulnerability discovery efficiency.
AI agent developers — integrate this skill into coding agents to enhance their security auditing capabilities.
DevSecOps teams — automate security audits in CI/CD pipelines and generate structured reports.
Security researchers — build custom vulnerability hunting harnesses based on this skill.

zh.tag: 给 AI 代理一台可用的电脑：开源驱动、跨系统机群与评测基准
zh.what: Cua 是一套面向 computer-use 代理的开源基础设施，提供桌面自动化驱动、隔离云桌面、本地 macOS 虚拟机、专用决策模型以及评测基准。目标是让代理能够真正操作 macOS、Windows、Linux 上的应用，并支持训练、评测与数据生成。
zh.content: 仓库按模块组织：Cua Fleets 云桌面机群、Cua Driver 跨系统驱动、Lume 本地虚拟机、CUA-S1 专用小模型、Cua Bench 评测与轨迹导出，另含文档与示例。
zh.stack: 主语言为 HTML，核心包含 Python 驱动与 CLI、Apple Silicon 上的 macOS/Linux 虚拟机、云桌面编排，以及面向代理的模型与基准工具链。
zh.hot: 24,418 颗星、今日新增 859，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 2。computer-use 代理正热，而它把驱动、机群、模型与基准打包成开源方案，降低了上手门槛。
uses: 想训练或评测 computer-use 代理的研究者与工程师
需要为代理提供隔离云桌面或本地 macOS 虚拟机的开发者
希望跨 macOS、Windows、Linux 自动化操作应用的产品团队
想用基准与轨迹数据生成训练数据的 AI 团队

en.tag: Give AI agents computers they can use: open-source drivers, cross-OS fleets, and benchmarks
en.what: Cua is an open-source stack for computer-use agents, offering desktop automation drivers, isolated cloud desktops, local macOS VMs, specialist decision models, and evaluation benchmarks. It lets agents actually operate apps on macOS, Windows, and Linux, and supports training, evaluation, and data generation.
en.content: The repo is organized into modules: Cua Fleets for cloud desktops, Cua Driver for cross-OS control, Lume for local VMs, CUA-S1 specialist models, and Cua Bench for evaluation and trajectory export, plus docs and examples.
en.stack: Primarily HTML, with Python drivers and CLI, macOS/Linux VMs on Apple Silicon, cloud desktop orchestration, and a model/benchmark toolchain for agents.
en.hot: 24,418 stars with 859 added today, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending daily. Computer-use agents are hot, and Cua packages drivers, fleets, models, and benchmarks into one open-source stack, lowering the barrier to entry.
uses: Researchers and engineers training or evaluating computer-use agents
Developers needing isolated cloud desktops or local macOS VMs for agents
Product teams automating apps across macOS, Windows, and Linux
AI teams generating training data with benchmarks and trajectories

zh.tag: 为 AI 编程代理提供生产级工程技能包
zh.what: 这是一套面向 AI 编程代理的工程技能库，把资深工程师的工作流、质量门禁和最佳实践编码成可复用的技能。它覆盖从需求定义到上线的完整开发生命周期，让代理在每个阶段都遵循一致的标准。
zh.content: 仓库以技能包形式组织，包含 25 个技能和 9 个斜杠命令（如 /spec、/plan、/build、/test、/review、/ship），每个命令会自动激活对应技能。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，通过开放的 skills CLI（npx skills add）安装，可接入 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Copilot、Cline 等 70 多个代理。
zh.hot: 凭借 Addy Osmani 的影响力与 AI 编程代理热潮，项目已获 94,344 颗星，今日新增 354 星，位列 GitHub Trending JavaScript 日榜第 3 名。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理的开发者，希望代理遵循统一工程规范
团队想为 AI 辅助开发引入质量门禁与标准化工作流
个人开发者需要从需求到上线的结构化开发流程模板
对 AI 代理技能包设计感兴趣、想学习或二次开发的人

en.tag: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents
en.what: A collection of engineering skills that encode the workflows, quality gates, and best practices senior engineers use, packaged so AI coding agents follow them consistently. It spans the full development lifecycle from defining requirements to shipping to production.
en.content: The repo is organized as skill packages, offering 25 skills and 9 slash commands (e.g. /spec, /plan, /build, /test, /review, /ship), each automatically activating the relevant skills.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, installed via the open skills CLI (npx skills add) and compatible with 70+ agents including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, and Cline.
en.hot: Backed by Addy Osmani's reputation and the AI coding agent boom, it has reached 94,344 stars with 354 added today, ranking #3 on GitHub Trending (JavaScript) daily.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor who want consistent engineering standards
Teams looking to add quality gates and standardized workflows to AI-assisted development
Individual developers wanting a structured spec-to-ship development process
Anyone curious about designing AI agent skill packages or wanting to extend them

zh.tag: 自托管的云端开发环境与 AI 编码代理平台
zh.what: Coder 是一个可自托管的平台，用 Terraform 定义云端开发环境（工作区），通过安全的 WireGuard 隧道连接，闲置时自动关闭以节省成本。它还内置 AI 编码代理，代理循环运行在你自己的控制平面中，工作区内无需存放任何 API 密钥。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的服务端与 CLI、Terraform 模板与 provider、Web 管理界面、文档和安装脚本，可部署到 EC2、Kubernetes、Docker 等多种基础设施。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 开发，依赖 Terraform 定义基础设施，采用 WireGuard 隧道保障连接安全，并支持接入 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、Bedrock 或自托管模型。
zh.hot: 凭借 14612 颗星和今日新增 83 星登上 Go 日榜第 16 名，反映出开发者对自托管、安全且带 AI 代理的云端开发环境需求旺盛。
uses: 需要为团队统一管理云端开发环境并控制成本的平台工程团队
希望让 AI 编码代理在自己基础设施上运行、避免密钥外泄的企业
使用 Terraform 管理基础设施、追求可审计与合规的开发组织
想快速为新人开通开发环境、缩短入职时间的工程团队

en.tag: Self-hosted cloud development environments and AI coding agents
en.what: Coder is a self-hosted platform for cloud development environments and AI coding agents. Workspaces are defined with Terraform, connected through a secure WireGuard tunnel, and automatically shut down when idle; its native AI agent runs in your control plane with no API keys inside workspaces.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based server and CLI, Terraform templates and providers, a web admin UI, docs, and install scripts, deployable across EC2, Kubernetes, Docker, and more.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it relies on Terraform for infrastructure definitions, uses WireGuard tunnels for secure connectivity, and supports Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Bedrock, or self-hosted models.
en.hot: With 14,612 stars and 83 added today, ranking 16th on the Go daily trending list, it reflects strong demand for self-hosted, secure cloud dev environments with AI agents.
uses: Platform engineering teams needing unified, cost-controlled cloud dev environments
Enterprises wanting AI coding agents on their own infra without leaking API keys
Organizations using Terraform that require auditable, compliant infrastructure
Engineering teams aiming to onboard developers in seconds instead of days

zh.tag: 终端里的智能体编程助手，用自然语言写代码
zh.what: Claude Code 是 Anthropic 推出的智能体编程工具，常驻终端，能理解你的代码库。它通过自然语言指令执行日常任务、解释复杂代码并处理 git 工作流，帮助开发者更快编码。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含安装脚本、插件目录（提供自定义命令与智能体扩展）以及演示动图，官方文档托管在外部站点。
zh.stack: 核心以 TypeScript 编写，要求 Node.js 18+，支持 curl、Homebrew、WinGet、PowerShell 等多种安装方式（npm 已弃用）。
zh.hot: 作为 Anthropic 官方出品的智能体编程工具，它已积累 145,507 颗星，今日再增 165 星并登上日榜第 11 名，持续吸引开发者关注。
uses: 希望用自然语言加速日常编码与重构的开发者
需要在终端内处理 git 工作流和代码解释的工程师
想通过插件扩展自定义命令与智能体的进阶用户

en.tag: An agentic coding tool living in your terminal, coding via natural language
en.what: Claude Code is Anthropic's agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal and understands your codebase. It executes routine tasks, explains complex code, and handles git workflows through natural language commands, helping developers code faster.
en.content: The repo mainly contains install scripts, a plugins directory (offering custom commands and agent extensions), and a demo GIF, with official docs hosted externally.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, it requires Node.js 18+ and supports multiple install methods like curl, Homebrew, WinGet, and PowerShell (npm is deprecated).
en.hot: As Anthropic's official agentic coding tool, it has amassed 145,507 stars, gaining 165 more today and ranking 11th on the daily trending list, drawing steady developer attention.
uses: Developers who want to speed up daily coding and refactoring with natural language
Engineers handling git workflows and code explanations inside the terminal
Advanced users extending custom commands and agents via plugins

zh.tag: 开源免费的实时行情追踪与公司洞察平台
zh.what: OpenStock 是昂贵金融行情平台的开源替代品，支持追踪实时股价、设置个性化提醒，并查看详细的公司信息。项目由 Open Dev Society 公开构建，承诺永久免费，面向所有投资者开放。
zh.content: 仓库为 TypeScript 前端项目，包含仪表盘等界面资源（如 public/assets/images/dashboard.png），并配有 Star History、Trendshift 等徽章展示热度。整体以 Web 应用形态呈现，采用 AGPL-3.0 许可。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，属于前端/全栈 Web 应用，依赖现代 JS 生态构建界面与数据展示。采用 AGPL-3.0 许可，修改或部署为服务需开源并署名。
zh.hot: 已获约 16,050 颗星，今日新增 472 星，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜第 6。免费替代付费行情平台的定位切中痛点，加上开源社区运营，推动其快速走红。
uses: 个人投资者：免费追踪实时股价并设置价格提醒
开发者：基于 TypeScript 二次开发或自建行情看板
开源爱好者：参与 Open Dev Society 的公开协作项目
预算有限的小团队：替代昂贵的商业行情平台

en.tag: A free, open-source alternative to pricey market data platforms
en.what: OpenStock is an open-source alternative to expensive market platforms, letting users track real-time prices, set personalized alerts, and explore detailed company insights. Built openly by Open Dev Society, it is promised to stay free forever for everyone.
en.content: The repo is a TypeScript web app containing UI assets such as the dashboard screenshot in public/assets/images, plus Star History and Trendshift badges. It ships as a web application under the AGPL-3.0 license.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, it is a front-end/full-stack web app built on the modern JS ecosystem for UI and data display. Licensed AGPL-3.0, requiring source release and attribution if modified or deployed as a service.
en.hot: It has around 16,050 stars with 472 added today, ranking #6 on GitHub Trending daily. Its pitch as a free replacement for paid market platforms hits a real pain point, and open community building fuels the surge.
uses: Individual investors: track real-time prices and set alerts for free
Developers: fork or extend the TypeScript codebase for custom dashboards
Open-source enthusiasts: contribute to Open Dev Society's public project
Budget-limited small teams: replace costly commercial market platforms

zh.tag: 面向万亿参数大模型的容错 GPU 编排与训练框架
zh.what: Higgsfield 是一个开源、容错、可扩展的 GPU 编排与机器学习框架，专为训练数十亿到数万亿参数的大模型（如 LLM）设计。它同时充当 GPU 工作负载管理器和训练框架，负责资源分配、任务排队与实验监控。
zh.content: 仓库以 Jupyter Notebook 为主，包含架构文档、安装说明，以及用少量代码训练 LLaMa 70B 的示例，展示 ZeRO-3、数据加载与实验装饰器等 API。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 与 PyTorch，集成 DeepSpeed ZeRO-3、PyTorch FSDP，并通过 Docker、GitHub Actions 和 PyPI 包（higgsfield==0.0.3）完成部署与 CI。
zh.hot: 大模型训练的基础设施痛点突出，加上今日新增 196 star、总量近 5000 并登上 GitHub 日榜第 7，说明开发者对简化多节点训练的强烈需求。
uses: 需要多节点训练大模型的研究团队与工程师，希望减少环境与配置的折腾
想用少量代码在分布式环境微调 LLaMa 等大模型的开发者
关注 GPU 资源调度、任务排队与实验可复现性的 MLOps 从业者

en.tag: Fault-tolerant GPU orchestration and training framework for trillion-parameter models
en.what: Higgsfield is an open-source, fault-tolerant, highly scalable GPU orchestration and machine learning framework built for training models with billions to trillions of parameters, such as LLMs. It doubles as a GPU workload manager and training framework, handling resource allocation, job queuing, and experiment monitoring.
en.content: The repo is mostly Jupyter Notebooks, with architecture docs, install instructions, and an example that trains LLaMa 70B in a few lines using ZeRO-3, data loaders, and an experiment decorator.
en.stack: Built on Python and PyTorch, integrating DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 and PyTorch FSDP, with Docker, GitHub Actions, and a PyPI package (higgsfield==0.0.3) for deployment and CI.
en.hot: It tackles a major pain point in LLM training infrastructure; with 196 stars added today, nearly 5,000 total, and a #7 spot on GitHub Trending, it reflects strong demand for simpler multi-node training.
uses: Research teams and engineers training large models across multiple nodes who want less environment and config hassle
Developers who want to fine-tune large models like LLaMa in a distributed setting with minimal code
MLOps practitioners focused on GPU scheduling, job queuing, and reproducible experiments

zh.tag: 面向生成式 AI 的文档解析与结构化工具
zh.what: Docling 是一个文档处理工具，能解析 PDF、DOCX、PPTX、XLSX、HTML、EPUB、图片、音频等多种格式，并深入理解 PDF 的版面、阅读顺序、表格结构、代码、公式与图片分类。它把非结构化文档转成统一、表达力强的 DoclingDocument 格式，方便接入生成式 AI 生态。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包源码、CLI 工具、文档站点、示例与测试，核心是 DoclingDocument 数据模型及各类格式的解析器与 AI 集成模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Pydantic v2、uv、Ruff 等现代工具链，并集成多种文档解析与 AI 模型库。
zh.hot: 凭借对复杂 PDF 的深度解析能力和对生成式 AI 工作流的友好支持，Docling 已获 67058 颗星，今日新增 129 星，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜第 8 名。
uses: 需要将 PDF 等文档转换为结构化数据以用于 RAG 或微调的 AI 工程师
构建文档问答、知识库或智能搜索产品的开发者
处理大量异构文档并希望统一格式的数据科学家
研究文档理解与版面分析的研究人员

en.tag: Document parsing and structuring toolkit for generative AI
en.what: Docling is a document processing tool that parses PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, EPUB, images, audio, and more, with advanced PDF understanding of layout, reading order, table structure, code, formulas, and image classification. It converts unstructured documents into a unified, expressive DoclingDocument format for seamless integration with the generative AI ecosystem.
en.content: The repo contains Python package source, a CLI, documentation site, examples, and tests, centered on the DoclingDocument data model plus parsers for various formats and AI integration modules.
en.stack: Primarily Python, using Pydantic v2, uv, Ruff, and other modern tooling, with integrations for document parsing and AI model libraries.
en.hot: With deep PDF understanding and strong support for generative AI workflows, Docling has earned 67,058 stars, adding 129 today and ranking #8 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: AI engineers converting PDFs and other documents into structured data for RAG or fine-tuning
Developers building document QA, knowledge base, or intelligent search products
Data scientists processing large volumes of heterogeneous documents and seeking a unified format
Researchers studying document understanding and layout analysis

zh.tag: Cloudflare 出品的 Rust QUIC 传输协议与 HTTP/3 实现
zh.what: quiche 是 Cloudflare 用 Rust 编写的 QUIC 传输协议与 HTTP/3 实现，遵循 IETF 规范。它提供处理 QUIC 数据包和连接状态的底层 API，由应用层自行负责 I/O、事件循环与定时器。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 quiche 库、提供命令行客户端与服务端的 quiche-apps crate，以及示例证书和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，发布在 crates.io 上，依赖 Rust 生态的加密与网络库，并提供 C 语言绑定。
zh.hot: 作为 Cloudflare 边缘网络 HTTP/3 的底层引擎，并被 Android DNS 解析器和 curl 采用，凭借 11847 颗星稳居 Rust 日榜第 8。
uses: 网络协议开发者，需要实现或研究 QUIC/HTTP/3 底层逻辑
希望为服务端或客户端添加 HTTP/3 支持的 Rust 工程师
想将 QUIC 集成进 curl、DNS 解析器等现有工具的项目维护者
关注高性能传输层与拥塞控制的研究与教学人员

en.tag: Cloudflare's Rust implementation of the QUIC transport protocol and HTTP/3
en.what: quiche is Cloudflare's Rust implementation of the QUIC transport protocol and HTTP/3 as specified by the IETF. It offers a low-level API for processing QUIC packets and managing connection state, leaving I/O, event loops and timers to the application.
en.content: The repo contains the core quiche library, a quiche-apps crate with command-line client and server, plus sample certificates and build scripts.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust and published on crates.io, it relies on Rust crypto and networking crates and also ships C bindings.
en.hot: As the engine behind Cloudflare's edge HTTP/3 and adopted by Android's DNS resolver and curl, it holds 11,847 stars and ranks 8th on the Rust daily trending list.
uses: Network protocol developers implementing or studying QUIC/HTTP/3 internals
Rust engineers adding HTTP/3 support to servers or clients
Maintainers integrating QUIC into tools like curl or DNS resolvers
Researchers and educators focused on high-performance transport and congestion control

zh.tag: 自建私有搜索引擎，索引浏览记录与本地文件
zh.what: Hister 是一个注重隐私的搜索引擎，可以索引你访问过的网页和本地文件的内容，支持全文搜索。它提供 Web 界面、终端界面和 MCP 接口，方便你随时找回信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Web UI（基于 Svelte）、浏览器扩展（Firefox/Chrome）以及终端客户端。支持多用户、语义搜索、爬虫和浏览器历史导入。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 CGO（需要 C 编译器），Web 前端使用 npm 和 Svelte。

en.stack: Primarily Go, with CGO dependencies (requires C compiler), and npm/Svelte for the web frontend.
en.hot: Gained 142 stars today, ranking #4 on Go trending. Amid growing privacy concerns, self-hosted search engines are in demand, and Hister offers full features with easy deployment.

Teams or organizations needing a private search solution for internal documents and web pages.
Developers who want to integrate MCP into AI assistants for personalized information retrieval.

zh.tag: 面向微型设备的2比特自动化基础模型，8-29MB即可在端侧完成工具调用与结构化抽取
zh.what: Needle 是一个专为手机、可穿戴设备、智能家居、机器人和微控制器等资源受限设备设计的基础模型。它牺牲通用聊天能力，换取在移动端工具调用上超越十倍参数模型的表现，并在结构化抽取上追平2-3倍大的模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包 cactus-needle、模型权重与各平台推理引擎（托管在 Hugging Face），以及架构图、基准测试图表和工具设计指南等文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，核心是自研的 Laddered Simple Attention Network（Monarch Hadamard MLP、GQA 注意力、engram n-gram 记忆），配合字节级语法约束解码，通过 pip install cactus-needle 安装。
zh.hot: 发布不久即收获 11607 星、今日新增 234 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 14 名，2 比特 8-29MB 的端侧工具调用能力切中了本地 AI 代理的刚需。
uses: 移动与可穿戴应用开发者，希望在端侧本地完成工具调用与意图路由
智能家居、机器人与车载系统工程师，需要在微控制器上跑结构化抽取

想用函数装饰器快速搭建轻量 AI 代理原型的 Python 开发者

en.tag: A 2-bit automation foundation model for tiny devices: 8-29 MB, on-device tool calls, structured extraction and embeddings
en.what: Needle is a foundation model built for constrained devices like phones, wearables, smart homes, robots and microcontrollers. It trades general chat capacity to beat models 10x its size on mobile tool calls and match 2-3x bigger models on structured extraction.
en.content: The repo ships the cactus-needle Python package, model weights and per-platform inference engines (hosted on Hugging Face), plus architecture diagrams, benchmark charts and tool-design guides.
en.stack: Built in Python around a custom Laddered Simple Attention Network (Monarch Hadamard MLP, GQA attention, engram n-gram memory) with byte-level grammar-constrained decoding, installed via pip install cactus-needle.
en.hot: It has quickly reached 11,607 stars with 234 added today, ranking #14 on GitHub Trending daily, as its 2-bit 8-29 MB on-device tool-calling capability hits a real need for local AI agents.
uses: Mobile and wearable developers who want on-device tool calling and intent routing
Smart home, robotics and automotive engineers needing structured extraction on microcontrollers
Privacy-sensitive apps that need local text embeddings for search, matching and routing
Python developers prototyping lightweight AI agents with simple function decorators

zh.tag: Codex 桌面端与 CLI 的可视化管理工具，统一管理提示词、Provider、会话与 Skills/MCP。
zh.what: Codex-X 是一款面向 OpenAI Codex 桌面端和 CLI 的跨平台桌面工具，把提示词模板、自定义 Prompt、第三方 API 供应商、会话同步、Skills/MCP 和 TOML 配置都集中到可视化界面里。它让用户不用反复手改配置文件，就能完成 Provider 切换、提示词注入、会话管理和 Token 用量查看等高频操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Tauri 2 桌面应用（React 前端 + Rust 后端）、内置 5 套提示词模板、Provider 管理、会话同步、Skills/MCP 管理、TOML 配置可视化、Token 用量统计，以及多语言 README 和界面截图。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 Rust（stable）配合 Tauri 2，前端使用 React 18、TypeScript 5、Vite，数据层使用 SQLite，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
zh.hot: 项目已获得 3300 颗星，今日新增 64 星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 Rust 第 9 名。它精准解决了 Codex 用户配置分散、多 Provider 切换繁琐的痛点，因此受到广泛关注。
uses: 同时使用 Codex 桌面端、CLI 和第三方 API 的开发者 —— 可在一个界面统一管理 Provider 与配置。
需要频繁切换提示词模板或注入自定义 Prompt 的 AI 重度用户 —— 可视化分类、导入、一键启用。
管理多个 Codex 会话和 Skills/MCP 的团队 —— 支持会话同步、搜索、删除和集中管理。
关注 Token 用量与成本的技术用户 —— 可按日期和模型查看用量趋势。

en.tag: A cross-platform GUI manager for OpenAI Codex desktop/CLI, unifying prompts, providers, sessions, and Skills/MCP.
en.what: Codex-X is a cross-platform desktop tool for OpenAI Codex desktop and CLI that centralizes prompt templates, custom prompts, third-party API providers, session sync, Skills/MCP, and TOML configuration into a visual interface. It lets users handle provider switching, prompt injection, session management, and token usage tracking without repeatedly editing config files by hand.
en.content: The repo contains a Tauri 2 desktop app (React frontend + Rust backend), 5 built-in prompt templates, provider management, session sync, Skills/MCP management, TOML config visualization, token usage stats, plus multilingual READMEs and UI screenshots.
en.stack: Built with Rust (stable) and Tauri 2, with a React 18 + TypeScript 5 + Vite frontend, SQLite for data, and support for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: It has 3,300 stars with 64 added today, ranking #9 on GitHub Trending (Rust) daily. It addresses the pain of scattered Codex configs and cumbersome multi-provider switching, driving strong attention.
uses: Developers using Codex desktop, CLI, and third-party APIs — manage providers and configs in one UI.
Heavy AI users who frequently switch prompt templates or inject custom prompts — visual categorization, import, one-click enable.
Teams managing multiple Codex sessions and Skills/MCP — session sync, search, delete, and centralized management.
Technical users tracking token usage and cost — view usage trends by date and model.

zh.tag: 用多个 AI 投资代理模拟对冲基金做交易决策

en.tag: A multi-agent AI hedge fund that simulates investor agents making trading decisions
en.what: This is a proof-of-concept AI-powered hedge fund exploring how AI can make trading decisions. It turns different investing styles into pluggable, backtestable "alpha model" agents that form a fund team to pick stocks and rebalance. It is explicitly educational and does not place real trades.
en.content: The repo ships as a Python package with an interactive terminal app, mandate config files, a backtesting engine, and investor-agent modules, plus VISION.md and ROADMAP.md planning docs.
en.stack: Primarily Python, managed with Poetry and installable via pipx/uv/pip; it relies on the Financial Datasets API for data and supports LLMs from Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Google, xAI, Kimi and more.

Quant and finance enthusiasts can backtest strategies without risking real money
AI researchers can explore how LLMs perform and fail at financial decision-making
General users can try AI stock picking through the interactive terminal app

zh.tag: NVIDIA 官方 LLM 推理优化引擎，Python API 定义模型并高效部署
zh.what: TensorRT-LLM 是 NVIDIA 推出的开源库，提供易用的 Python API 来定义大语言模型，并通过专用算子、高效运行时和量化等优化手段在 NVIDIA GPU 上实现高性能推理。它还包含构建 Python 与 C++ 运行时的组件，用于编排推理执行。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Python 包 tensorrt_llm、C++ 运行时源码、大量示例与文档（含技术博客、架构说明、性能指南），以及面向 LLM 和视觉生成模型的优化实现。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python（支持 3.10/3.12），依赖 CUDA 13.2.1、PyTorch 2.12.0，并包含 C++ 运行时组件，遵循 Apache 2.0 许可。
zh.hot: 作为 NVIDIA 官方推理优化方案，它持续跟进最新模型（如 DeepSeek-V4）和 Blackwell 架构，star 数已达 14673，今日新增 14，位列 Python 日榜第 5，反映社区对高性能 LLM 部署的强烈需求。
uses: 需要在 NVIDIA GPU 上部署大语言模型并追求低延迟高吞吐的工程师
希望用 Python 快速定义和优化自定义 LLM 的算法研究人员
构建生产级 AI 推理服务、需要 C++/Python 运行时的后端开发者
关注最新推理优化技术（量化、注意力优化）并想学习实践的技术爱好者

en.tag: NVIDIA's official LLM inference optimization engine with a Python API for defining and deploying models
en.what: TensorRT-LLM is NVIDIA's open-source library that offers an easy-to-use Python API for defining large language models and applies state-of-the-art optimizations, including specialized kernels and an efficient runtime, for high-performance inference on NVIDIA GPUs. It also includes components for building Python and C++ runtimes that orchestrate inference execution.
en.content: The repo contains the core tensorrt_llm Python package, C++ runtime sources, extensive examples and docs (including tech blogs, architecture overview, and performance guides), plus optimized implementations for LLMs and visual generation models.
en.stack: Primarily Python (3.10/3.12) with CUDA 13.2.1 and PyTorch 2.12.0 dependencies, plus C++ runtime components, under Apache 2.0 license.
en.hot: As NVIDIA's official inference optimization solution, it keeps pace with the latest models (e.g., DeepSeek-V4) and Blackwell architecture, reaching 14,673 stars with 14 added today and ranking 5th on the Python daily trending list, reflecting strong demand for high-performance LLM deployment.
uses: Engineers deploying LLMs on NVIDIA GPUs who need low latency and high throughput
Algorithm researchers wanting to define and optimize custom LLMs quickly in Python
Backend developers building production AI inference services with C++/Python runtimes
Tech enthusiasts interested in learning and applying the latest inference optimizations (quantization, attention optimization)

zh.tag: OpenAI 官方 Python SDK，接入 REST API 的标准客户端
zh.what: 这是 OpenAI 官方维护的 Python 库，让任何 Python 3.10+ 应用都能方便地调用 OpenAI REST API。它为所有请求参数和响应字段提供类型定义，并同时支持同步与异步客户端。
zh.content: 仓库包含由 OpenAPI 规范自动生成的客户端代码、完整的 api.md 接口文档、类型定义，以及同步/异步两套客户端实现。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10+，使用 HTTPX2 作为 HTTP 客户端，并由 OpenAPI 规范自动生成，依赖 Pydantic 做类型校验。
zh.hot: 作为官方 SDK，它是几乎所有 Python 开发者调用 OpenAI 模型的第一入口，31.6k star 且今日仍新增 13 星，稳居 Python 日榜第 6。
uses: Python 开发者快速接入 OpenAI 模型能力，构建聊天、补全等应用
需要类型安全与同步/异步双模式的企业级后端服务开发
在 Kubernetes、Azure、GCP 等云环境中使用工作负载身份认证的团队
学习 OpenAI API 调用方式与最佳实践的入门者

en.tag: The official Python SDK for accessing the OpenAI REST API
en.what: This is OpenAI's official Python library that gives any Python 3.10+ application convenient access to the OpenAI REST API. It includes type definitions for all request params and response fields, and offers both synchronous and asynchronous clients.
en.content: The repo contains client code generated from the OpenAPI spec, full api.md API docs, type definitions, and both sync and async client implementations.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10+, uses HTTPX2 as the HTTP client, is auto-generated from the OpenAPI spec, and relies on Pydantic for type validation.
en.hot: As the official SDK, it's the first entry point for nearly every Python developer calling OpenAI models, with 31.6k stars and 13 added today, ranking 6th on the Python daily trending list.
uses: Python developers quickly integrating OpenAI model capabilities into chat and completion apps
Enterprise backend teams needing type safety and both sync/async modes
Teams using workload identity authentication in Kubernetes, Azure, or GCP environments
Beginners learning how to call the OpenAI API and follow best practices

zh.tag: 用树状索引与推理取代向量检索的无向量 RAG 方案
zh.what: PageIndex 是一个面向长文档与专业文档的 RAG 框架，用层级树状索引替代向量数据库，让 LLM 像人类专家一样在目录树上推理定位相关章节。它主张「相似不等于相关」，通过先建树、再推理检索的两步流程提升复杂文档的检索准确率。
zh.content: 仓库提供 Python SDK（pip install pageindex，支持本地模式与云端 API）、PageIndex Flash 快速建树、面向百万文档的 PageIndex File System，以及一个类人文档分析 App。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主，依赖用户自带的 LLM API Key，可本地运行或对接 PageIndex Cloud；无需向量数据库与分块流程。
zh.hot: 以「无向量、无分块、推理式检索」的差异化思路切入 RAG 痛点，已积累约 3.6 万 Star，今日新增 24 并登上 GitHub Trending Python 日榜第 7。
uses: 需要处理财报、法律合同、研报等长专业文档的 RAG 开发者
对向量检索准确率不满、想尝试推理式检索的 AI 工程师
希望本地私有化部署文档问答、自带 LLM Key 的团队
研究检索增强生成新范式的技术爱好者与研究者

en.tag: Vectorless, reasoning-based RAG that replaces vector search with a tree index
en.what: PageIndex is a RAG framework for long and professional documents that replaces the vector database with a hierarchical tree index, letting an LLM reason through it like a human expert. It argues similarity is not relevance, and improves retrieval accuracy via a two-step index-then-reason pipeline.
en.content: It ships a Python SDK (pip install pageindex, with local mode and cloud API), PageIndex Flash for fast tree generation, a PageIndex File System for corpus-scale indexing, and a human-like document analysis app.
en.stack: Primarily Python, using your own LLM API key, runnable locally or against PageIndex Cloud; no vector database or chunking pipeline required.

en.what: GitDiagram converts any public or private GitHub repository into an interactive architecture diagram in seconds, going beyond folder trees. en.content: The repo contains the Next.js app source, generation API routes, docs images and README, plus front-end features like Mermaid/PNG export and private-repo token support.

en.hot: It turns the common pain of understanding a codebase's architecture into a zero-friction URL swap, with streaming generation and clickable source links, reaching 16,469 stars and gaining 152 today for the #16 spot on the daily trending list.
uses: Developers who want to quickly grasp an unfamiliar open-source project's architecture
New team members onboarding into a large codebase who need the module map first

Engineers evaluating the internal structure of a third-party dependency

zh.tag: 可视化搭建 AI 代理与工作流的开源自动化平台
zh.what: n8n 是一个 fair-code 的工作流自动化平台，把可视化画布与自定义代码结合，用来构建和部署 AI 代理及多步骤自动化流程。它支持自托管或云端运行，可连接 1500+ 集成，并灵活切换 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 或开源模型。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 TypeScript 编写的核心引擎与节点系统，包含可视化编辑器前端、后端执行引擎、1500+ 集成节点以及大量示例工作流模板。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，基于 Node.js 运行，依赖 pnpm 工作区管理多包结构，前端采用 Vue，AI 能力集成 LangChain。

uses: 希望快速搭建 AI 代理和自动化流程的开发者与团队
需要自托管、数据可控的企业级自动化场景
想把 AI 接入现有系统并复用 1500+ 集成的工程师
用可视化方式学习工作流与 AI 编排的初学者

en.tag: Fair-code visual platform for building AI agents and workflow automation
en.what: n8n is a fair-code workflow automation platform that blends a visual canvas with custom code to build and deploy AI agents and multi-step workflows. It runs self-hosted or in the cloud, connects to 1500+ integrations, and lets you swap between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or open-source models.
en.content: The repo centers on a TypeScript core engine and node system, including the visual editor frontend, backend execution engine, 1500+ integration nodes, and a large library of example workflow templates.
en.stack: Primarily built with TypeScript on Node.js, using pnpm workspaces for its monorepo, a Vue-based frontend, and LangChain for AI capabilities.
en.hot: With 204k stars and 225 added today, n8n stands out as one of the most watched open-source projects in AI agents and automation, prized for its visual-plus-code flexibility and rich integrations.
uses: Developers and teams wanting to quickly build AI agents and automated workflows
Enterprise scenarios needing self-hosted, data-controlled automation
Engineers connecting AI to existing systems via 1500+ integrations
Beginners learning workflow and AI orchestration through a visual canvas

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理借用你已登录的真实浏览器，不打断你的工作
zh.what: BrowserSkill 通过 CLI 加浏览器扩展，把 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等任意能调用 shell 的 AI 代理连接到你已经登录的浏览器。代理需要操作某个已打开的标签页时必须显式借用，任务完成后归还，不影响你其余浏览。
zh.content: 仓库包含 bsk CLI/守护进程与浏览器扩展两部分运行时，以及安装文档、全页截图指南、沙箱代理配置等 docs 目录。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，支持 macOS、Linux、Windows，浏览器端支持 Chrome 与 Edge 等 Chromium 内核扩展。
zh.hot: 今日新增 1302 star、总数 4149，冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 4，切中了代理复用真实登录态与人工接管的刚需。
uses: 用 Cursor、Claude Code 等代理自动操作已登录网站的个人开发者
需要代理处理验证码、登录等人工步骤并随时接管的团队
希望避免维护独立测试账号与登录态的自动化工程师
在沙箱环境中运行代理、需要持久守护进程的进阶用户

en.tag: Let AI agents borrow your real, logged-in browser without interrupting your work
en.what: BrowserSkill connects shell-capable AI agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex to your already logged-in browser via a CLI plus extension. Agents must explicitly borrow an open tab, return it when done, and leave the rest of your browser untouched.
en.content: The repo ships two local runtimes — the bsk CLI/daemon and a browser extension — plus docs for installation, full-page screenshots, and sandboxed agent setup.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript; runs on macOS, Linux, and Windows, with Chrome and Edge (Chromium-based) extension support.
en.hot: With 1,302 stars added today and 4,149 total, it hit #4 on GitHub Trending, tapping the real need for agents to reuse live login state with human-in-the-loop handoff.
uses: Individual developers automating logged-in sites with Cursor, Claude Code, or similar agents
Teams needing agents to pause for captcha or login and hand control back to a human
Engineers who want to avoid maintaining separate test accounts and login states
Advanced users running agents in sandboxes who need a persistent daemon

zh.tag: 为 AI 编程助手打造的规格驱动开发框架
zh.what: OpenSpec 是一套规格驱动开发（SDD）框架，让 AI 编程助手在动手写代码前先生成提案、规格、设计与任务清单。它把模糊的想法转成结构化产物，再驱动 AI 逐步实现并归档，避免直接让模型改代码带来的失控。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 实现的 CLI 与工作流文档为主，核心是 /opsx:explore、/opsx:propose、/opsx:apply、/opsx:archive 等命令，以及 openspec/changes/ 下的提案、规格、设计与任务产物模板。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，通过 npm 包 @fission-ai/openspec 分发，MIT 许可，配有 CI 与 Discord 社区。
zh.hot: AI 编程助手普及后，如何约束模型行为成为痛点，OpenSpec 以轻量、迭代、面向存量代码库的理念切中需求，已积累约 6.9 万 star，今日再增 296 并登上日榜第 8。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程助手的开发者，希望先规划再让 AI 写代码
需要为存量项目引入规格化流程、减少 AI 随意改动的团队
想把需求、设计与任务沉淀为可追溯文档的个人或企业项目

en.tag: Spec-driven development framework for AI coding assistants
en.what: OpenSpec is a spec-driven development (SDD) framework that makes AI coding assistants produce proposals, specs, designs and task lists before writing any code. It turns vague ideas into structured artifacts, then drives the AI through implementation and archiving instead of letting it edit code blindly.
en.content: The repo centers on a TypeScript CLI plus workflow docs, with commands like /opsx:explore, /opsx:propose, /opsx:apply and /opsx:archive, along with templates for proposals, specs, designs and tasks under openspec/changes/.
en.stack: Built in TypeScript and distributed as the npm package @fission-ai/openspec under the MIT license, with CI and a Discord community.
en.hot: As AI coding assistants spread, constraining their behavior became a real pain point; OpenSpec's lightweight, iterative, brownfield-friendly philosophy hits the mark, reaching ~69k stars with 296 added today and the #8 spot on the daily trending list.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants like Claude Code or Cursor who want planning before code generation
Teams needing spec-driven workflows for brownfield projects to curb uncontrolled AI edits
Individuals or enterprises wanting requirements, design and tasks captured as traceable documents

zh.tag: 面向一人公司的 AI 内容营销智能体，一键分发与变现
zh.what: AiToEarn 是一个通过 AI Agent 自动化，帮助一人公司、创作者和品牌在全球主流平台构建、分发并变现内容的平台。它覆盖从内容创作、多平台发布到互动运营与收益转化的完整链路，支持抖音、小红书、TikTok、YouTube 等十余个渠道。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 为主，包含 Web 应用、AI Agent 工作流、多平台发布适配器、Docker 部署配置和开放平台 API 文档，提供网站直用、OpenClaw/Claude/Cursor 集成、Docker 私有化部署和源码开发五种使用方式。

zh.hot: 凭借 26057 颗星和日增 50 星登上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 日榜第 18 名，反映出创作者经济与 AI 自动化变现需求的强劲增长。

品牌与营销团队 —— 批量管理多账号内容发布与互动，降低运营成本
开发者/技术团队 —— 通过开放 API 或源码二次开发，集成到自有工作流
AI 工具用户 —— 在 Claude、Cursor 等助手中直接调用，快速生成营销内容

en.tag: AI content marketing agent for solopreneurs — create, publish, and monetize at scale
en.what: AiToEarn is an AI-agent-powered platform that helps solopreneurs, creators, and brands build, distribute, and monetize content across major global platforms. It automates the full pipeline from content creation and multi-platform publishing to engagement and revenue conversion, supporting over a dozen channels like TikTok, YouTube, and Xiaohongshu.

en.hot: With 26,057 stars and 50 new stars today, it ranks #18 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript daily), reflecting strong demand for creator economy and AI-driven monetization automation.
uses: Solopreneurs/independent creators — auto-generate and distribute content across platforms to boost reach and revenue
Brands and marketing teams — batch-manage multi-account publishing and engagement to cut operational costs
Developers/technical teams — integrate via open API or source code into custom workflows
AI tool users — call directly from Claude, Cursor, etc., to quickly generate marketing content

zh.tag: 用 TypeScript 编排沙箱自主智能体的框架
zh.what: Flue 是一个智能体编排框架，用可编程的 TypeScript harness 把模型、工具、技能和沙箱组合成能自主完成任务的 agent。它不提供又一套 SDK，而是让 agent 本身就是一个函数，在本地或远程容器沙箱中安全执行真实操作。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 源码和文档为主，包含 runtime 包（@flue/runtime）、示例 agents 目录，以及 skills、tools、sandboxes、subagents、durability 等模块文档。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 与 Node.js，提供 @flue/runtime 运行时和 @flue/runtime/node 适配，支持本地、虚拟或远程容器沙箱，并可接入 MCP 工具。
zh.hot: 发布不久即收获 8307 颗星并登上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 日榜第 10，说明开发者对「可编程沙箱智能体」这一新范式需求强烈。
uses: 想用 TypeScript 构建自主智能体的开发者
需要为 agent 提供安全沙箱执行环境的团队
希望把工具、技能与 MCP 服务组合进 agent 工作流的工程师
关注 Claude Code / Codex 式自主代理架构的研究者

en.tag: A TypeScript harness framework for building sandboxed autonomous agents
en.what: Flue is an agent harness framework that composes models, tools, skills, and sandboxes into autonomous agents via programmable TypeScript. Rather than another SDK, it makes the agent itself a function that safely executes real work in local or remote container sandboxes.
en.content: The repo is mainly TypeScript source and docs, including the @flue/runtime package, example agents, and documentation for skills, tools, sandboxes, subagents, and durability.
en.stack: Built on TypeScript and Node.js with the @flue/runtime and @flue/runtime/node adapters, supporting local, virtual, or remote container sandboxes and MCP tool integration.
en.hot: With 8,307 stars shortly after launch and a #10 spot on GitHub Trending's TypeScript daily list, it shows strong developer demand for the programmable sandboxed-agent paradigm.
uses: Developers who want to build autonomous agents in TypeScript
Teams needing a secure sandbox for agent execution
Engineers composing tools, skills, and MCP servers into agent workflows
Researchers exploring Claude Code / Codex-style autonomous agent architectures

zh.tag: 为 AI 打造的记忆与上下文引擎，可完全本地运行
zh.what: Supermemory 是面向 AI 的记忆与上下文层，能从对话中自动提取事实、构建用户画像、处理知识更新与矛盾并遗忘过期信息。它把完整 RAG、连接器、文件处理整合成一套系统，在 LongMemEval、LoCoMo、ConvoMem 三大记忆基准上排名第一。

zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，提供 npm 与 Python 双 SDK，支持自托管与本地运行，集成 Google Drive、Gmail、Notion、OneDrive、GitHub 等连接器及多模态提取器。
zh.hot: 凭借三大记忆基准第一、95% Recall@15 与 99.4% 上下文压缩的硬指标，加上可完全本地运行，项目已积累 30280 颗星，今日再增 140 星登上日榜第 11。
uses: 构建长期记忆 AI 助手与聊天机器人的开发者
需要为 RAG 应用加入个性化用户画像的团队
希望自托管、数据不出本地的隐私敏感场景

en.tag: A state-of-the-art memory and context engine for AI, fully self-hostable
en.what: Supermemory is a memory and context layer for AI that automatically extracts facts from conversations, builds user profiles, handles knowledge updates and contradictions, and forgets expired information. It bundles full RAG, connectors, and file processing into one system, ranking #1 on LongMemEval, LoCoMo, and ConvoMem.

en.stack: Primarily TypeScript with both npm and Python SDKs, supporting self-hosting and local runs, plus connectors for Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub with multi-modal extractors.

Teams adding personalized user profiles to RAG applications

TypeScript or Python engineers wanting quick memory integration

Operations or investment professionals monitoring infrastructure and energy dynamics
Developers who want to integrate global intelligence into their apps via npm package or Python SDK
Information enthusiasts interested in verticals like tech, finance, and commodities

zh.tag: 让编码智能体直接操控并调试真实 Chrome 浏览器的 MCP 服务器

en.tag: An MCP server that lets coding agents control and debug a live Chrome browser

en.content: The repository contains module files for five proxy platforms (Shadowrocket, Surge, Loon, Quantumult X, Stash), a core JavaScript script location-spoofer.js, and detailed Chinese tutorials and troubleshooting guides.

en.hot: The project gained 252 stars this week, reaching 4,147 total stars, and ranked 11th on GitHub Trending weekly (JavaScript). en.tag: The core async runtime powering reliable, high-concurrency Rust applications
en.what: Tokio is an event-driven, non-blocking I/O runtime for writing reliable, asynchronous, and slim applications in Rust. It provides a multithreaded work-stealing task scheduler, a reactor backed by the OS event queue (epoll/kqueue/IOCP), and asynchronous TCP/UDP sockets.
en.content: The repo ships as a Rust crate containing the runtime scheduler, networking, I/O, timers and synchronization primitives, plus numerous examples (such as a TCP echo server) and pointers to real-world projects like mini-redis.

en.hot: As the undisputed foundation of the Rust async ecosystem, it underpins countless frameworks like Axum, Hyper and Tonic; with 33k+ stars it remains a top Rust project, and even a modest +8 today keeps it in the daily top 10.

Systems developers needing async I/O, timers or task scheduling

Teams rewriting high-performance gateways, proxies or DB middleware in Rust

en.tag: Alibaba's battle-tested hybrid-architecture AI code review CLI
en.what: Open Code Review is an open-sourced AI code review CLI incubated inside Alibaba, combining deterministic pipelines with an LLM Agent. It produces precise line-level comments and ships with a built-in multi-language ruleset covering NPE, thread-safety, XSS and SQL injection.

Developers using Claude Code, Codex or Cursor agents

AI tool builders studying hybrid architecture and ruleset design

zh.tag: 让编码代理像原始人一样说话，省下 65% token 的代理技能与代理层
zh.what: Caveman 是一个面向 AI 编码代理的技能（skill）与代理（proxy），通过强制代理用极简的“原始人式”语言输出，把 token 消耗削减约 65%。它不改模型本身，而是在代理与模型之间做一层输出压缩，从而直接降低按 token 计费的账单。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 Go 编写的代理/CLI 核心、可一键安装的 skill 包（npx skills add）、10 个原生代理包装配置以及 30+ 代理的兼容说明文档，另附 logo、演示视频与安装指南。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，提供 npm 包 @caveman-ai/cli 与 skills.sh 技能分发，支持 30+ 编码代理、10 个原生包装配置，采用 MIT + BSL 双许可。
zh.hot: 凭借“少 token 多干活”的反差梗和 ThePrimeagen 反应视频迅速走红，登上 GitHub Trending 与 Hacker News 第一，已积累 10.6 万 star，今日仍新增 229 星。
uses: 按 token 计费、想压低 AI 编码代理账单的个人开发者与团队
使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 30+ 代理、希望零改造接入省 token 的用户

想研究提示词/输出风格对成本与质量影响的 AI 研究者

en.tag: A viral skill + proxy that makes coding agents talk like cavemen to cut 65% of tokens
en.what: Caveman is a skill and proxy for AI coding agents that cuts token usage by roughly 65% by forcing agents to speak in terse, caveman-style language. It doesn't change the model itself; it compresses agent output at the layer between agent and model, directly lowering token-based bills.
en.content: The repo ships a Go-based proxy/CLI core, a one-command installable skill package (npx skills add), 10 native agent wrap profiles, and compatibility docs for 30+ agents, plus logos, a demo video, and install guides.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, distributed via the npm package @caveman-ai/cli and skills.sh, supporting 30+ coding agents and 10 native wrap profiles under an MIT + BSL dual license.
en.hot: It went viral on the back of the 'few token do trick' meme and a ThePrimeagen reaction video, topping GitHub Trending and Hacker News, and now sits at 106k stars with 229 added today.
uses: Individual devs and teams billed by tokens who want to shrink their AI coding agent bills
Users of Claude Code, Cursor and 30+ other agents who want zero-effort token savings
AI and platform engineers interested in agent output compression and cost optimization
AI researchers studying how prompt/output style affects cost and quality

zh.tag: 面向自主代理的高密度安全沙箱运行时，支持微虚拟机和 gVisor，实现亚秒级挂起/恢复与 30 倍超售。
zh.what: Agent Substrate 是一个专为自主代理设计的安全执行运行时，能在标准容器运行时基础上实现 10 倍密度的沙箱运行，支持每秒超过 500 次挂起/恢复操作且恢复时间低于 500 毫秒。它通过将大量“actor”（如代理应用）映射到少量“worker”上，利用代理大部分时间空闲的特性实现高密度多路复用，并提供 actor 生命周期管理、实时调度和流量路由。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心系统代码，主要用 Go 编写，并利用 Kubernetes 进行基础设施供给和 worker 生命周期管理。README 中提供了演示视频，展示如何在 8 个物理 Pod 上多路复用约 250 个有状态 actor，实现 30 倍以上的超售。
zh.stack: 技术栈以 Go 为主，依赖 Kubernetes 进行 Pod 管理和自动扩缩容，并支持 microVM 和 gVisor 等多种沙箱技术，实现零信任内核和网络隔离。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 12 颗星，总星数达 1979，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜（Go）第 6 名。其高密度、低延迟的代理运行时特性，以及来自 Google 的开源背景，吸引了大量关注。
uses: AI 代理开发者 —— 需要大规模部署和运行自主代理，追求高密度和低延迟的运行时环境。
基础设施工程师 —— 希望利用 Kubernetes 和沙箱技术构建安全、高效的代理执行平台。
强化学习研究者 —— 需要跨代理、推理和训练周期进行整体基础设施优化，以支持 RL 场景。
云原生爱好者 —— 对微虚拟机、gVisor 等沙箱技术及高密度多路复用感兴趣的技术人员。

en.tag: A secure-by-default agent execution runtime for running millions of sandboxes with 10x density, sub-500ms resume, and 30x oversubscription.
en.what: Agent Substrate is a secure-by-default agent execution runtime engineered to run millions of sandboxes with 10x higher density than standard container runtimes, delivering sub-500ms resume operations at over 500 suspend/resume activations per second. It maps a larger set of 'actors' (applications such as agents) onto a smaller set of ready 'workers', leveraging the fact that agent-like applications tend to be idle most of the time to achieve heavy multiplexing, and provides actor lifecycle management, real-time assignment, and traffic routing.
en.content: The repository contains the core system code, primarily written in Go, leveraging Kubernetes for infrastructure provisioning and worker lifecycle management. The README includes a demo video showing how to multiplex ~250 stateful actors across just 8 physical pods, achieving 30x+ oversubscription.
en.stack: The tech stack is primarily Go, relying on Kubernetes for pod management and autoscaling, and supports multiple sandbox technologies including microVMs and gVisor, with native zero-trust kernel and network isolation.
en.hot: The project gained 12 stars today, reaching 1,979 total stars, and ranks 6th on GitHub Trending (Go) daily list. Its high-density, low-latency agent runtime features and Google open-source background have attracted significant attention.
uses: AI agent developers — need to deploy and run autonomous agents at scale with high density and low latency.
Infrastructure engineers — want to build secure and efficient agent execution platforms using Kubernetes and sandbox technologies.
Reinforcement learning researchers — need holistic infrastructure optimizations across agentic, inference, and training cycles for RL scenarios.
Cloud-native enthusiasts — interested in microVMs, gVisor, and high-density multiplexing technologies.

zh.tag: 把文档变成可查询RAG、自主推理Agent和自维护Wiki的LLM知识平台

uses: 企业知识库建设：将内部文档自动整理为可查询的RAG和自维护Wiki，提升员工检索效率。
智能客服与问答系统：利用RAG快速问答能力，构建基于私有知识的对话机器人。

en.tag: Open-source LLM knowledge platform turning documents into queryable RAG, autonomous agent, and self-maintaining Wiki
en.what: WeKnora is an open-source LLM knowledge platform from Tencent that transforms raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki. Intelligent customer service and Q&A systems: Leverage RAG-based quick Q&A to build chatbots grounded in private knowledge.
Complex task automation: Use ReAct Agent to orchestrate retrieval, tool calls, and web search for multi-step analysis.
Personal knowledge management: Import personal documents to generate knowledge graphs and wikis for learning and research.

zh.tag: 用众包提示词把 AI 能力接入日常工具的开源框架
zh.what: Fabric 是一个用 AI 增强人类能力的开源框架，核心思路是：AI 的问题不是能力不足，而是难以融入日常。它把提示词（Patterns）按真实任务组织起来，让用户在任何工具里复用这些 AI 解决方案。

en.tag: An open-source framework that augments humans with AI via crowdsourced prompts
en.what: Fabric is an open-source framework for augmenting humans using AI. Its core idea is that AI's problem isn't capability but integration, so it organizes prompts (Patterns) by real-world task so users can reuse AI solutions in any tool.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based CLI and REST API server, a task-organized library of Patterns (prompts), helper apps, and a docs folder.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, it offers both CLI and REST API usage, depends on various AI model provider APIs, and is MIT-licensed.
en.hot: With 44k+ stars and a clear 'prompts as infrastructure' positioning, Fabric is a popular way to integrate AI into workflows, still ranking 8th on today's Go trending list.

Terminal-heavy users who prefer a CLI to call various AI models quickly
Teams building their own AI services and integrating prompt capabilities via REST API

zh.tag: 基于eBPF的云原生网络、安全与可观测性平台
zh.what: Cilium 是一个基于 eBPF 数据平面的网络、可观测性和安全解决方案。它提供简单的扁平三层网络，支持多集群原生路由或覆盖模式，并具备 L7 协议感知能力，可基于身份模型实施 L3-L7 网络策略。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Cilium 核心组件（如 agent、operator、CNI 插件）、eBPF 数据平面代码、文档、测试和部署清单。主要目录有 daemon、pkg、bpf、Documentation、operator 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Linux 内核 eBPF 技术，需要较新内核版本（通常 4.19+）。项目使用 Kubernetes 作为主要编排平台，并集成 Prometheus、Envoy 等生态组件。
zh.hot: Cilium 是 CNCF 毕业项目，拥有 25k+ stars，今日新增 20 stars，位列 Go 趋势榜第 20 名。作为 Kubernetes 网络、安全和可观测性的领先方案，它持续受到云原生社区的高度关注。
uses: Kubernetes 集群管理员：需要高性能、可扩展的网络方案来替代 kube-proxy。
云原生安全工程师：希望实施基于身份的网络策略和 L7 层安全控制。
平台运维团队：需要深度网络可观测性和故障排查能力。
服务网格架构师：寻求集成 ingress/egress 网关和带宽管理的一体化方案。

en.tag: eBPF-based networking, security, and observability for cloud native
en.what: Cilium is a networking, observability, and security solution with an eBPF-based dataplane. It provides a simple flat Layer 3 network that can span multiple clusters in native routing or overlay mode, and is L7-protocol aware, enforcing network policies on L3-L7 using an identity-based security model.
en.content: The repository contains Cilium core components (such as agent, operator, CNI plugin), eBPF dataplane code, documentation, tests, and deployment manifests. Main directories include daemon, pkg, bpf, Documentation, operator, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on Linux kernel eBPF technology and requiring a relatively new kernel (typically 4.19+). The project uses Kubernetes as the main orchestration platform and integrates with ecosystem components like Prometheus and Envoy.
en.hot: Cilium is a CNCF graduated project with 25k+ stars, gaining 20 stars today and ranking 20th on the Go trending list. As a leading solution for Kubernetes networking, security, and observability, it continues to attract significant attention from the cloud native community.
uses: Kubernetes cluster administrators: need a high-performance, scalable networking solution to replace kube-proxy.
Cloud native security engineers: want to implement identity-based network policies and L7 security controls.
Platform operations teams: require deep network observability and troubleshooting capabilities.
Service mesh architects: seek an integrated solution with ingress/egress gateways and bandwidth management.

zh.tag: 用一份 YAML 定义并一键运行多容器应用
zh.what: Docker Compose 是 Docker 官方的多容器编排工具，通过 Compose 文件格式（compose.yaml）声明式地定义应用所需的多个容器、网络与卷。定义完成后，只需一条 `docker compose up` 命令即可创建并启动整个应用。

CI/CD 工程师：在流水线中快速构建可复现的集成测试环境
运维与平台团队：为小型服务栈提供轻量级编排方案
技术学习者：通过 YAML 直观理解多容器应用的组织方式

en.tag: Define and run multi-container apps with a single YAML file
en.what: Docker Compose is Docker's official tool for orchestrating multi-container applications, using the Compose file format (compose.yaml) to declaratively define the containers, networks and volumes an app needs. Once defined, a single `docker compose up` command creates and starts the entire application.
en.content: The repo holds the Go implementation of Compose v2: CLI command source, Compose spec parsing, the client layer talking to Docker Engine, plus docs, CI configs and release scripts.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, it depends on the Docker Engine API and the compose-spec, ships as a Docker CLI plugin, and supports Windows, macOS and Linux.
en.hot: As the de-facto standard for container orchestration, it has 38,195 stars, gained 17 more today and ranks 10th on the Go daily trending list, remaining the go-to choice for local dev and CI.
uses: Local developers: spin up a full dev stack (DB, cache, backend) with one command
CI/CD engineers: build reproducible integration test environments in pipelines

Learners: understand multi-container app structure visually through YAML

en.what: Karmada (Kubernetes Armada) is a Kubernetes management system that lets you run cloud-native applications across multiple Kubernetes clusters and clouds without changing your apps. It speaks Kubernetes-native APIs and offers advanced scheduling, enabling truly open multi-cloud Kubernetes.
