zh.tag: 跨厂商 3D 高斯泼溅训练器：视频到泼溅到网格，单文件运行
zh.what: Spirula Studio 是一个 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）训练工具，能把原始照片或视频一路处理成 splat 再到带纹理的网格。它打包成单个自包含二进制，不需要 Python/PyTorch，也不用单独安装 COLMAP。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整训练管线：内置快速 SfM、AI 遮罩、视频抽帧、深度/法线估计、网格化、天空盒与线性色彩处理，并提供 GUI、CLI 和网页查看器。
zh.stack: 主语言 C++，通过 Vulkan 计算实现跨厂商 GPU 支持，也支持 CUDA；依赖 Vulkan SDK 与各平台图形驱动，可自行从源码构建。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub C++ 日榜第 1 名，它凭 465 星（今日 +9）吸引关注：单二进制、无 Python 依赖、8GB 显存跑 1000 万高斯，还支持 360° 相机，大幅降低 3DGS 使用门槛。
uses: 3D 重建与数字孪生从业者，想用普通视频快速生成 splat 与网格
没有 Python/PyTorch 环境或使用 AMD/Intel/Apple GPU 的创作者
需要处理鱼眼或 360° 全景素材的 VR/AR 内容制作者
希望把 3DGS 训练集成进自有工具链的 C++ 开发者

en.tag: Cross-vendor 3D Gaussian Splatting trainer: video to splat to mesh in one binary
en.what: Spirula Studio is a 3D Gaussian Splatting trainer that takes raw photos or video all the way from splat to textured mesh. It ships as one self-contained binary with no Python/PyTorch and no separate COLMAP install.
en.content: The repo contains a full pipeline: built-in fast SfM, AI masking, video frame extraction, depth/normal estimation, meshing, skybox and linear color, plus GUI, CLI and a web viewer.
en.stack: Written in C++ with Vulkan compute for cross-vendor GPUs and optional CUDA; it depends on the Vulkan SDK and platform graphics drivers, and can be built from source.
en.hot: Ranked #1 on GitHub Trending (C++) with 465 stars (+9 today), it stands out for a single binary, no Python dependency, 10M Gaussians in 8GB VRAM and native 360° camera support, greatly lowering the 3DGS barrier.
uses: 3D reconstruction and digital-twin practitioners who want splat and mesh from ordinary video
Creators without a Python/PyTorch setup or on AMD/Intel/Apple GPUs
VR/AR content makers working with fisheye or 360° footage
C++ developers integrating 3DGS training into their own toolchain

zh.tag: 纯C/C++的高性能LLM推理引擎
zh.what: llama.cpp 是一个用纯 C/C++ 编写的高性能大语言模型推理引擎，支持在 CPU 和 GPU 上高效运行。它针对本地部署和资源受限环境进行了优化，无需依赖庞大的深度学习框架。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理库 libllama、命令行工具、REST API 服务器（llama-server）以及 WebUI。支持多种量化格式（如 GGUF）和模型架构（如 LLaMA、GPT-OSS）。
zh.stack: 纯 C/C++ 实现，依赖 ggml 张量库，可选支持 CUDA、Vulkan、Metal 等 GPU 加速后端。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的本地 LLM 推理方案之一，llama.cpp 持续获得社区关注，今日新增 159 星，总星数突破 12 万。其高性能、跨平台和易用性使其成为 AI 开发者和爱好者的首选。
uses: AI 开发者：在本地或边缘设备上运行和测试大语言模型
隐私敏感用户：无需联网即可使用 LLM，数据完全本地化
研究人员：探索模型量化、推理优化和自定义模型架构

en.tag: High-performance LLM inference engine in pure C/C++
en.what: llama.cpp is a high-performance LLM inference engine written in pure C/C++, optimized for CPU and GPU execution. It enables efficient local deployment without heavy deep learning frameworks.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference library libllama, CLI tools, a REST API server (llama-server), and a WebUI. It supports various quantization formats (e.g., GGUF) and model architectures (e.g., LLaMA, GPT-OSS).
en.stack: Pure C/C++ implementation, relies on the ggml tensor library, with optional GPU backends like CUDA, Vulkan, and Metal.
en.hot: As one of the most popular local LLM inference solutions, llama.cpp continues to gain community traction with 159 new stars today, surpassing 120K total. Its performance, cross-platform support, and ease of use make it a top choice for AI developers and enthusiasts.
uses: AI developers: run and test LLMs locally or on edge devices
Privacy-conscious users: use LLMs offline with full data locality
Researchers: explore quantization, inference optimization, and custom model architectures

zh.tag: 让 vLLM 在昇腾 NPU 上跑起来的社区硬件插件
zh.what: 这是 vLLM 官方生态下的昇腾（Ascend）硬件后端插件，把 vLLM 的高吞吐推理能力对接到华为昇腾 NPU。它负责算子适配、显存管理与分布式推理支持，让原本面向 GPU 的 vLLM 能在昇腾设备上直接部署大模型服务。
zh.content: 仓库以 C++/Python 混合实现为主，包含昇腾算子与图适配层、vLLM 平台接口实现、安装脚本、测试用例以及完整的官方文档站（含支持矩阵、用户指南与中英文 README）。
zh.stack: 基于 vLLM 插件机制与 PyTorch，依赖 CANN、torch_npu 及昇腾驱动/固件，主语言为 C++ 并辅以 Python 绑定。
zh.hot: 作为 vLLM 官方生态中唯一的昇腾后端，它填补了国产 NPU 跑主流推理框架的空白；2830 star 且今日仍在上榜，说明国产算力适配需求持续旺盛。
uses: 使用华为昇腾 NPU 部署大模型推理服务的工程师
需要在国产算力上跑 vLLM 高吞吐推理的团队
为昇腾平台做算子适配与性能调优的开发者
评估国产 AI 芯片推理可行性的技术决策者

en.tag: Community hardware plugin that runs vLLM on Ascend NPUs
en.what: This is the Ascend hardware backend plugin under the vLLM project, connecting vLLM's high-throughput inference engine to Huawei Ascend NPUs. It handles operator adaptation, memory management and distributed inference so that GPU-oriented vLLM can serve large models directly on Ascend devices.
en.content: The repo is a C++/Python hybrid containing the Ascend operator and graph adaptation layer, vLLM platform interface implementations, install scripts, tests, and a full documentation site with a support matrix, user guide and bilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Built on vLLM's plugin mechanism and PyTorch, depending on CANN, torch_npu and Ascend drivers/firmware, primarily in C++ with Python bindings.
en.hot: As the only Ascend backend in the vLLM ecosystem, it fills the gap for running mainstream inference frameworks on domestic NPUs; with 2,830 stars and still trending today, demand for domestic accelerator support remains strong.
uses: Engineers deploying LLM inference on Huawei Ascend NPUs
Teams needing high-throughput vLLM inference on domestic accelerators
Developers adapting operators and tuning performance for Ascend
Technical decision-makers evaluating domestic AI chip inference

zh.tag: 开源计算机视觉库，图像与视频处理的事实标准
zh.what: OpenCV 是一个开源的计算机视觉与机器学习软件库，提供图像处理、视频分析、特征检测、目标识别等数千个优化算法。它支持从实时图像滤波到深度学习推理的完整流程，是视觉应用开发的基础设施。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心模块源码（core、imgproc、video、dnn、calib3d 等）、构建脚本、测试与文档；扩展功能如 contrib 模块、示例代码和跨平台绑定（Python、Java 等）分布在关联仓库中。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 C++、Python、Java 等多语言接口，依赖 CMake 构建，可选 CUDA、OpenCL、IPP 等硬件加速后端，并支持 Windows、Linux、macOS、Android、iOS。
zh.hot: 作为计算机视觉领域最广泛使用的开源库，OpenCV 已积累超过 9 万 star，今日新增 14 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 4，说明其在 AI 视觉应用持续普及的背景下仍保持高关注度。
uses: 计算机视觉工程师与研究者，用于快速实现图像/视频处理算法
机器人、自动驾驶、安防监控等领域的开发者，需要实时视觉感知能力
学生与教育工作者，通过 OpenCV 课程和示例学习计算机视觉基础
AI 应用开发者，将 OpenCV 作为深度学习模型的前后处理与部署工具

en.tag: The de facto standard open-source library for computer vision and image processing
en.what: OpenCV is an open-source computer vision and machine learning software library offering thousands of optimized algorithms for image processing, video analysis, feature detection, and object recognition. It covers everything from real-time filtering to deep learning inference, serving as foundational infrastructure for vision applications.
en.content: The repository contains core module sources (core, imgproc, video, dnn, calib3d, etc.), build scripts, tests, and documentation; extended functionality such as contrib modules, samples, and cross-platform bindings (Python, Java, etc.) live in companion repositories.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ with bindings for C++, Python, Java, and more; built with CMake and optionally accelerated by CUDA, OpenCL, IPP, and other backends, supporting Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, and iOS.
en.hot: As the most widely used open-source library in computer vision, OpenCV has accumulated over 90k stars; with 14 new stars today and ranking 4th on the C++ trending list, it remains highly relevant amid the ongoing spread of AI vision applications.
uses: Computer vision engineers and researchers implementing image/video processing algorithms quickly
Developers in robotics, autonomous driving, and surveillance needing real-time visual perception
Students and educators learning computer vision fundamentals via OpenCV courses and samples
AI application developers using OpenCV for pre/post-processing and deployment of deep learning models

zh.tag: 开源游戏串流客户端，把 PC 游戏投到任意屏幕
zh.what: Moonlight PC 是 NVIDIA GameStream 与开源主机端 Sunshine 的桌面客户端，让你把高性能 PC 上的游戏以低延迟串流到 Windows、Mac、Linux 或 Steam Link 设备上。它负责解码与输入回传，主机端则负责编码画面。
zh.content: 仓库是完整的 Qt/C++ 桌面应用源码，包含 Windows、macOS、Linux、Steam Link、树莓派、ARM 与 RISC-V 等平台的构建配置，以及发布包与 nightly 构建流程。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 与 Qt 编写，依赖 FFmpeg 做硬件加速解码，支持 H.264、HEVC、AV1 与 HDR；输入与手柄层使用 SDL 等库，构建走 CMake 与 GitHub Actions。
zh.hot: NVIDIA 官方 GameStream 停服后，Moonlight + Sunshine 成为自建串流的事实标准，本月新增 413 star、总数 18695，稳居 C++ 月榜第 15。
uses: 想把客厅电视或旧笔记本变成游戏终端的 PC 玩家
在 Steam Deck、树莓派或 Steam Link 上串流大作的用户
需要远程桌面式低延迟控制与多手柄支持的场景

en.tag: Open-source game streaming client that casts your PC games to any screen
en.what: Moonlight PC is a desktop client for NVIDIA GameStream and the open-source Sunshine host, letting you stream games from a powerful PC to Windows, Mac, Linux, or Steam Link devices with low latency. It handles decoding and input forwarding while the host handles encoding.
en.content: The repo holds the full Qt/C++ desktop application source, with build configs for Windows, macOS, Linux, Steam Link, Raspberry Pi, ARM, and RISC-V, plus release and nightly build workflows.
en.stack: Written in C++ with Qt, it relies on FFmpeg for hardware-accelerated decoding with H.264, HEVC, AV1, and HDR support; input and gamepad handling use SDL and friends, built via CMake and GitHub Actions.
en.hot: After NVIDIA discontinued GameStream, Moonlight plus Sunshine became the de facto standard for self-hosted streaming, adding 413 stars this month for 18,695 total and ranking 15th on the monthly C++ chart.
uses: PC gamers who want to turn a living-room TV or old laptop into a game terminal
Users streaming AAA titles on Steam Deck, Raspberry Pi, or Steam Link
Scenarios needing low-latency remote desktop control and multi-gamepad support

zh.tag: 苹果芯片上的高性能机器学习数组框架
zh.what: MLX 是苹果机器学习研究团队推出的数组框架，专为 Apple silicon 优化，提供类似 NumPy 的 Python API 以及 C++、C、Swift 接口。它支持自动微分、自动向量化和计算图优化，并采用惰性计算与统一内存模型，便于在 CPU 和 GPU 上高效训练和部署模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 实现、Python 绑定、文档和示例链接；配套的 mlx-examples 仓库提供 Transformer 语言模型、LLaMA 文本生成、LoRA 微调、Stable Diffusion 图像生成和 Whisper 语音识别等示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 Python、C、Swift 等多语言 API，依赖 NumPy 风格的数组操作和 PyTorch 风格的高层模块（mlx.nn、mlx.optimizers），并针对 Apple silicon 的 CPU 和 GPU 进行优化。
zh.hot: MLX 由苹果官方推出，凭借对 Apple silicon 的深度优化和统一内存模型，在本地运行大模型场景中备受关注，已获得 28484 颗星，今日新增 16 星，位列 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 6 名。
uses: 苹果生态开发者，希望在 Mac 上高效训练和部署机器学习模型
机器学习研究者，需要轻量、可扩展且易于修改的数组框架
需要在本地运行大语言模型、图像生成或语音识别应用的用户
对 NumPy/PyTorch 熟悉，想尝试 Apple silicon 加速的开发者

en.tag: A high-performance array framework for machine learning on Apple silicon
en.what: MLX is an array framework by Apple Machine Learning Research, optimized for Apple silicon, offering a NumPy-like Python API plus C++, C, and Swift APIs. It supports automatic differentiation, automatic vectorization, and computation graph optimization, with lazy computation and a unified memory model for efficient training and deployment on CPU and GPU.
en.content: The repo contains the core C++ implementation, Python bindings, documentation, and example links; the companion mlx-examples repo offers examples like Transformer language model training, LLaMA text generation, LoRA fine-tuning, Stable Diffusion image generation, and Whisper speech recognition.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with multi-language APIs for Python, C, and Swift, relying on NumPy-style array operations and PyTorch-style high-level modules (mlx.nn, mlx.optimizers), optimized for Apple silicon CPU and GPU.
en.hot: Backed by Apple, MLX stands out for its deep optimization for Apple silicon and unified memory model, gaining traction for running large models locally; it has 28,484 stars with 16 added today, ranking 6th on GitHub Trending's daily C++ list.
uses: Apple ecosystem developers who want to train and deploy ML models efficiently on Mac
ML researchers needing a lightweight, extensible, and easy-to-modify array framework
Users running LLMs, image generation, or speech recognition locally
Developers familiar with NumPy/PyTorch looking to leverage Apple silicon acceleration

zh.tag: 谷歌开源组合优化求解套件，覆盖约束规划、线性规划与路径规划
zh.what: OR-Tools 是谷歌开源的组合优化软件套件，用于求解约束规划、线性/混合整数规划、装箱与背包、旅行商与车辆路径、图算法等经典优化问题。核心用 C++ 编写，同时提供 Python、C#、Java 封装，方便不同语言用户直接调用。
zh.content: 仓库以 ortools 为源码根目录，包含 base、algorithms、graph、linear_solver、glop、pdlp、sat 等模块及大量示例；构建体系同时提供 Makefile、CMake 和 Bazel 三套入口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 实现，依赖 Abseil、Protocol Buffers、SCIP、GLOP/PDLP 等求解器组件，并通过 SWIG 等机制生成 Python、Java、.NET 绑定。
zh.hot: 作为运筹优化领域少有的工业级开源套件，OR-Tools 长期被物流、排班、调度等场景使用，已积累约 1.4 万 star；今日小幅新增 6 star 并登上 C++ 日榜第 7，说明其仍是该领域稳定的参考实现。
uses: 运筹优化与算法工程师：需要求解排班、路径、资源分配等组合优化问题
物流与供应链团队：用车辆路径和装箱算法优化配送与装载方案
学术研究者与学生：以 OR-Tools 作为教学和论文实验的求解器基线
后端/数据工程师：通过 Python、Java 或 C# 封装快速集成优化能力

en.tag: Google's open-source suite for combinatorial optimization: CP, LP, routing and graph algorithms
en.what: OR-Tools is Google's open-source suite for combinatorial optimization, covering constraint programming, linear and mixed-integer programming, bin packing, knapsack, TSP/VRP and graph algorithms. It is written in C++ with wrappers for Python, C# and Java so users can call it from multiple languages.
en.content: The repo centers on the ortools source root, with modules for base utilities, algorithms, graph, linear_solver, glop, pdlp and sat, plus many samples; builds are supported via Makefile, CMake and Bazel.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with dependencies such as Abseil, Protocol Buffers, SCIP and the GLOP/PDLP solvers, and it generates Python, Java and .NET bindings via SWIG-style tooling.
en.hot: As a rare industrial-grade open-source optimization suite, OR-Tools is widely used in logistics, scheduling and rostering, accumulating about 14k stars; today it gained 6 stars and ranked 7th on the C++ daily trending list, showing it remains a steady reference implementation in the field.
uses: Operations research and algorithm engineers solving scheduling, routing and resource allocation problems
Logistics and supply-chain teams optimizing delivery routes and bin packing
Researchers and students using OR-Tools as a solver baseline for teaching and experiments
Backend and data engineers integrating optimization via Python, Java or C# wrappers

zh.tag: 英特尔开源深度学习推理优化与部署工具包
zh.what: OpenVINO 是英特尔开源的深度学习推理优化与部署工具包，可将训练好的模型转换并加速到 CPU、GPU、NPU 等硬件上运行。它覆盖计算机视觉、语音识别、生成式 AI 与 NLP 等常见任务，支持从边缘到云端的部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 推理引擎、模型转换与优化工具（如 Model Optimizer、NNCF 量化）、多语言绑定（Python/Node.js/C）、示例教程与文档，并有 openvino.genai 等配套仓库。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为核心，提供 Python、Node.js、C 等绑定，支持 PyTorch、TensorFlow、ONNX、Keras、PaddlePaddle、JAX/Flax 及 Hugging Face 模型，可通过 pip、conda、npm、brew 安装。
zh.hot: 作为英特尔主推的推理部署方案，OpenVINO 在边缘 AI 与本地大模型推理需求增长下持续受关注，本月新增 211 star，累计 10822，位列 GitHub C++ 月榜第 11。
uses: 需要在英特尔 CPU/GPU/NPU 上部署高性能推理的 AI 工程师
希望把 PyTorch/TensorFlow 模型优化并落地到边缘设备的开发者
从事计算机视觉、语音或生成式 AI 应用的产品与研究人员
想学习模型量化、转换与推理加速的学生和爱好者

en.tag: Intel's open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning inference
en.what: OpenVINO is Intel's open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning inference, converting trained models to run fast on CPU, GPU, and NPU hardware. It covers computer vision, speech recognition, generative AI, and NLP, from edge to cloud.
en.content: The repo contains the core C++ inference engine, model conversion and optimization tools (Model Optimizer, NNCF quantization), multi-language bindings (Python/Node.js/C), samples, tutorials, and docs, plus companion repos like openvino.genai.
en.stack: Core in C++ with Python, Node.js, and C bindings; supports PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, Keras, PaddlePaddle, JAX/Flax, and Hugging Face models, installable via pip, conda, npm, and brew.
en.hot: As Intel's flagship inference deployment solution, OpenVINO keeps gaining traction amid rising edge AI and local LLM inference demand, adding 211 stars this month for 10,822 total and ranking 11th on GitHub's monthly C++ trending list.
uses: AI engineers deploying high-performance inference on Intel CPU/GPU/NPU
Developers optimizing and shipping PyTorch/TensorFlow models to edge devices
Product teams and researchers working on vision, speech, or generative AI apps
Students and hobbyists learning model quantization, conversion, and inference acceleration

zh.tag: 面向红队测试的多功能 ESP32 攻击固件
zh.what: Bruce 是一款基于 ESP32 的多功能固件，内置大量攻击性安全工具，目标是让红队行动快速且便携。它支持 M5Stack、LILYGO、RockBase IoT、Elecrow 等硬件，适配 Cardputer、Sticks、M5Cores、T-Decks 和 T-Embeds 等设备。
zh.content: 仓库包含固件源码、媒体素材与文档入口，功能覆盖 WiFi 攻击（Beacon Spam、Deauth、EvilPortal、Wardriving）、TelNet/SSH、RAW Sniffer 等，并配有官方 Wiki、FAQ 与 Web Flasher 安装方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，基于 ESP32/ESP32-S3 平台，依赖 esptool.py 烧录，并兼容 M5Launcher、m5burner 等安装工具。
zh.hot: 作为 Flipper Zero 风格的 ESP32 渗透固件，它已积累 6779 颗星，今日新增 6 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 第 9 名，说明硬件安全与红队工具社区热度持续。
uses: 红队与渗透测试人员，用于便携式无线安全评估
硬件安全爱好者与创客，折腾 ESP32 开发板与自制 DevKit
CTF 选手与安全教学场景，演示 WiFi/射频攻击原理
M5Stack、LILYGO 等设备用户，想扩展设备的安全测试能力

en.tag: A versatile offensive-security ESP32 firmware for Red Team operations
en.what: Bruce is a versatile ESP32 firmware packed with offensive-security tools, built to make Red Team operations fast and portable. It supports hardware from M5Stack, LILYGO, RockBase IoT and Elecrow, and works with Cardputer, Sticks, M5Cores, T-Decks and T-Embeds.
en.content: The repo contains firmware source, media assets and docs, with features spanning WiFi attacks (Beacon Spam, Deauth, EvilPortal, Wardriving), TelNet/SSH and RAW Sniffer, plus an official Wiki, FAQ and Web Flasher.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ for the ESP32/ESP32-S3 platform, flashed via esptool.py, and compatible with installers like M5Launcher and m5burner.
en.hot: As a Flipper Zero-style ESP32 pentest firmware, it has gathered 6,779 stars, added 6 today and ranked No.9 on GitHub Trending (C++), showing sustained interest in hardware security and Red Team tooling.
uses: Red teamers and pentesters needing portable wireless security assessments
Hardware security hobbyists and makers tinkering with ESP32 boards and custom DevKits
CTF players and security educators demonstrating WiFi/RF attack concepts
M5Stack, LILYGO and similar device owners extending their gear for security testing

zh.tag: Google 官方 C++ 测试与模拟框架
zh.what: GoogleTest 是 Google 的 C++ 测试框架，用于编写和运行单元测试。它支持自动测试发现、丰富的断言、死亡测试、参数化测试等，并集成了 GoogleMock 用于模拟对象。
zh.content: 仓库包含 GoogleTest 和 GoogleMock 的源码、文档、示例以及构建配置。文档托管在 GitHub Pages 上，提供用户指南和入门教程。
zh.stack: 基于 C++，要求 C++17 或更高版本（1.18.x 分支）。计划依赖 Abseil 库。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方测试框架，拥有近 3.9 万 Star，是 C++ 社区的事实标准，持续维护并发布新版本。
uses: C++ 开发者编写单元测试，确保代码质量
需要模拟对象进行依赖隔离的测试场景
在 CI/CD 流程中集成自动化测试
学习 xUnit 测试框架设计的最佳实践

en.tag: Google's official C++ testing and mocking framework
en.what: GoogleTest is Google's C++ testing framework for writing and running unit tests. It supports automatic test discovery, rich assertions, death tests, parameterized tests, and integrates GoogleMock for mocking.
en.content: The repository contains source code, documentation, examples, and build configuration for GoogleTest and GoogleMock. Docs are hosted on GitHub Pages with user guide and primer.
en.stack: Built on C++, requires C++17 or later (1.18.x branch). Plans to depend on Abseil.
en.hot: As Google's official testing framework, it has nearly 39k stars, is the de facto standard in C++ community, and is actively maintained with new releases.
uses: C++ developers writing unit tests to ensure code quality
Scenarios requiring mocking objects for dependency isolation
Integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Learning best practices of xUnit test framework design

zh.tag: 老牌开源 OCR 引擎，支持 100+ 语言的文字识别
zh.what: Tesseract 是一个开源光学字符识别（OCR）引擎，提供 libtesseract 库和 tesseract 命令行程序。Tesseract 4 引入基于 LSTM 神经网络的行识别引擎，同时保留 Tesseract 3 的传统字符模式识别模式（--oem 0）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OCR 引擎核心源码（C++）、命令行工具、训练工具与构建脚本，语言数据由配套的 tessdata 仓库单独提供。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 编写，依赖 Leptonica 图像处理库，使用 CMake/Autotools 构建，可选依赖 libcurl、ICU 等。
zh.hot: 作为 OCR 领域的经典项目，它积累了 76,574 颗星，今日仍新增 16 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 11 名，说明其长期刚需地位。
uses: 需要批量把扫描件、截图转成可搜索文本的开发者与运维人员
为文档数字化、票据识别等产品寻找免费 OCR 引擎的团队
想用 Python/Java 等语言绑定 Tesseract 做图像文字提取的工程师
研究传统 OCR 与 LSTM 识别方案对比的学生和研究人员

en.tag: The veteran open-source OCR engine supporting 100+ languages
en.what: Tesseract is an open-source Optical Character Recognition (OCR) engine, shipping the libtesseract library and the tesseract command-line program. Tesseract 4 adds an LSTM neural-net based line recognition engine while still supporting the legacy Tesseract 3 character-pattern engine via --oem 0.
en.content: The repo holds the C++ OCR engine core, the CLI tool, training utilities and build scripts, while language data lives in the companion tessdata repositories.
en.stack: Written in C++, it depends on the Leptonica image library, builds with CMake/Autotools, and optionally links libcurl, ICU and more.
en.hot: A classic in OCR, it has accumulated 76,574 stars and still gained 16 today, ranking 11th on the C++ daily trending list — proof of its enduring demand.
uses: Developers and ops staff who need to batch-convert scans or screenshots into searchable text
Teams looking for a free OCR engine for document digitization or receipt recognition
Engineers using Python/Java bindings to extract text from images with Tesseract
Students and researchers comparing legacy OCR with LSTM-based recognition

zh.tag: 开源自托管 VPN 客户端，一键在自己服务器上部署 VPN
zh.what: Amnezia 是一款开源 VPN 客户端，核心特色是让用户在自己的服务器上快速搭建专属 VPN。只需输入 IP、SSH 登录名和密码，它就会自动安装 VPN Docker 容器并完成连接。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面端与移动端客户端源码（C++/Qt 为主），以及协议插件、构建脚本、多语言 README 和发布配置。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 和 Qt 构建跨平台客户端，集成 OpenVPN、WireGuard、IKEv2、Cloak、Shadowsocks、AmneziaWG、XRay 等协议，并通过 Docker 在服务器端部署。
zh.hot: 凭借“自建 VPN + 流量混淆”的实用定位，已积累约 1.5 万 star，今日再登 C++ 日榜第 12 名，持续吸引关注隐私与翻墙需求的用户。
uses: 希望自建 VPN、掌控服务器与数据的隐私敏感用户
需要流量混淆以应对网络审查的跨境用户
想研究 VPN 协议与客户端实现的 C++/Qt 开发者
为团队或家庭搭建私有安全网络的技术运维人员

en.tag: Open-source self-hosted VPN client that deploys a VPN server on your own machine
en.what: Amnezia is an open-source VPN client whose key feature is letting you deploy your own VPN server on your own machine. Just enter your IP address, SSH login and password, and it automatically installs VPN Docker containers and connects.
en.content: The repo contains desktop and mobile client source code (mainly C++/Qt), plus protocol plugins, build scripts, multilingual READMEs and release configuration.
en.stack: Built with C++ and Qt for cross-platform clients, integrating OpenVPN, WireGuard, IKEv2, Cloak, Shadowsocks, AmneziaWG and XRay, with server-side deployment via Docker.
en.hot: With its practical 'self-hosted VPN + traffic obfuscation' positioning, it has gathered ~15k stars and ranks 12th on today's C++ trending list, drawing users focused on privacy and censorship circumvention.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want to self-host a VPN and control their own server and data
Cross-border users needing traffic obfuscation to deal with censorship
C++/Qt developers studying VPN protocols and client implementations
Tech ops building private secure networks for teams or families

zh.tag: 进程内分析型 SQL 数据库，极速查询 CSV/Parquet
zh.what: DuckDB 是一个高性能的分析型数据库系统，设计为快速、可靠、可移植且易于使用。它支持丰富的 SQL 方言，包括复杂子查询、窗口函数、复杂类型等，并可直接查询 CSV 和 Parquet 文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 DuckDB 的完整源代码、文档、扩展机制以及多种客户端（Python、R、Java、Wasm 等）的集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++17 编写，依赖 CMake 构建系统，支持 Python 3 等开发环境。
zh.hot: 作为进程内分析数据库的标杆，DuckDB 凭借其极简部署和高性能查询，在数据科学领域迅速走红，star 数已突破 4 万，今日新增 69 个。
uses: 数据科学家和分析师，希望在 Python 或 R 环境中快速分析大型数据集，无需单独部署数据库服务器。
数据工程师，需要将 CSV/Parquet 文件直接作为 SQL 查询源，简化数据管道。
应用开发者，希望嵌入分析能力到现有应用中，提供轻量级 OLAP 功能。

en.tag: In-process analytical SQL database, blazing fast queries on CSV/Parquet
en.what: DuckDB is a high-performance analytical database system designed to be fast, reliable, portable, and easy to use. It supports a rich SQL dialect including complex subqueries, window functions, complex types, and can directly query CSV and Parquet files.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, extension mechanisms, and integrations for multiple clients (Python, R, Java, Wasm, etc.).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++17, built with CMake, and supports Python 3 for development.
en.hot: As a benchmark for in-process analytical databases, DuckDB has gained rapid popularity in data science due to its minimal deployment and high-performance queries, with over 40k stars and 69 new today.
uses: Data scientists and analysts who want to quickly analyze large datasets in Python or R without deploying a separate database server.
Data engineers who need to query CSV/Parquet files directly as SQL sources to simplify data pipelines.
Application developers who want to embed analytical capabilities into existing applications for lightweight OLAP functionality.

zh.tag: AMD ROCm 系统级项目的超级仓库，统一开发与 CI
zh.what: 这是 AMD ROCm 系统项目的超级仓库，把原本分散的多个 ROCm 底层系统项目合并到一个仓库中，以简化开发、CI 和集成流程。首批整合的项目聚焦于构建 PyTorch 所需的底层组件。
zh.content: 仓库以子目录形式收纳了 amdsmi、hip、clr、rocprofiler、rocm-smi-lib、rocdecode、rocjpeg 等众多 ROCm 系统组件，并在 README 中用表格标注各项目的迁移状态与 CI 健康度。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主，围绕 HIP、ROCm 运行时与底层驱动接口构建，依赖 CMake 等构建系统及 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 作为 AMD 官方整合 ROCm 生态的关键动作，它登上 GitHub C++ 日榜第 14 名；虽然仅 507 star，但代表了 AI 算力底层基础设施的重要走向。
uses: AMD GPU 与 ROCm 平台的底层开发者，需要跟踪 HIP、驱动与性能分析组件
希望从源码构建 PyTorch 等 AI 框架的工程师，关注 ROCm 系统依赖
负责 ROCm 相关 CI/CD 与集成测试的运维或平台团队
研究 GPU 计算栈与开源硬件生态的技术观察者

en.tag: Super-repo consolidating AMD ROCm systems projects for unified dev and CI
en.what: This is the ROCm Systems super-repo, consolidating multiple ROCm systems projects into a single repository to streamline development, CI, and integration. The first batch of projects focuses on the requirements for building PyTorch.
en.content: It hosts numerous ROCm system components as subdirectories, including amdsmi, hip, clr, rocprofiler, rocm-smi-lib, rocdecode, and rocjpeg, with a README table tracking each project's migration status and CI health.
en.stack: Primarily C++, built around HIP, the ROCm runtime, and low-level driver interfaces, using CMake and GitHub Actions for continuous integration.
en.hot: As AMD's key move to consolidate the ROCm ecosystem, it ranks 14th on GitHub's daily C++ trending list; with only 507 stars, it still signals a major direction in AI compute infrastructure.
uses: Low-level developers on AMD GPU and ROCm platforms tracking HIP, drivers, and profiling components
Engineers building PyTorch and other AI frameworks from source who care about ROCm system dependencies
DevOps or platform teams handling ROCm-related CI/CD and integration testing
Technical observers studying GPU compute stacks and open hardware ecosystems

zh.tag: 强大易用的开源跨平台截图工具
zh.what: Flameshot 是一款开源截图软件，支持截图后直接在图上标注、画箭头、打码、加文字等操作。它跨 Linux、Windows、macOS 平台，可通过命令行或快捷键快速调用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++/Qt 编写的桌面应用源码、图标与预览资源、多语言翻译文件，以及各平台打包脚本和 CI 工作流。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 与 Qt 框架开发，使用 CMake 构建，依赖各平台原生截图与窗口系统（X11/Wayland 等）。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源截图工具，它已积累超 3 万 star，本月新增 267，稳居 C++ 月榜第 23 名，持续受 Linux 用户青睐。
uses: Linux 桌面用户，需要比系统自带截图更强大的标注功能
经常写文档、做教程或提 issue，需要快速截图并标注
开发者与运维，习惯用命令行或快捷键触发截图
追求开源、免费、跨平台工具的效率爱好者

en.tag: Powerful yet simple open-source cross-platform screenshot tool
en.what: Flameshot is an open-source screenshot tool that lets you annotate captures directly with arrows, text, blur and more. It runs on Linux, Windows and macOS, and can be triggered via CLI or keyboard shortcuts.
en.content: The repo contains the C++/Qt desktop app source, icons and preview assets, translation files, plus packaging scripts and CI workflows for each platform.
en.stack: Built with C++ and the Qt framework, using CMake, and relying on native platform capture and window systems (X11/Wayland, etc.).
en.hot: As a veteran open-source screenshot tool, it has over 30k stars, adding 267 this month and ranking 23rd on the C++ monthly chart, staying popular among Linux users.
uses: Linux desktop users who need richer annotation than built-in tools
People writing docs, tutorials or issues who need quick annotated screenshots
Developers and ops who prefer CLI or shortcut-triggered capture
Efficiency fans who want a free, open-source, cross-platform tool

zh.tag: 任天堂 Switch 定制固件，实现自定义系统与虚拟 NAND
zh.what: Atmosphère 是一个针对任天堂 Switch 的开源定制固件项目，通过替换和修改系统各个组件（如引导加载器、TrustZone、系统模块等）来实现自定义功能。它允许用户运行自制软件、备份和虚拟化 NAND 等。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个组件：Fusée（第一阶段加载器）、Exosphère（自定义 TrustZone）、Thermosphère（emuNAND 支持）、Stratosphère（自定义系统模块）、Troposphère（应用程序级补丁），以及相关文档和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 libnx、devkitA64 工具链、FatFs、hekate 等开源项目。
zh.hot: 作为 Switch 破解社区的核心项目，Atmosphère 拥有近 2 万星标，今日新增 13 星，位列 C++ 日榜第二，持续受到关注。
uses: Switch 破解玩家：用于运行自制软件和备份游戏
安全研究人员：研究 Switch 系统安全与漏洞
自制软件开发者：基于 Atmosphère 开发自定义模块

en.tag: Custom firmware for Nintendo Switch enabling custom OS and emuNAND
en.what: Atmosphère is an open-source custom firmware for the Nintendo Switch that replaces and modifies various system components (such as bootloader, TrustZone, sysmodules) to enable custom features. It allows users to run homebrew, backup and virtualize NAND, and more.
en.content: The repository contains multiple components: Fusée (first-stage loader), Exosphère (custom TrustZone), Thermosphère (emuNAND support), Stratosphère (custom sysmodules), Troposphère (application-level patches), along with documentation and build scripts.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on libnx, devkitA64 toolchain, FatFs, hekate, and other open-source projects.
en.hot: As a core project in the Switch hacking community, Atmosphère has nearly 20k stars, with 13 added today, ranking second on the C++ daily trending list, showing sustained interest.
uses: Switch hacking enthusiasts: to run homebrew and backup games
Security researchers: to study Switch system security and vulnerabilities
Homebrew developers: to build custom modules based on Atmosphère

zh.tag: 实验性 C++ 继任者语言的主仓库
zh.what: Carbon 是一门实验性的编程语言，目标是成为 C++ 的继任者，在保持与现有 C++ 代码互操作、性能相当的前提下，提供更现代的语言基础。仓库承载语言的设计文档、规范、编译器实现与相关工具。
zh.content: 包含设计文档（docs/）、语言规范、编译器与工具链实现（以 C++ 编写）、示例代码与构建脚本，以及治理与路线图等资料。
zh.stack: 主要用 C++ 实现，基于 LLVM 进行代码生成，并配套 Bazel 等构建系统与自有包管理/工具链规划。
zh.hot: 作为备受关注的 C++ 继任者实验项目，它已积累约 3.4 万 star，今日仍登上 GitHub C++ 日榜第 17 名，说明社区对 C++ 演进方向的持续兴趣。
uses: 关注 C++ 演进与语言设计的开发者，可阅读设计文档并参与讨论
希望提前了解下一代系统编程语言的研究者与爱好者
愿意为开源编译器与语言工具链贡献代码的 C++ 工程师

en.tag: Main repo for Carbon, an experimental successor to C++
en.what: Carbon is an experimental programming language aiming to be a successor to C++, offering modern language foundations while interoperating with existing C++ code and matching its performance. This repository hosts its design docs, specification, compiler implementation, and related tooling.
en.content: It contains design documents (docs/), the language specification, the compiler and toolchain implementation (written in C++), example code and build scripts, plus governance and roadmap materials.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++ with LLVM for code generation, alongside build tooling such as Bazel and plans for its own package manager and toolchain.
en.hot: As a closely watched experimental successor to C++, it has gathered about 33.9k stars and still ranks 17th on GitHub's daily C++ trending list, reflecting sustained community interest in C++'s evolution.
uses: Developers interested in C++ evolution and language design who want to read the docs and join discussions
Researchers and enthusiasts wanting an early look at a next-generation systems language
C++ engineers willing to contribute code to an open-source compiler and toolchain

zh.tag: 谷歌开源的端到端机器学习框架，人人可用
zh.what: TensorFlow 是谷歌大脑团队开源的端到端机器学习平台，覆盖从研究到生产部署的全流程。它提供稳定的 Python 与 C++ API，并配套丰富的工具、库与社区资源，让研究者推进 SOTA、开发者快速构建并上线 ML 应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心框架源码（C++/Python）、Keras 高层 API、各语言绑定、构建脚本与测试，以及大量官方文档与示例。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 实现核心计算引擎，Python 为主要前端，依赖 Bazel 构建，支持 GPU/TPU 加速与 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 作为 ML 领域最老牌、生态最完整的框架之一，它已积累超 20 万 star，今日再登 C++ 日榜第 18 名，长期热度不减。
uses: 机器学习研究者，用于复现与推进前沿模型
需要将模型部署到生产环境的工程团队
学习深度学习的学生与入门开发者
在移动端、浏览器或云端落地 ML 应用的开发者

en.tag: Google's end-to-end open source machine learning framework for everyone
en.what: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open source machine learning platform originally built by Google Brain, covering everything from research to production deployment. It offers stable Python and C++ APIs plus a broad ecosystem of tools, libraries and community resources for pushing state-of-the-art ML and shipping ML-powered apps.
en.content: The repo holds the core framework source (C++/Python), the Keras high-level API, language bindings, build scripts and tests, plus extensive official docs and examples.
en.stack: Core compute engine written in C++ with Python as the primary frontend, built via Bazel, with GPU/TPU acceleration and Docker deployment support.
en.hot: As one of the oldest and most complete ML frameworks, it has accumulated over 200k stars and still charts at #18 on today's C++ trending list, showing enduring popularity.
uses: ML researchers reproducing and advancing state-of-the-art models
Engineering teams deploying models to production
Students and beginners learning deep learning
Developers shipping ML apps on mobile, browser or cloud

zh.tag: 浏览器里的实时全球态势感知模拟器
zh.what: 这是一个在浏览器中运行的间谍卫星模拟器，但数据是真实的。它在一个逼真的3D地球上实时展示飞机、船舶、卫星、地震、交通和公共摄像头等公开信号，并支持语音控制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的Web应用源码，包括3D地球渲染、实时数据图层、语音控制AI代理、以及清晰的标注（如模拟与实时区分）。
zh.stack: 主要使用JavaScript，可能涉及Three.js或类似3D库、WebSocket实时数据、语音识别API等。
zh.hot: 该项目在GitHub Trending日榜排名第一，今日新增近2000星，因其独特的'真实数据间谍卫星'概念和病毒式传播的YouTube系列而迅速走红。
uses: 对开源情报、地理空间数据可视化感兴趣的开发者或研究者。
希望体验实时全球动态（航班、船舶、卫星等）的科技爱好者。
教育场景中用于演示实时数据源和3D可视化技术。

en.tag: A real-time global situational awareness simulator in your browser
en.what: A spy-satellite simulator in your browser with real data. It visualizes live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic, and public cameras on a photorealistic 3D globe, with hands-free voice control.
en.content: The repo contains the full web app source code, including 3D globe rendering, live data layers, a voice-controlled AI agent, and clear labeling of simulated vs. live feeds.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, likely using Three.js or similar 3D libraries, WebSocket for real-time data, and speech recognition APIs.
en.hot: Ranked #1 on GitHub Trending daily with ~2,000 stars added today, it went viral due to its unique 'real-data spy satellite' concept and the popular YouTube series behind it.
uses: Developers or researchers interested in open-source intelligence and geospatial data visualization.
Tech enthusiasts who want to experience real-time global dynamics (flights, ships, satellites, etc.).
Educational settings for demonstrating real-time data sources and 3D visualization techniques.

zh.tag: 让编程 Agent 先给答案、别绕弯子的输出规范技能
zh.what: 这是一个给编程助手（coding agent）用的输出风格技能，强制它先给行动、再给解释，用编号步骤代替长篇铺垫。它不改变模型能力，只改变回答的组织方式，让结果像给 ADHD 用户看的一样直接。
zh.content: 仓库核心是 skills/i-have-adhd/SKILL.md 里的 10 条规则，外加 INSTALL.md 安装说明、AGENTS.md 给 agent 的指引，以及多语言 README 和 logo。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主语言，本质是 Markdown 技能文件，通过 Claude 插件市场（claude plugin marketplace）安装，可 fork 后自行改规则。
zh.hot: 它精准戳中「AI 回答又长又绕」的痛点，用极简规则给出可感知的前后对比，今日新增 4650 star、总数 34632，直接冲上 GitHub 日榜第一。
uses: 每天被 AI 长回复淹没、只想快速拿到下一步操作的开发者
用 Claude 等 coding agent 写代码、希望输出更紧凑的团队
想自定义 agent 输出规范、愿意 fork 改 SKILL.md 的进阶用户

en.tag: A skill that stops your coding agent from burying the answer
en.what: It's an output-style skill for coding agents that forces action-first answers with numbered steps instead of long preambles. It doesn't change model capability, only how responses are organized, making them ADHD-friendly and to the point.
en.content: The core is a 10-rule SKILL.md under skills/i-have-adhd/, plus INSTALL.md, an AGENTS.md for agents, multilingual READMEs, and a logo.
en.stack: Python is the listed language, but it's essentially a Markdown skill file installed via the Claude plugin marketplace and forkable for custom rules.
en.hot: It nails the pain of bloated AI answers with a simple rule set and a clear before/after demo, gaining 4,650 stars today to 34,632 total and hitting #1 on GitHub Trending.
uses: Developers drowning in long AI replies who just want the next action
Teams using coding agents like Claude who want tighter, more actionable output
Advanced users who want to fork and customize the SKILL.md rules

zh.tag: AI 编码代理的上下文优化层，削减 98% 工具输出
zh.what: Context Mode 是专为 AI 编码代理设计的上下文窗口优化工具。它通过沙箱化工具输出（减少 98% 的 token 占用）、持久化会话记忆，并借助 MCP 和 hooks 在 17 个平台间强制路由，从而解决 AI 编程中的“上下文另一半”问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 核心库、MCP 服务器、编辑器/平台扩展（如 VS Code、JetBrains）、CLI 工具、hooks 示例及文档。提供 npm 包、GitHub Marketplace 集成，并附带统计徽章与使用指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，依赖 MCP（Model Context Protocol）与平台 hooks，支持 npm 分发与 GitHub Marketplace 安装。
zh.hot: GitHub 星标超 2 万，今日新增 35，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 6。因解决 AI 编码代理的上下文溢出痛点，且被 Microsoft、Google 等大厂团队采用，并登上 Hacker News 榜首。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程工具的开发者，希望减少上下文浪费、提升长任务稳定性。
团队需要跨平台统一管理 AI 代理的上下文与记忆，适用于多 IDE 或 CI 环境。
对 MCP 生态感兴趣，想通过 hooks 定制工具输出过滤与路由的进阶用户。

en.tag: Context optimization layer for AI coding agents, cutting tool output by 98%
en.what: Context Mode is a context window optimization tool for AI coding agents. It sandboxes tool output (98% token reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP and hooks, addressing the 'other half' of the context problem in AI coding.
en.content: The repo contains a TypeScript core library, MCP server, editor/platform extensions (VS Code, JetBrains, etc.), CLI tools, hooks examples, and docs. Includes npm package, GitHub Marketplace integration, with stats badges and usage guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, relies on MCP (Model Context Protocol) and platform hooks, distributed via npm and GitHub Marketplace.
en.hot: With 20k+ stars and +35 today, ranking #6 on TypeScript daily trending. It solves context overflow for AI coding agents, adopted by teams at Microsoft, Google, etc., and hit #1 on Hacker News.
uses: Developers using AI coding tools like Claude Code or Cursor who want to reduce context waste and improve long-task stability.
Teams needing unified context and memory management across platforms, suitable for multi-IDE or CI environments.
Advanced users interested in MCP ecosystem, wanting to customize tool output filtering and routing via hooks.

zh.tag: 面向并行 AI 代理工作流的 Git worktree 管理 CLI
zh.what: Worktrunk 是一个用 Rust 编写的命令行工具，用于管理 Git worktree，让开发者可以在同一仓库中并行维护多个工作目录。它专为并行 AI 代理工作流设计，使多个代理或任务能各自在独立工作区中同时运行而不互相干扰。
zh.content: 仓库以 Rust 源码为主体，包含 CLI 命令实现、文档站点（worktrunk.dev）与 CI/Codecov 配置，并提供 crate 发布形态。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，通过 Cargo/crates.io 分发，采用 MIT 或 Apache-2.0 双许可，并配有 GitHub Actions CI 与 Codecov 覆盖率检测。
zh.hot: 项目已获得约 6984 颗星，今日新增 44 星并登上 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 18 名，说明在 AI 代理并行开发这一热点方向上需求旺盛。
uses: 需要同时运行多个 AI 编码代理的开发者，用独立 worktree 隔离各自任务
在本地并行开发多个分支或功能、频繁切换上下文的工程师
希望用 CLI 简化 Git worktree 创建、切换与清理流程的团队
构建代理编排或自动化流水线、需要可靠工作区管理的工具作者

en.tag: A CLI for Git worktree management, built for parallel AI agent workflows
en.what: Worktrunk is a Rust-based CLI for managing Git worktrees, letting developers keep multiple working directories of the same repository in parallel. It is designed for parallel AI agent workflows, so multiple agents or tasks can run simultaneously in isolated workspaces without stepping on each other.
en.content: The repo centers on Rust source code implementing the CLI, alongside documentation at worktrunk.dev plus CI and Codecov configuration, and is published as a crate.
en.stack: Written in Rust and distributed via Cargo/crates.io under a dual MIT OR Apache-2.0 license, with GitHub Actions CI and Codecov coverage checks.
en.hot: With roughly 6,984 stars, +44 today, and a No. 18 spot on GitHub Trending's daily Rust list, it rides strong demand in the hot area of parallel AI agent development.
uses: Developers running multiple AI coding agents at once, isolating each task in its own worktree
Engineers developing several branches or features in parallel and switching contexts frequently
Teams wanting a CLI to simplify creating, switching, and cleaning up Git worktrees
Tool authors building agent orchestration or automation pipelines that need reliable workspace management

zh.tag: AI 文本去味剂，让机器写作更自然
zh.what: 一个便携的代理技能，用于去除文本中 AI 写作的痕迹，使其听起来更自然、更像人类。它基于维基百科的“AI 写作迹象”指南，并包含二次润色和防幻觉机制。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 SKILL.md 文件，可通过 skills CLI 或手动安装到任何支持技能指令的代理框架中。支持全局或项目级安装，并可作为 Claude Code 插件使用。
zh.stack: 纯 Markdown 技能文件，无外部依赖，可在任何支持技能指令的代理框架中运行。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1504 星，总星数 31573，排名 Python 周榜第 16。因其解决了 AI 写作“一眼假”的痛点，且安装使用极其简单，受到开发者社区追捧。
uses: 内容创作者 —— 将 AI 草稿润色为自然的人类风格，避免被检测
开发者 —— 集成到代理工作流中，自动优化 AI 生成的文本输出
学术写作者 —— 确保论文或报告中的 AI 辅助内容更符合人类写作习惯

en.tag: Remove AI-generated writing signs, make text sound human
en.what: A portable agent skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text, making it sound more natural and human. It is based on Wikipedia's 'Signs of AI writing' guide and includes a second rewrite pass with hallucination prevention.
en.content: The repo contains a single SKILL.md file that can be installed via skills CLI or manually into any agent harness supporting skill-style instructions. Supports global or project-local install and can be used as a Claude Code plugin.
en.stack: Plain Markdown skill file with no external dependencies, runs in any harness that supports skill-style instructions.
en.hot: Gained 1504 stars this week, total 31573, ranked #16 on Python weekly trending. It addresses the pain point of AI-generated text being easily detectable, and is extremely easy to install and use.
uses: Content creators — polish AI drafts into natural human style to avoid detection
Developers — integrate into agent workflows to automatically optimize AI-generated text output
Academic writers — ensure AI-assisted content in papers or reports reads more naturally

zh.tag: 本地优先的开源智能家居自动化平台
zh.what: Home Assistant 是一个开源家庭自动化平台，把本地控制和隐私放在首位，让用户在自己的服务器或树莓派上统一接入并联动各类智能设备。它由全球 DIY 爱好者社区驱动，通过模块化集成支持成千上万种设备与动作。
zh.content: 仓库是 Home Assistant 的核心代码库，包含平台内核、集成组件（integrations）、自动化引擎与前端资源等模块化目录。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，采用模块化架构以便轻松扩展新设备或动作，可运行在树莓派或本地服务器上。
zh.hot: 作为智能家居领域最知名的开源项目之一，它已积累超过 9 万 star，本周新增 228 星并登上 Python 周榜第 18 名，社区活跃度持续走高。
uses: 智能家居爱好者：想用本地服务器统一控制家中各类设备
隐私敏感用户：不愿把家庭数据交给云端厂商
DIY 与开发者：希望编写自定义集成或自动化组件
树莓派/家庭服务器玩家：寻找可长期自托管的自动化中枢

en.tag: Open-source, local-first home automation platform
en.what: Home Assistant is an open-source home automation platform that puts local control and privacy first, letting users unify and automate smart devices on their own server or Raspberry Pi. Driven by a worldwide DIY community, it supports thousands of devices and actions through modular integrations.
en.content: The repo is the core codebase of Home Assistant, containing the platform core, integration components, the automation engine, and frontend assets in a modular layout.
en.stack: Built mainly in Python with a modular architecture that makes adding new devices or actions easy, and it runs on a Raspberry Pi or local server.
en.hot: As one of the best-known open-source smart home projects, it has over 90k stars, gained 228 this week, and ranked 18th on the Python weekly trending list, showing sustained community momentum.
uses: Smart home enthusiasts who want to unify devices on a local server
Privacy-conscious users who avoid handing home data to cloud vendors
DIYers and developers building custom integrations or automation components
Raspberry Pi / home server owners seeking a long-term self-hosted hub

zh.tag: 微软出品的文件转 Markdown 工具，为 LLM 喂料而生
zh.what: MarkItDown 是一个轻量级 Python 工具，能把 PDF、Office 文档、图片、音频、HTML、ZIP、YouTube 链接等多种格式统一转换成 Markdown。它重点保留标题、列表、表格、链接等文档结构，输出主要面向 LLM 与文本分析管线，而非高保真的人用排版。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 包形式组织，核心是 markitdown 包及其各类格式转换器，另含 CLI 入口、可选依赖分组（如 [all]）与安全注意事项文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10+，通过 pip 安装，支持 uv/venv/conda 环境，按需引入 PDF、OCR、语音转写等可选依赖。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方项目，它精准踩中 LLM 数据预处理刚需，已积累约 18.2 万 star，本周再增 4579 并登上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 16 名。
uses: 需要把大量异构文档转成 Markdown 再喂给 LLM 的 RAG 与数据工程开发者
想快速把 PDF、Word、PPT 转成纯文本做检索或摘要的研究与内容团队
在命令行或脚本里批量处理 Office 文档、图片 OCR、音频转写的自动化用户

en.tag: Microsoft's file-to-Markdown converter built to feed LLMs
en.what: MarkItDown is a lightweight Python utility that converts PDFs, Office documents, images, audio, HTML, ZIP files, YouTube URLs and more into Markdown. It focuses on preserving document structure like headings, lists, tables and links, targeting LLM and text-analysis pipelines rather than high-fidelity human-facing output.
en.content: The repo is organized as a Python package, with the core markitdown package and per-format converters, plus a CLI entry point, optional dependency groups (e.g. [all]) and security documentation.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10+, installed via pip, compatible with uv/venv/conda, and pulls in optional dependencies for PDF, OCR and speech transcription as needed.
en.hot: As an official Microsoft project, it hits the sweet spot of LLM data preprocessing, racking up about 182k stars, adding 4,579 this week and ranking 16th on GitHub Trending's weekly chart.
uses: RAG and data engineers who need to turn heterogeneous documents into Markdown for LLMs
Research and content teams wanting to convert PDFs, Word and PPT into plain text for search or summarization
Automation users batch-processing Office docs, image OCR and audio transcription from CLI or scripts

zh.tag: 面向多任务并行的 AI 代理编排发行版，一个主代理指挥一队编码代理
zh.what: firstmate 让你只与一个「大副」代理对话，由它自动派生并监督多个自主编码代理，每个代理在独立的 git worktree 中并行处理修复、调研、规划、审计等任务。任务完成后，它会交付可直接合并的 PR、本地合并结果或独立调研报告，免去你手动切换标签页和复制上下文的麻烦。
zh.content: 仓库本身就是一个「代理发行版」：包含 AGENTS.md 指令、内置的 firstmate 技能集和辅助脚本，任何终端编码代理都能按这些约定运行。没有需要安装的应用，克隆下来的目录即是发行版。
zh.stack: 以 Shell 为主，依赖 tmux、Herdr、zellij、cmux 或 Orca 等可见会话后端，并借助 treehouse 管理 git worktree；支持 macOS 与 Linux。
zh.hot: 它切中了多代理并行时「标签页地狱」的痛点，用「一个联络人 + 可见船员」的模型给出清晰解法，本周新增 873 star、总计 6201，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 12 名。
uses: 需要同时推进多个编码任务、又不想手动管理多个代理会话的开发者
希望让代理在隔离的 git worktree 中并行工作、避免仓库冲突的工程团队
想用自然语言指挥一队代理完成修复、调研、审计并直接拿到 PR 的个人开发者
需要跨本机或 SSH 主机扩展代理舰队规模的高级用户

en.tag: An agent distro that lets one lead agent orchestrate a crew of coding agents
en.what: firstmate lets you talk to a single 'first mate' agent that spawns and supervises a crew of autonomous coding agents, each working in its own clean git worktree on parallel tasks like fixes, investigations, plans, and audits. It hands back finished PRs, approved local merges, or standalone investigation reports, removing the need to juggle tabs and copy context between repos.
en.content: The repo itself is the 'agent distro': it bundles AGENTS.md instructions, firstmate skills, and helper scripts that any terminal coding agent can follow. There is no app to install—the cloned directory is the distro.
en.stack: Primarily Shell, relying on visible session backends like tmux, Herdr, zellij, cmux, or Orca, plus treehouse for git worktree management; supports macOS and Linux.
en.hot: It tackles the 'tab-juggling hell' of running multiple agents in parallel with a clear 'one liaison, visible crew' model, gaining 873 stars this week for a total of 6,201 and ranking #12 on GitHub Trending weekly.
uses: Developers who need to push multiple coding tasks in parallel without manually babysitting agent sessions
Engineering teams wanting agents to work in isolated git worktrees to avoid repo collisions
Solo developers who want to command a crew of agents via natural language and receive finished PRs
Advanced users who need to scale agent fleets across local machines or SSH-reachable hosts

zh.tag: 一条 CLI 给 AI Agent 装上全网读取与搜索能力
zh.what: Agent Reach 是一个 Python 命令行工具，让 AI Agent 无需申请各家 API key 就能读取和搜索 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书等平台内容。它替用户选好并维护当下最稳定的接入方式，把多平台数据获取统一到一条命令里。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 包形式提供 CLI 入口，配套 docs 目录含中英日韩多语言 README、赞助商素材与设计理念说明，并附 Trendshift、Star History 徽章。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10+，MIT 许可，采用 CLI 形态封装各平台抓取与搜索逻辑，依赖较轻、开箱即用。
zh.hot: 上线即冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 6，累计 81255 star、今日新增 651，说明「零 API 费用 + 多平台统一接入」正好击中 Agent 开发者的数据获取痛点。
uses: 做 AI Agent 的开发者，需要给 Agent 补上实时互联网数据源
想低成本抓取社交平台内容做分析或舆情监控的团队
需要跨 Twitter/Reddit/YouTube/B站/小红书统一检索的研究者
不想维护各家 API key 与频繁更换接入方式的个人开发者

en.tag: One CLI that gives AI agents internet-wide reading and search
en.what: Agent Reach is a Python CLI that lets AI agents read and search content across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili and XiaoHongShu without paying for each platform's API. It picks and maintains the currently most reliable access method so users don't have to keep up with changing interfaces.
en.content: The repo ships a Python package with a CLI entry point, plus a docs folder containing multilingual READMEs (EN/JA/KO), sponsor assets and design notes, along with Trendshift and Star History badges.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10+ under the MIT license, it wraps per-platform scraping and search logic into a lightweight, ready-to-run CLI.
en.hot: It hit #6 on GitHub Trending with 81,255 stars and 651 added today, showing that zero-API-fee, unified multi-platform access hits a real pain point for agent builders.
uses: AI agent developers who need to feed their agents live internet data
Teams doing social content analysis or sentiment monitoring on a budget
Researchers who need unified search across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, Bilibili and XiaoHongShu
Solo developers tired of managing API keys and chasing changing access methods

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的 HTML 转视频渲染框架
zh.what: HyperFrames 是一个开源框架，可将 HTML、CSS、媒体和可定位动画转换为确定性的 MP4 视频。它支持本地 CLI 使用，也可作为 AI 编码代理的技能，或作为托管创作流程的渲染核心。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码、CLI 工具、技能包（SKILL.md）、文档、示例和展示页面。核心是让代理通过编写 HTML 来生成视频，并支持可定位动画。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，要求 Node.js >= 22，通过 npm 分发，并集成了 AI 代理技能系统（如 Claude 和 Agents skills）。
zh.hot: 凭借 4.4 万+ Star 和每日新增 220 的热度，它精准切中 AI 代理自动生成视频的需求，将 HTML 编写与视频渲染无缝结合，成为 GitHub Trending 上的明星项目。
uses: AI 代理开发者：希望让代理自动生成视频内容，如产品介绍、教程等。
视频创作者：通过编写 HTML 快速生成可定制、确定性的视频，无需传统编辑软件。
自动化工作流：在 CI/CD 或内容管道中集成视频渲染，实现批量生成。
前端开发者：利用熟悉的 HTML/CSS 技能创建动画和视频效果。

en.tag: Open-source framework turning HTML/CSS into deterministic MP4 videos, built for AI agents
en.what: HyperFrames is an open-source framework that converts HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos. It can be used locally via CLI, as skills for AI coding agents, or as the rendering core behind hosted authoring workflows.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, CLI tools, skill packages (SKILL.md), documentation, examples, and showcase pages. The core enables agents to generate videos by writing HTML, with support for seekable animations.
en.stack: Primarily developed in TypeScript, requires Node.js >= 22, distributed via npm, and integrates AI agent skill systems (e.g., Claude and Agents skills).
en.hot: With over 44k stars and 220 daily additions, it precisely meets the demand for AI-agent-driven video generation, seamlessly combining HTML authoring with video rendering, making it a star on GitHub Trending.
uses: AI agent developers: enable agents to automatically generate video content like product intros or tutorials.
Video creators: quickly produce customizable, deterministic videos by writing HTML, without traditional editing software.
Automation workflows: integrate video rendering into CI/CD or content pipelines for batch generation.
Frontend developers: leverage familiar HTML/CSS skills to create animations and video effects.

zh.tag: 并行多智能体编排的桌面级 ADE，自带订阅即可跑任意编码代理
zh.what: Orca 是一个面向编码代理的 ADE（Agent Development Environment），让你把 Codex、ClaudeCode、OpenCode、Pi 等代理并排运行，每个代理跑在独立的 git worktree 里并统一追踪。它支持桌面端、移动端伴侣 App 与远程运行时，用你自己的订阅即可驱动任意编码代理。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 编写的桌面应用为主体，包含 resources 图标与构建资源、docs 多语言 README（中/日/韩/西/法/葡）与功能演示 GIF、移动端伴侣 App（iOS/TestFlight/Android APK）以及远程运行时相关代码。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，基于 Electron 风格的跨平台桌面应用（macOS/Windows/Linux），配套 iOS/Android 移动端与远程运行时，MIT 许可，依赖各编码代理 CLI 与 git worktree 机制。
zh.hot: 本周新增 5362 star、总量约 6.95 万，冲上 GitHub Trending 周榜 TypeScript 第 14 名；多代理并行编排正是当下最热的开发范式，而 Orca 让用户用自己的订阅跑多个代理，切中成本与效率痛点。
uses: 同时使用多个编码代理、需要并行对比结果的开发者
希望用自有订阅而非额外付费来驱动代理的个人与团队
需要在手机上监控和跟进代理进度、随时发指令的工程师
想用 git worktree 隔离实验、再择优合并的工程团队

en.tag: A desktop ADE for orchestrating a fleet of parallel coding agents on your own subscription
en.what: Orca is an Agent Development Environment for running a fleet of coding agents in parallel. It runs Codex, ClaudeCode, OpenCode or Pi side-by-side, each in its own isolated git worktree, tracked in one place, and works on desktop, mobile companion app and remote runtime using your own subscription.
en.content: The repo centers on a TypeScript desktop app, with build resources and icons, multilingual docs (zh-CN, ja, ko, es, fr, pt) plus feature GIFs, a mobile companion app (iOS App Store, TestFlight, Android APK) and remote runtime code.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript as a cross-platform desktop app (macOS/Windows/Linux), paired with iOS/Android companions and a remote runtime, MIT-licensed, and relying on coding-agent CLIs plus git worktrees.
en.hot: It gained 5,362 stars this week to reach ~69.5k total, landing at #14 on GitHub Trending's weekly TypeScript chart. Parallel multi-agent orchestration is the hottest dev paradigm right now, and Orca's bring-your-own-subscription model hits both cost and efficiency pain points.
uses: Developers running multiple coding agents and comparing results in parallel
Individuals and teams wanting to drive agents with their own existing subscriptions
Engineers who need to monitor and steer agents from their phone on the go
Teams wanting isolated git worktree experiments and merging the winner

zh.tag: 官方 Codex 插件示例与市场
zh.what: 该仓库是 OpenAI 官方的 Codex 插件集合，包含多种插件示例，每个插件都有清单文件和可选配套组件。它提供了默认市场和 API 密钥用户的独立市场，方便用户发现和安装插件。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个插件目录，如 Figma、Notion、iOS/macOS 构建、Web 应用、Expo 等，每个插件包含清单文件及技能、MCP 配置等。

zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方仓库，吸引了大量开发者关注，今日新增 20 星，总星数超 5400，位列日榜第 15 名。

团队需要集成 Figma、Notion 等工具到 AI 工作流。

zh.tag: 为 Hermes Agent 打造的全能插件与长期记忆操作层
zh.what: oh-my-hermes（OMH）是构建在 NousResearch 的 Hermes Agent 之上的操作层插件，把普通的自然语言请求转化为明确的能力调用、可执行的下一步以及带有证据边界的真实记录。它不替换 Hermes，而是为其补充规划、研究、创作、编码交接、运维和项目记忆等工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含插件本体、分组技能与 OMH 专家模块，以及安装、能力、能力影响等文档，并提供多语言 README（英/韩/日/中）和 GitHub Pages 站点。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主要语言，依赖并扩展 Hermes Agent 生态，集成长期记忆系统与模型优化的工作流包。
zh.hot: 上线不久即获得 2551 颗星，今日新增 80 星并冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 15 名，说明围绕 Hermes Agent 的插件化记忆与工作流需求正快速升温。
uses: 正在使用 Hermes Agent、希望增强其规划与记忆能力的开发者
需要为 AI 编码代理建立长期项目记忆与证据追踪的团队
想研究代理操作层、技能编排与工作流治理的 AI 工程师
希望用自然语言驱动研究、创作与运维流程的个人用户

en.tag: An all-in-one plugin and long-term memory operating layer for Hermes Agent
en.what: oh-my-hermes (OMH) is an operating-layer plugin built on top of NousResearch's Hermes Agent that turns ordinary natural-language requests into clear capabilities, useful next steps, and an honest record of what actually happened. It does not replace Hermes but adds planning, research, creation, coding handoffs, operations, and project memory workflows.
en.content: The repo contains the plugin itself, grouped skills and OMH specialist modules, plus docs for installation, capabilities, and capability impact, along with multilingual READMEs (EN/KO/JA/ZH) and a GitHub Pages site.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, it depends on and extends the Hermes Agent ecosystem, integrating a long-term memory system and model-optimized workflow packages.
en.hot: It has quickly reached 2,551 stars, gaining 80 today and ranking 15th on GitHub Trending's daily list, showing fast-growing demand for plugin-based memory and workflows around Hermes Agent.
uses: Developers already using Hermes Agent who want stronger planning and memory
Teams needing long-term project memory and evidence tracking for AI coding agents
AI engineers studying agent operating layers, skill orchestration, and workflow governance
Individuals who want to drive research, creation, and ops via natural language

zh.tag: 抖音批量下载工具，去水印，支持视频、图集、合集与音乐
zh.what: 这是一个抖音内容批量下载工具，支持单条链接下载和作者主页批量抓取，可保存视频、图集、合集、收藏夹以及原声音乐。内置进度显示、失败重试、SQLite 去重和下载完整性校验，并提供浏览器回退方案应对反爬。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 脚本为主体，包含中英文 README、命令行入口与配置示例，另有基于同一后端的桌面 GUI「Douzy」截图与 Releases 构建，覆盖抖音、TikTok、YouTube 三个平台的工作区。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，依赖 requests 等 HTTP 库与 SQLite 做去重记录，并通过浏览器回退机制处理登录与风控；桌面端为同一后端的 GUI 封装。
zh.hot: 抖音内容存档需求旺盛，加上去水印与批量下载的实用定位，项目已积累 11363 颗星，今日新增 452 星并冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 17 名。
uses: 需要批量备份自己或他人抖音作品的普通用户
做短视频素材收集与二次创作的内容创作者
研究爬虫、反爬与浏览器回退方案的技术学习者
希望本地归档抖音收藏、喜欢与合集的重度用户

en.tag: A practical Douyin batch downloader with watermark removal for videos, galleries, collections and music
en.what: This is a practical Douyin downloader that handles both single-item and profile batch downloads, saving videos, image-notes, collections, favorites and original music. It ships with progress display, retries, SQLite deduplication, download integrity checks and a browser fallback for anti-bot scenarios.
en.content: The repo centers on Python scripts with bilingual READMEs, a CLI entry point and config samples, plus screenshots and Releases builds for a desktop GUI called Douzy built on the same backend, covering Douyin, TikTok and YouTube workspaces.
en.stack: Written mainly in Python, it relies on HTTP libraries like requests plus SQLite for dedup records, and uses a browser fallback to handle login and risk control; the desktop app is a GUI wrapper over the same backend.
en.hot: Strong demand for archiving Douyin content plus its practical watermark-free batch downloading have pushed it to 11,363 stars, with 452 added today and a No.17 spot on the GitHub Trending daily list.
uses: Everyday users who want to batch back up their own or others' Douyin posts
Content creators collecting short-video material for remixing
Developers studying scraping, anti-bot and browser-fallback techniques
Heavy Douyin users archiving favorites, likes and collections locally

zh.tag: 把 AI 编码助手变成完整视频制作工作室的开源智能体系统
zh.what: OpenMontage 是首个开源的智能体视频制作系统，内置 12 条制作流水线、100 多个工具以及 700 多份智能体技能与制作知识文件。它让 Claude、ChatGPT 等 AI 编码助手直接驱动从脚本、分镜到剪辑合成的完整视频生产流程。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 代码为主体，包含 12 条制作流水线、100 多个工具脚本和 700 多份智能体技能/制作知识文档，并配有 AGENT_GUIDE.md、PROVIDERS.md 等指南与吉祥物 Monty 的视觉资源。
zh.stack: 核心使用 Python 编写，围绕 AI 编码助手（Claude、ChatGPT、DeepSeek 等）构建智能体工作流，并支持多家模型/服务提供商接入。
zh.hot: 上线即登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第一，目前累计近 6 万 star，本周新增 2863 星，位列 Python 周榜第 15 名，说明「AI 智能体 + 视频生产」这一组合正切中开发者痛点。
uses: 内容创作者与自媒体团队，想用 AI 助手批量产出短视频和营销素材
独立开发者与工程师，希望把视频制作能力集成进自己的 AI 工作流
影视/广告从业者，用智能体自动化脚本、分镜与剪辑合成环节
AI 工具爱好者，想体验把编码助手变成视频工作室的新玩法

en.tag: The first open-source agentic video production system that turns your AI coding assistant into a full studio
en.what: OpenMontage is the first open-source, agentic video production system, bundling 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, and 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files. It turns AI coding assistants like Claude and ChatGPT into a full video production studio, driving everything from scripting and storyboarding to editing and compositing.
en.content: The repo is primarily Python code, shipping 12 production pipelines, 100+ tool scripts, and 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files, alongside guides like AGENT_GUIDE.md and PROVIDERS.md plus mascot Monty's visual assets.
en.stack: Built mainly in Python, it orchestrates agentic workflows around AI coding assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, etc.) and supports multiple model/service providers.
en.hot: It hit #1 Repository of the Day on GitHub Trending, now sits at nearly 60k stars with 2,863 added this week, ranking 15th on the Python weekly chart — showing the 'AI agent + video production' combo hits a real developer pain point.
uses: Content creators and media teams wanting to mass-produce short videos and marketing assets with AI assistants
Indie developers and engineers looking to integrate video production into their own AI workflows
Film/advertising professionals automating scripting, storyboarding, and editing with agents
AI tool enthusiasts eager to try turning a coding assistant into a video studio

zh.tag: 开源自主编码代理，覆盖 IDE、终端与桌面
zh.what: Cline 是一个开源的自主编码代理，能读写文件、执行命令、浏览网页并调用工具，全程可人工审批。它以 VS Code/JetBrains 插件、CLI、桌面应用和 SDK 多种形态提供同一套代理引擎。
zh.content: 仓库按产品线组织：sdk/ 提供 Node.js 编程式代理 API，apps/cli/ 是终端 UI 与无头模式，另有 VS Code 扩展、JetBrains 插件和 macOS/Windows 桌面应用。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，基于 Node.js 生态；CLI 通过 npm 全局安装，SDK 以 @cline/sdk 包发布，支持 MCP 服务器与自定义工具。
zh.hot: 68,377 颗星、日增 112 并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 20，说明多形态统一代理引擎的定位持续吸引开发者。
uses: 想在 VS Code 或 JetBrains 里获得可审批自主编码助手的开发者
需要在 CI/CD 或脚本中使用无头编码代理的工程团队
希望基于同一引擎构建自定义 AI 代理与集成的开发者
偏好桌面应用管理模型、插件与 MCP 服务器的进阶用户

en.tag: Open-source autonomous coding agent for IDE, terminal, and desktop
en.what: Cline is an open-source autonomous coding agent that can create files, run commands, browse the web, and use tools with human-in-the-loop approval. It ships the same agent engine as VS Code/JetBrains extensions, a CLI, a desktop app, and an SDK.
en.content: The repo is organized by product line: sdk/ offers a Node.js programmatic agent API, apps/cli/ holds the terminal UI and headless mode, plus VS Code extension, JetBrains plugin, and macOS/Windows desktop app.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript on the Node.js ecosystem; the CLI installs globally via npm and the SDK ships as @cline/sdk, with support for MCP servers and custom tools.
en.hot: With 68,377 stars, +112 today, and a #20 spot on GitHub Trending daily, its multi-surface unified agent engine keeps drawing developers.
uses: Developers wanting an approval-gated autonomous coding assistant in VS Code or JetBrains
Engineering teams needing a headless coding agent for CI/CD or scripting
Developers building custom AI agents and integrations on the same engine
Power users preferring a desktop app to manage models, plugins, and MCP servers

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 编程代理桌面工作台
zh.what: PI-Desktop 是一个本地优先、模型无关的 AI 编程代理桌面应用，让代理在独立工作区里处理项目、会话、文件与预览。项目与会话留在本机，模型请求直连你自己配置的服务商或端点，无需账号或强制中转。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 桌面端、Rust 主机核心、pi Agent Harness 以及可用户安装的插件体系，并配有文档、截图与插件开发指南。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，桌面层基于 Electron，核心主机用 Rust 编写，支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、本地模型及任意 OpenAI 兼容 API。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1939 star、总数达 4156，登上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 周榜第 5，本地优先与模型无关的定位正好切中开发者对隐私和可控性的需求。
uses: 希望代理在自己机器上运行、数据不外传的开发者
需要接入多家模型或本地模型、不想被单一厂商锁定的团队
想为 AI 编程代理开发插件、扩展工作流的工程师
偏好独立桌面工作区而非终端或编辑器插件的编程用户

en.tag: Local-first desktop workspace for AI coding agents
en.what: PI-Desktop is a local-first, model-agnostic desktop app for AI coding agents, giving agents a dedicated workspace for projects, sessions, files, and previews. Projects and sessions stay on your machine, and model requests go straight to the provider or endpoint you configure—no account or mandatory relay.
en.content: The repo ships an Electron desktop app, a Rust host core, the pi Agent Harness, and a user-installable plugin system, along with docs, screenshots, and a plugin development guide.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with an Electron desktop layer and a Rust host core; it supports OpenAI, Anthropic, local models, and any OpenAI-compatible API.
en.hot: It gained 1,939 stars this week for a total of 4,156, ranking 5th on GitHub Trending's weekly TypeScript list, as its local-first, model-agnostic stance hits developers' demand for privacy and control.
uses: Developers who want agents running locally without sending data off their machine
Teams needing multi-provider or local models without vendor lock-in
Engineers building plugins to extend AI coding agent workflows
Coders who prefer a standalone desktop workspace over terminal or editor extensions

zh.tag: 开源企业级业务管理平台，集 ERP、CRM、HRM、ATS 与项目管理于一体
zh.what: Ever Gauzy 是一个面向协作、按需和共享经济的开源业务管理平台，提供企业资源规划（ERP）、客户关系管理（CRM）、人力资源管理（HRM）、招聘跟踪（ATS）以及工作与项目管理（PM）等核心功能。它旨在帮助企业在一个统一的系统中管理财务、销售、库存、员工和项目等关键业务流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的平台源代码，主要使用 TypeScript 编写，提供无头 API、仪表盘、时间跟踪、员工管理、招聘、销售管道、会计发票等模块。还包括详细的文档和部署指南，支持 Gitpod 在线开发。
zh.stack: 技术栈以 TypeScript 为主，基于 Node.js 和 NestJS 构建后端，前端可能使用 Angular 或 React，数据库支持 PostgreSQL、MySQL 等，并采用 AGPL v3 许可证。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 191 颗星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 2 名，总星数达 5084，表明其作为开源 ERP/CRM 替代方案正受到广泛关注。
uses: 中小企业寻求开源 ERP/CRM 解决方案以降低软件成本
开发团队需要可定制、可扩展的业务管理平台进行二次开发
人力资源和招聘团队希望集成 ATS 和员工管理功能
项目管理和咨询公司需要时间跟踪与项目协作工具

en.tag: Open business management platform combining ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS and project management
en.what: Ever Gauzy is an open business management platform for collaborative, on-demand and sharing economies, offering Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Human Resource Management (HRM), Applicant Tracking System (ATS), and Work and Project Management (PM). It aims to help businesses manage key processes like finance, sales, inventory, employees, and projects in one unified system.
en.content: The repository contains the full platform source code, primarily written in TypeScript, offering headless APIs, dashboards, time tracking, employee management, ATS, sales pipelines, accounting/invoicing modules, and more. It also includes detailed documentation and deployment guides, with Gitpod support for online development.
en.stack: The tech stack is primarily TypeScript, with a Node.js and NestJS backend, possibly Angular or React frontend, and support for databases like PostgreSQL and MySQL, under the AGPL v3 license.
en.hot: The project gained 191 stars today, ranking 2nd on GitHub Trending daily list, with a total of 5,084 stars, indicating growing attention as an open-source ERP/CRM alternative.
uses: Small and medium businesses seeking open-source ERP/CRM solutions to reduce software costs
Development teams needing a customizable and extensible business management platform for secondary development
HR and recruitment teams looking to integrate ATS and employee management features
Project management and consulting firms requiring time tracking and project collaboration tools

zh.tag: 面向网络安全分析师的图化OSINT调查平台
zh.what: Flowsint 是一个开源的 OSINT 图探索工具，专为合乎伦理的调查、透明度和验证而设计。它让网络安全分析师和调查人员能够以可视化、灵活且可扩展的方式，对实体及其关系进行图谱化调查。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端应用、核心逻辑和 API 服务等模块，采用 Docker 化部署，提供完整的本地或团队调查环境。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，依赖 Docker 和 Make 进行构建与部署，支持 Linux、macOS 和 Windows。
zh.hot: 凭借 8341 颗星和今日新增 280 星，Flowsint 登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 18 名，反映出网络安全与 OSINT 工具在开源社区的高关注度。
uses: 网络安全分析师 —— 用于可视化调查网络威胁和实体关系
OSINT 调查人员 —— 进行开源情报收集与图谱分析
安全团队 —— 在内部网络中部署协作调查平台
隐私关注者 —— 所有数据存储在本地，保障调查隐私

en.tag: A graph-based OSINT investigation platform for cybersecurity analysts
en.what: Flowsint is an open-source OSINT graph exploration tool designed for ethical investigation, transparency, and verification. It enables cybersecurity analysts and investigators to visually, flexibly, and extensibly investigate entities and their relationships as graphs.
en.content: The repository contains frontend app, core logic, and API service modules, with Docker-based deployment for a complete local or team investigation environment.
en.stack: Primarily built with TypeScript, relying on Docker and Make for building and deployment, supporting Linux, macOS, and Windows.
en.hot: With 8,341 stars and 280 new stars today, Flowsint ranks 18th on GitHub Trending daily, reflecting strong community interest in cybersecurity and OSINT tools.
uses: Cybersecurity analysts — for visual investigation of cyber threats and entity relationships
OSINT investigators — for open-source intelligence gathering and graph analysis
Security teams — deploy a collaborative investigation platform on internal networks
Privacy-conscious users — all data is stored locally, ensuring investigation privacy

zh.tag: 开源自托管 AI 销售 CRM，原生 AI 代理接管 WhatsApp 聊天
zh.what: DeskcommCRM 是一个开源的 AI 销售操作系统，把能接待、筛选并促成成交的 AI 代理直接嵌进 CRM，通过 WhatsApp（WAHA）与客户对话。它是 Kommo、Octadesk、Intercom 的开源替代品，数据自持、无月费、无功能锁。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Next.js 应用主体、WAHA 的 WhatsApp 集成、Supabase 数据库与认证、多租户与 LGPD 合规逻辑，以及 hostgator-setup-kit 一键部署脚本和架构/路线图文档。

zh.hot: 上线不久即冲到 GitHub Trending 日榜第 4，今日新增 152 star、总数 1347，说明拉美市场对「开源 + WhatsApp 原生 AI 销售」的需求被长期压抑。
uses: 通过 WhatsApp 成交的中小企业与销售团队，想摆脱 Kommo/Octadesk 的月费与功能锁定
需要数据主权与 LGPD 合规、希望把 CRM 跑在自己 VPS 上的巴西及拉美公司
想给现有销售流程加 AI 代理、并接入 MCP 生态的开发者与集成商
寻找 Intercom 开源替代、重视自托管与多租户能力的 SaaS 团队

en.tag: Open-source self-hosted AI sales CRM with native AI agents on WhatsApp
en.what: DeskcommCRM is an open-source AI sales OS that embeds AI agents capable of greeting, qualifying and closing deals directly inside a CRM, conversing with customers over WhatsApp (WAHA). It positions itself as the open alternative to Kommo, Octadesk and Intercom, with self-owned data, no monthly fees and no locked features.
en.content: The repo contains the Next.js app, WhatsApp integration via WAHA, Supabase database and auth, multi-tenant and LGPD compliance logic, plus a hostgator-setup-kit one-command deploy script and architecture/roadmap docs.
en.stack: Built with strict TypeScript and Next.js 16, backed by Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage), using WAHA for the WhatsApp channel, with MCP support, multi-tenancy and self-hosted deployment.
en.hot: It hit #4 on GitHub Trending with 152 stars added today and 1,347 total, showing pent-up demand in LATAM for an open-source, WhatsApp-native AI sales tool.
uses: SMBs and sales teams closing deals on WhatsApp who want to escape Kommo/Octadesk monthly fees and locked features
Brazilian and LATAM companies needing data sovereignty and LGPD compliance by running the CRM on their own VPS
Developers and integrators adding AI agents to existing sales flows and plugging into the MCP ecosystem
SaaS teams seeking an open-source Intercom alternative with self-hosting and multi-tenancy

zh.tag: 本地优先的开源 AI 语音工作室：克隆、合成、听写
zh.what: Voicebox 是一个本地运行的 AI 语音工作室，可替代 ElevenLabs 与 WisprFlow。它支持用几秒音频克隆音色、在 7 个 TTS 引擎和 23 种语言中生成语音，并通过全局快捷键向任意输入框听写。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用本体、landing 官网与 docs 文档站，并附带应用截图与图标资源，同时提供 API 与 MCP 集成说明。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，采用本地优先架构，内置本地 LLM 用于文本润色与角色人格，并打包多个 TTS 引擎。
zh.hot: 以 54,383 星、单日新增 417 星冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 5，靠的是把语音输入与输出两条链路合并进一个免费本地应用。
uses: 内容创作者：用几秒样本克隆音色，为视频和播客批量生成多语言配音
开发者与 AI 工程师：通过 API 或 MCP 为智能体接入自有音色

效率办公人群：用全局快捷键在任意应用中语音听写代替打字

en.tag: The local-first open-source AI voice studio: clone, generate, dictate
en.what: Voicebox is a local-first AI voice studio positioned as a free, open-source alternative to ElevenLabs and WisprFlow. It clones voices from a few seconds of audio, generates speech across 7 TTS engines and 23 languages, and dictates into any text field via a global hotkey.
