zh.tag: 用 Rust 编写的开源远程桌面，可自托管替代 TeamViewer
zh.what: RustDesk 是一款用 Rust 编写的开源远程桌面应用，开箱即用、无需配置，用户可完全掌控自己的数据。它支持使用官方中继服务器、自建服务器，或自行编写会合/中继服务器，作为 TeamViewer 等商业方案的替代。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 客户端源码（src/）、多语言 UI 文案（src/lang）、文档（docs/，含 30 多种语言的 README 翻译）、构建与 Docker 脚本，以及截图等资源。
zh.stack: 核心使用 Rust 编写，采用 Flutter/Dart 构建跨平台 UI，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 与 Web，依赖自研的会合/中继服务器协议。
zh.hot: 已收获 123,695 颗星，今日再增 172 星并登上 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 9 名，凭借自托管、隐私可控和跨平台能力持续吸引关注。
uses: 需要远程办公或远程协助个人电脑的用户
重视数据隐私、希望自建中继服务器的团队与企业
想研究远程桌面协议与 Rust 跨平台开发的开发者
为家人朋友提供远程技术支持的技术爱好者

en.tag: Open-source remote desktop in Rust, a self-hostable TeamViewer alternative
en.what: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop application written in Rust that works out of the box with no configuration. It lets users keep full control of their data by using the official rendezvous/relay server, hosting their own, or writing a custom one, as an alternative to TeamViewer.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust client source (src/), multilingual UI strings (src/lang), docs (docs/, with README translations in 30+ languages), build and Docker scripts, and screenshot assets.
en.stack: Core is written in Rust with a Flutter/Dart cross-platform UI, targeting Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS and Web, relying on its own rendezvous/relay server protocol.
en.hot: With 123,695 stars and 172 added today, it ranks 9th on GitHub Trending's daily Rust list, drawing steady attention for self-hosting, privacy control and cross-platform support.
uses: Individuals who need remote access to their own computers
Teams and enterprises that value privacy and want self-hosted relay servers
Developers studying remote desktop protocols and Rust cross-platform development
Tech-savvy users providing remote support to family and friends

zh.tag: 终端里找片、下载、播放影视与直播的 TUI 工具
zh.what: MovieBox-TUI 是一个用 Rust 编写的终端界面应用，让你在命令行里搜索、下载并播放电影、剧集、动漫和直播电视。它把内容源、字幕、播放器和下载引擎整合进一个 TUI，调用本地播放器完成实际播放。
zh.content: 仓库主体是一个 Rust 编写的 TUI 应用，包含多语言 README（英/孟加拉/印地/西语）、一键安装脚本（install.sh / install.ps1）、Homebrew tap 以及演示录屏。功能模块覆盖点播流媒体、M3U/IPTV 直播、字幕自动加载、下载与书签历史。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，终端 UI 渲染依赖支持图形协议的终端（Ghostty、Kitty、WezTerm、iTerm2）；播放依赖 mpv、IINA、VLC 或 Termux 下的安卓播放器，DASH 下载可选 yt-dlp 与 ffmpeg。
zh.hot: 本周新增 262 星、总计 2012 星并登上 GitHub Trending Rust 周榜第 5，说明终端党对「命令行看片」这类整合型 TUI 工具有强烈兴趣，跨平台与多播放器支持也降低了使用门槛。
uses: 喜欢在终端里完成一切操作、追求键盘流体验的开发者与极客
想在低配设备或 Termux 安卓环境上追剧、看直播的用户
需要批量下载剧集并自动匹配字幕的影视收藏者
希望用 mpv/VLC 等本地播放器获得硬件加速播放体验的人

en.tag: A terminal TUI to find, download and stream movies, TV shows and live TV
en.what: MovieBox-TUI is a Rust-built terminal interface that lets you search, download and stream movies, series, anime and live TV from the command line. It bundles content sources, subtitles, players and a download engine into one TUI, delegating actual playback to local media players.
en.content: The repo is a Rust TUI app with multilingual READMEs (EN/BN/HI/ES), one-line install scripts (install.sh / install.ps1), a Homebrew tap and a walkthrough recording. Feature modules cover on-demand streaming, M3U/IPTV live TV, automatic subtitles, downloads, and bookmarks/history.
en.stack: Written in Rust; the TUI relies on graphics-capable terminals (Ghostty, Kitty, WezTerm, iTerm2). Playback uses mpv, IINA, VLC or Android players via Termux, with optional yt-dlp and ffmpeg for DASH downloads.
en.hot: It gained 262 stars this week for a total of 2,012, ranking 5th on GitHub Trending's weekly Rust list, showing strong appetite for an all-in-one 'watch in the terminal' TUI, with cross-platform and multi-player support lowering the barrier.
uses: Developers and geeks who prefer doing everything in the terminal with a keyboard-driven workflow
Users who want to watch shows or live TV on low-end devices or Android via Termux
Collectors who need to batch-download seasons with automatic subtitle matching
People who want hardware-accelerated playback through local players like mpv or VLC

zh.tag: 一键切换 Antigravity 账号的桌面管理工具
zh.what: Antigravity Tools 是一款专为开发者和 AI 爱好者设计的桌面应用，用于管理 Antigravity 账号并实现一键无缝切换。它还能将 Web 端 Session 转化为标准 API，充当本地 AI 中转站。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Tauri v2 + React 前端和 Rust 后端，提供图形界面进行账号管理、协议转换和请求调度。
zh.stack: 基于 Tauri v2、React 和 Rust，使用现代桌面应用框架，支持跨平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 3 万+ Star 和日增 84 的热度，它解决了 AI 账号管理的痛点，提供高效便捷的本地中转方案。
uses: 需要管理多个 Antigravity 账号的开发者，可一键切换，提升效率。
希望将 Web Session 转为 API 的 AI 爱好者，用于本地集成和调用。
追求低成本、高稳定 AI 中转服务的用户，可结合赞助商服务使用。

en.tag: One-click Antigravity account manager & switcher desktop app
en.what: Antigravity Tools is a desktop app for developers and AI enthusiasts to manage Antigravity accounts and switch between them seamlessly with one click. It also converts web sessions into standard APIs, acting as a local AI relay.
en.content: The repo contains a Tauri v2 + React frontend and Rust backend, offering a GUI for account management, protocol conversion, and request routing.
en.stack: Built with Tauri v2, React, and Rust, leveraging a modern desktop framework for cross-platform support.
en.hot: With over 30k stars and 84 daily additions, it addresses AI account management pain points with an efficient local relay solution.
uses: Developers managing multiple Antigravity accounts can switch with one click for efficiency.
AI enthusiasts wanting to convert web sessions into APIs for local integration and calls.
Users seeking low-cost, stable AI relay services can leverage sponsor offerings.

zh.tag: 用纯 Rust 直接编译 GPU 内核到 CUDA PTX 的编译器
zh.what: cuda-oxide 是 NVIDIA 官方实验室推出的 rustc 后端，让你用安全、地道的 Rust 编写 SIMT GPU 内核，并直接编译成 PTX，无需 DSL 或外部语言绑定。它支持单源编译，主机端与设备端代码可写在同一个文件里。
zh.content: 仓库包含 rustc 代码生成后端、设备端抽象（类型安全索引、共享内存、作用域原子操作、屏障、TMA、warp/cluster 操作）、编译期内核策略，以及主机端运行时（cuda-core、cuda-async）和基于 Pliron 的 Rust 原生编译流水线。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 与 rustc 后端，使用 Pliron（Rust 实现的类 MLIR IR 框架），编译路径为 Rust → Rust MIR → Pliron IR → LLVM IR → PTX，并依赖 CUDA 驱动与运行时。
zh.hot: 作为 NVIDIA Labs 官方项目，它让 Rust 开发者无需学习 CUDA C++ 或 DSL 就能写 GPU 内核，发布不久即获 3504 stars，今日新增 50，登上 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 5 名。
uses: Rust 开发者希望用熟悉语言编写高性能 GPU 内核
需要单源编译、避免 CUDA C++ 与 Rust 混合编程的团队
研究 GPU 编译器、rustc 后端或 MLIR 类 IR 的工程师
想在 CUDA 上尝试类型安全、内存安全抽象的 HPC 与 AI 系统开发者

en.tag: A Rust-to-CUDA compiler that compiles pure Rust GPU kernels to PTX
en.what: cuda-oxide is an NVIDIA Labs rustc backend that lets you write SIMT GPU kernels in safe, idiomatic Rust and compile them directly to PTX, with no DSLs or foreign language bindings. It supports single-source compilation, keeping host and device code in the same file.
en.content: The repo contains a rustc codegen backend, device-side abstractions (type-safe indexing, shared memory, scoped atomics, barriers, TMA, warp/cluster ops), compile-time kernel policies, host-side runtimes (cuda-core, cuda-async), and a Rust-native compilation pipeline built on Pliron.
en.stack: Built in Rust as a rustc backend, it uses Pliron (an MLIR-like IR framework in Rust) with a pipeline of Rust → Rust MIR → Pliron IR → LLVM IR → PTX, and depends on the CUDA driver and runtime.
en.hot: As an official NVIDIA Labs project, it lets Rust developers write GPU kernels without learning CUDA C++ or a DSL, quickly reaching 3,504 stars with 50 added today and ranking 5th on GitHub Trending for Rust.
uses: Rust developers who want to write high-performance GPU kernels in a familiar language
Teams seeking single-source compilation without mixing CUDA C++ and Rust
Engineers researching GPU compilers, rustc backends, or MLIR-like IRs
HPC and AI systems developers wanting type-safe, memory-safe abstractions on CUDA

zh.tag: 为AI代理压缩命令输出的CLI代理，节省高达90%token
zh.what: RTK是一个高性能的CLI代理，在命令输出进入LLM上下文之前进行过滤和压缩，可减少60-90%的token消耗。它拦截shell命令，将冗长的输出转换为紧凑格式，例如将ls输出转为带文件计数的树形结构，仅保留git diff的关键变更等。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个用Rust编写的单一二进制文件，支持100多种命令，如ls、cat、grep、git、cargo test等。还提供安装脚本、文档（包括架构说明）和多语言README。
zh.stack: 纯Rust实现，零依赖，单一二进制文件，开销小于10ms。
zh.hot: 随着AI编程助手普及，token成本成为痛点，RTK能大幅削减成本，且安装简单、性能高，因此迅速走红。
uses: 使用Claude Code、Codex等AI编程助手的开发者，希望减少token消耗和费用。
需要处理大量命令行输出的DevOps工程师，通过压缩日志和状态信息提高效率。
对Rust高性能工具感兴趣的开发者，可学习其架构和实现。

en.tag: CLI proxy that compresses command output for AI agents, cutting token usage by up to 90%
en.what: RTK is a high-performance CLI proxy that filters and compresses command output before it reaches the LLM context, reducing token consumption by 60-90%. It intercepts shell commands and converts verbose output into compact formats, such as turning ls output into a tree with file counts and keeping only essential changes from git diff.
en.content: The repository contains a single Rust binary supporting over 100 commands like ls, cat, grep, git, cargo test, etc. It also includes installation scripts, documentation (including architecture), and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Pure Rust implementation, zero dependencies, single binary, overhead under 10ms.
en.hot: As AI coding assistants become popular, token costs are a pain point. RTK significantly cuts costs, is easy to install, and performs well, hence its rapid rise.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants like Claude Code or Codex who want to reduce token usage and costs.
DevOps engineers dealing with large command outputs, improving efficiency by compressing logs and status info.
Developers interested in high-performance Rust tools, who can learn from its architecture and implementation.

zh.tag: 一条命令升级系统上所有包管理器与工具链
zh.what: Topgrade 会自动探测你机器上安装了哪些包管理器、语言工具链和系统更新工具，然后依次调用它们各自的升级命令。它把散落在 shell 配置里的多行升级脚本收敛成一条 topgrade 命令，覆盖 Linux、macOS 和 Windows。
zh.content: 一个 Rust 编写的 CLI 项目，核心是各平台/工具的升级步骤模块与配置系统，另含文档、演示 GIF 和发布脚本，通过 crates.io、Homebrew、AUR、Winget 等渠道分发。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，以 Cargo/crates.io 发布，依赖各系统的包管理器命令；支持通过 TOML 配置文件自定义要执行或跳过的步骤。
zh.hot: 作为原版 topgrade 的维护分支，它解决了跨平台升级碎片化的真实痛点，已积累 4562 颗星，本周再增 49 星并登上 Rust 周榜第 15 名。
uses: 同时使用多种包管理器和语言工具链的开发者，想一条命令完成全部升级
经常重装或管理多台 Linux/macOS/Windows 机器的运维与极客用户
厌倦在 dotfiles 里维护冗长升级脚本、希望统一配置的人
想学习 Rust 编写跨平台 CLI 与外部命令编排的开发者

en.tag: One command to upgrade every package manager and toolchain on your system
en.what: Topgrade detects which package managers, language toolchains and system updaters are installed on your machine and runs the appropriate upgrade command for each of them. It replaces the long, non-portable shell one-liners in your dotfiles with a single topgrade invocation, working across Linux, macOS and Windows.
en.content: A Rust CLI project whose core is a set of per-platform and per-tool upgrade step modules plus a config system, alongside docs, a demo GIF and release tooling, distributed via crates.io, Homebrew, AUR, Winget and more.
en.stack: Written in Rust and published via Cargo/crates.io, it shells out to each system's package manager commands and supports a TOML config file to customize which steps run or are skipped.
en.hot: As the maintained fork of the original topgrade, it solves the real pain of fragmented cross-platform upgrades, holding 4,562 stars with 49 added this week and a No.15 spot on the Rust weekly trending list.
uses: Developers juggling multiple package managers and language toolchains who want one command to upgrade everything
Ops engineers and power users who frequently set up or manage many Linux/macOS/Windows machines
Anyone tired of maintaining long upgrade one-liners in their dotfiles and wanting a single config
Developers curious about building cross-platform CLIs and orchestrating external commands in Rust

zh.tag: 基于 Tauri 的跨平台 Clash Meta 图形客户端
zh.what: Clash Verge Rev 是 Clash Verge 的延续项目，一个基于 Tauri 框架的现代化代理客户端。它内置 Clash.Meta(mihomo) 内核，为 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 提供统一的图形化代理体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 Tauri 后端（src-tauri）与前端界面，附有多语言 README、深浅色预览图、发布页与文档站点。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 Rust + Tauri 2，内置 Clash.Meta(mihomo) 内核，前端负责界面与主题渲染。
zh.hot: 凭借 14.4 万 star 与本周新增 1698 star 登上 GitHub Trending 周榜 Rust 第 6 名，跨平台代理需求与活跃维护持续吸引关注。
uses: 需要跨平台图形化代理客户端的普通用户
希望管理 Clash 配置、节点与规则的高级玩家
关注 Rust/Tauri 桌面应用开发的开发者

en.tag: A cross-platform Clash Meta GUI client built on Tauri
en.what: Clash Verge Rev is a continuation of Clash Verge, a modern proxy client built on the Tauri framework. It bundles the Clash.Meta (mihomo) core and delivers a unified graphical proxy experience across Windows, macOS and Linux.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust-based Tauri backend (src-tauri) plus the frontend UI, along with multilingual READMEs, dark/light previews, release pages and a docs site.
en.stack: Built with Rust and Tauri 2, bundling the Clash.Meta (mihomo) core, with the frontend handling UI and theming.
en.hot: With 144k stars and 1,698 added this week, it ranks 6th on GitHub Trending's weekly Rust list, driven by cross-platform proxy demand and active maintenance.
uses: Everyday users needing a cross-platform graphical proxy client
Power users managing Clash configs, nodes and rules
Developers interested in Rust/Tauri desktop apps

zh.tag: 面向严苛审查网络的 Rust 抗审查隧道客户端
zh.what: Aether 是一个用 Rust 编写的抗审查客户端，专为深度包检测（DPI）、协议指纹识别、UDP 限速和端点封锁普遍的网络环境设计。它会自动发现可达端点、建立加密隧道，并在本地暴露 SOCKS5 代理供应用使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、多平台预编译发行包（Windows/macOS/Linux/OpenWrt/Android Termux）、校验文件，以及英文与波斯语文档和 Telegram 社区入口。
zh.stack: 核心使用 Rust 实现，基于 MASQUE（HTTP/3 与 HTTP/2）与 WireGuard，支持 TLS ClientHello 分片、流量混淆、Tor 出口和上游代理。
zh.hot: 本周新增 153 star、总数 1926，登上 GitHub Trending Rust 周榜第 17 名，反映出对实用抗审查工具在受限网络地区的强烈需求。
uses: 身处网络审查严格地区、需要稳定翻墙通道的普通用户
希望在 DPI 环境下隐藏协议特征的隐私与安全研究者
在 OpenWrt 路由器或 Android Termux 上部署隧道的进阶玩家
需要本地 SOCKS5 代理接入现有工具链的开发者

en.tag: A Rust censorship-circumvention tunnel client for heavily restricted networks
en.what: Aether is a Rust-based censorship-circumvention client built for networks with heavy DPI, protocol fingerprinting, UDP throttling, and endpoint blocking. It automatically discovers reachable endpoints, establishes an encrypted tunnel, and exposes a local SOCKS5 proxy for applications.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, prebuilt release archives for Windows/macOS/Linux/OpenWrt/Android Termux, checksum files, plus English and Persian documentation with a Telegram community link.
en.stack: Built in Rust on MASQUE (HTTP/3 and HTTP/2) and WireGuard, with TLS ClientHello fragmentation, traffic obfuscation, Tor exit, and upstream proxy support.
en.hot: With 153 stars added this week and 1,926 total, it hit #17 on GitHub's weekly Rust trending list, reflecting strong demand for practical censorship-circumvention tools in restricted regions.
uses: Everyday users in heavily censored regions needing a stable circumvention tunnel
Privacy and security researchers wanting to hide protocol fingerprints under DPI
Advanced users deploying tunnels on OpenWrt routers or Android Termux
Developers needing a local SOCKS5 proxy to plug into existing tooling

zh.tag: 用普通 WiFi 信号实现穿墙感知、姿态估计与生命体征监测
zh.what: RuView 把普通 WiFi 路由器发出的无线电波变成空间感知系统：通过 CSI 信号捕捉人体对电磁波的扰动，实现穿墙人员检测、人数统计、动作追踪，以及呼吸和心率等生命体征测量。全程不需要摄像头或可穿戴设备，只靠物理信号。
zh.content: 仓库以 Rust 实现为核心，包含 CSI 信号采集与处理管线、姿态/生命体征推断模型、以及面向智能家居的集成层：Home Assistant 的 MQTT 发布器、Apple Home 的 HAP-1.1 桥、Matter 端点，并提供 21 个实体（11 个原始信号 + 10 个语义状态）和 3 个 HA Blueprint。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，依赖低成本 ESP32 传感器采集 CSI 数据；通过 MQTT、HAP-1.1、Matter 等协议对接 Home Assistant、Apple Home、Google Home、Alexa 等生态。
zh.hot: 以 93841 颗星、今日新增 383 星冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 12 名，凭借“用 WiFi 穿墙感知、无需摄像头”的隐私友好卖点，加上对主流智能家居生态的原生支持，迅速引发关注。
uses: 智能家居用户：想在不装摄像头的情况下实现房间级存在检测与老人看护
隐私敏感场景：浴室、卧室等不便安装摄像头的空间需要生命体征与跌倒风险监测
IoT/嵌入式开发者：基于 ESP32 与 Rust 构建 WiFi 感知应用或二次开发
健康与养老机构：需要非接触式呼吸、心率及活动异常监测的远程照护方案

en.tag: Turn commodity WiFi signals into through-wall sensing, pose estimation and vital-sign monitoring
en.what: RuView turns ordinary WiFi radio waves into a spatial sensing system: it captures human-induced disturbances in Channel State Information (CSI) to detect people through walls, count them, track movement, and measure breathing and heart rate. No cameras or wearables are needed — just physics.
en.content: The repo centers on a Rust implementation with a CSI acquisition and processing pipeline, pose/vital-sign inference models, and smart-home integration layers: an MQTT publisher for Home Assistant, a HAP-1.1 bridge for Apple Home, and a Matter endpoint. It ships 21 entities per node (11 raw signals + 10 semantic states) plus 3 starter HA Blueprints.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, it relies on low-cost ESP32 sensors for CSI data collection and integrates with Home Assistant, Apple Home, Google Home and Alexa via MQTT, HAP-1.1 and Matter.
en.hot: With 93,841 stars and 383 added today, it ranks 12th on GitHub Trending's daily list. Its privacy-friendly pitch — through-wall sensing with WiFi and no cameras — plus native support for major smart-home ecosystems has driven rapid attention.
uses: Smart-home users who want room-level presence detection and elderly care without cameras
Privacy-sensitive spaces like bathrooms or bedrooms needing vital-sign and fall-risk monitoring
IoT/embedded developers building WiFi sensing apps on ESP32 and Rust
Health and elder-care providers needing contactless breathing, heart-rate and activity anomaly monitoring

zh.tag: 自主AI渗透测试代理系统
zh.what: PentAGI 是一个全自主的 AI 代理系统，能够执行复杂的渗透测试任务。它利用先进的人工智能技术，为信息安全专业人员、研究人员和爱好者提供强大且灵活的安全测试解决方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的系统代码、架构文档、快速入门指南、LLM 提供商配置（如 OpenAI、Anthropic、Ollama 等）、Docker 镜像配置、开发与测试工具（如 ftester）以及社区链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，支持多种 LLM 提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、AWS Bedrock 等），集成 Docker 进行隔离，并支持 Langfuse 监控和知识图谱（Graphiti）。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 与网络安全结合的热度上升，PentAGI 作为自动化渗透测试的领先项目，在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，今日新增 89 星，总星数达 22519，位居 Go 语言趋势榜第一。
uses: 安全研究人员：利用 AI 代理自动执行渗透测试，提高效率。

AI 爱好者：探索 AI 在网络安全领域的实际应用。

en.tag: Autonomous AI agent system for complex penetration testing
en.what: PentAGI is a fully autonomous AI agent system capable of performing complex penetration testing tasks. It leverages advanced AI technologies to provide a powerful and flexible security testing solution for infosec professionals, researchers, and enthusiasts.
en.content: The repository includes full system code, architecture docs, quick start guides, LLM provider configurations (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama), Docker image setup, development and testing tools (like ftester), and community links.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, supports multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, AWS Bedrock, etc.), integrates Docker for isolation, and supports Langfuse monitoring and knowledge graph (Graphiti).
en.hot: With the rising intersection of AI and cybersecurity, PentAGI as a leading autonomous pentesting project has gained rapid traction on GitHub, adding 89 stars today to reach 22,519 total, ranking #1 in Go trending.

Red and blue teams: conduct automated security assessments in authorized environments.
AI enthusiasts: explore practical applications of AI in cybersecurity.

zh.tag: 为现有 AI 编程代理提供记忆、工作流与可验证证据的确定性工程环境
zh.what: Gentle-AI 是一个开源配置层，为你已经在用的 AI 编程代理（如 Claude Code、Cursor、OpenCode、Codex、Pi 等 16 种）注入持久记忆、规格驱动开发、精选技能、MCP 服务器、人格设定和可选的有界审查。它不锁定任何代理，目标是让代理写代码后不再失忆，并能证明自己做了什么。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 工具、文档（快速开始、预期用法、Wiki）、品牌资源以及针对不同代理的配置模板和技能库。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，跨平台支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows，采用 MIT 许可证。依赖可能包括各代理的配置接口和 MCP 协议。
zh.hot: 本周新增 411 颗星，总星数达 6911，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Go）第 9 名。它解决了 AI 代理缺乏记忆和工作流的痛点，且支持多种主流代理，无锁定，因此受到开发者关注。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理的开发者，希望增强代理的记忆和工作流能力。
团队需要规格驱动开发和可验证的代理行为，以提升代码质量和可审计性。
希望避免代理锁定，灵活切换或组合多种 AI 编程工具的用户。
对 MCP 服务器、技能库和人格设定等高级功能感兴趣的 AI 工程实践者。

en.tag: A deterministic engineering environment that gives your existing AI coding agents memory, workflow, and evidence.
en.what: Gentle-AI is an open-source configuration layer that injects persistent memory, Spec-Driven Development, curated skills, MCP servers, personas, and optional bounded review into the AI coding agents you already use (16 agents including Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Codex, and Pi). It avoids agent lock-in and aims to stop your agent from forgetting everything after writing code, while providing evidence of what it did.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based CLI tool, documentation (quickstart, intended usage, wiki), brand assets, and configuration templates and skill libraries for different agents.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, cross-platform for macOS, Linux, and Windows, under MIT license. Dependencies may include configuration interfaces for various agents and the MCP protocol.
en.hot: It gained 411 stars this week, reaching 6,911 total, and ranked 9th on GitHub Trending weekly (Go). It addresses the pain point of AI agents lacking memory and workflow, supports multiple mainstream agents without lock-in, thus attracting developer attention.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor who want to enhance agent memory and workflow.
Teams needing Spec-Driven Development and verifiable agent behavior for better code quality and auditability.
Users who want to avoid agent lock-in and flexibly switch or combine multiple AI coding tools.
AI engineering practitioners interested in advanced features like MCP servers, skill libraries, and personas.

zh.tag: 可插拔传输的 TCP 隧道与网络栈研究工具
zh.what: OpenFlux 是一个网络栈研究工具，提供 TCP 隧道并支持可插拔传输、批量+zstd 编解码，以及两种出口节点后端（L3 原始转发 / L4 gVisor 代理）。它允许客户端通过多种传输方式连接到出口节点，再访问互联网，适用于网络架构实验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 实现的 CLI 客户端和出口节点，支持 macOS、Linux、Windows，并有独立的 Android APK 和 iOS TestFlight 测试版。核心模块包括传输层（Yandex.Docs、Volga、MAX、Cups、Mail.ru）、编解码器以及 L3/L4 出口后端。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 gVisor 用户态网络栈实现 L4 代理，并集成 zstd 压缩。客户端和出口节点均以 CLI 形式提供，支持跨平台构建。
zh.hot: 本周新增 888 星，总星数达 1704，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Go）第 3 名。其可插拔传输和两种出口模式的设计，以及对多平台客户端的支持，吸引了网络研究者和开发者的关注。
uses: 网络研究人员和开发者，用于实验 TCP 隧道和可插拔传输架构。
需要跨平台（macOS/Linux/Windows/Android/iOS）网络工具的技术爱好者。
学习 gVisor 用户态网络栈和 L3/L4 转发机制的学生或工程师。
希望自建出口节点进行网络测试的运维人员。

en.tag: TCP tunnel with pluggable transports for network stack research
en.what: OpenFlux is a network stack research tool offering a TCP tunnel with pluggable transports, batched+zstd codec, and two exit-node backends (L3 raw forward / L4 gVisor proxy). It lets clients connect to an exit node via various transports to reach the internet, suitable for network architecture experiments.
en.content: The repo contains Go-based CLI clients and exit nodes for macOS, Linux, and Windows, plus standalone Android APK and iOS TestFlight beta. Core modules include transports (Yandex.Docs, Volga, MAX, Cups, Mail.ru), codec, and L3/L4 exit backends.
en.stack: Primarily built in Go, leveraging gVisor userspace network stack for L4 proxy and integrating zstd compression. Both client and exit node are CLI-based, supporting cross-platform builds.
en.hot: Gained 888 stars this week, reaching 1,704 total, ranking 3rd on GitHub Trending weekly (Go). Its pluggable transports, dual exit modes, and multi-platform client support attract network researchers and developers.
uses: Network researchers and developers experimenting with TCP tunnels and pluggable transport architectures.
Tech enthusiasts needing a cross-platform (macOS/Linux/Windows/Android/iOS) network tool.
Students or engineers learning gVisor userspace network stack and L3/L4 forwarding mechanisms.
Ops personnel wanting to self-host exit nodes for network testing.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理提供持久记忆的 Go 单文件方案
zh.what: Engram 是一个面向 AI 编码代理的持久记忆系统，让代理在会话结束后仍能记住项目上下文与历史决策。它通过 SQLite + FTS5 存储与检索记忆，并以 MCP 服务器、HTTP API、CLI 和 TUI 多种形态对外提供能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 实现的单一二进制程序，以及 docs 目录下的安装、架构、代理接入、插件、团队使用等文档，另有品牌素材与 Engram Cloud 相关说明。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，存储层使用 SQLite 配合 FTS5 全文检索，对外提供 MCP server、HTTP API、CLI 与 TUI，并强调零依赖、单二进制部署。
zh.hot: 它切中了 AI 编码代理「会话即失忆」的痛点，加上代理无关、单二进制零依赖的轻量设计，本周新增约 195 star，累计 6508 star，登上 GitHub Go 周榜第 18 名。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编码代理、希望跨会话保留上下文的开发者
需要在本地或云端为团队统一管理代理记忆的工程团队
想通过 MCP/HTTP API 把记忆能力接入自研代理工具的开发者

en.tag: Persistent memory for AI coding agents in a single Go binary
en.what: Engram is a persistent memory system for AI coding agents, letting them retain project context and past decisions across sessions. It stores and retrieves memories with SQLite + FTS5 and exposes them through an MCP server, HTTP API, CLI, and TUI.
en.content: The repo ships a single Go binary plus a docs folder covering installation, architecture, agent setup, plugins, and team usage, along with branding assets and Engram Cloud docs.
en.stack: Written in Go with SQLite + FTS5 for storage and full-text search, exposing an MCP server, HTTP API, CLI, and TUI, with an emphasis on zero dependencies and single-binary deployment.
en.hot: It targets the 'amnesia between sessions' pain of AI coding agents, and its agent-agnostic, single-binary, zero-dependency design helped it gain ~195 stars this week to reach 6,508, ranking 18th on GitHub's weekly Go trending list.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor who want context to survive across sessions
Engineering teams needing local or cloud-shared memory management for their agents
Developers integrating memory into custom agent tooling via MCP or HTTP API

zh.tag: 为 AI Agent 打造的毫秒级硬件隔离安全沙箱服务
zh.what: CubeSandbox 是腾讯云开源的高性能安全沙箱服务，基于 RustVMM 与 KVM 构建，可在 60ms 内创建硬件级隔离的沙箱环境，内存开销低于 5MB。它兼容 E2B SDK，支持单机部署并平滑扩展为多节点集群，为 AI Agent 提供安全、并发、轻量的代码执行环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心服务代码、RustVMM/KVM 虚拟化集成、E2B 兼容 API 层、快速开始与部署文档（docs/guide、docs/index.md）、中文文档及变更日志，并提供 PyPI 上的 cubesandbox 客户端包。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，底层依赖 RustVMM 与 KVM 实现硬件级虚拟化隔离，对外提供兼容 E2B SDK 的 API，并发布 PyPI 客户端包，采用 Apache 2.0 许可。
zh.hot: 上线即获 12512 星、今日新增 259 星，位列 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 2。AI Agent 爆发式增长让安全代码执行沙箱成为刚需，而 CubeSandbox 以 60ms 启动、5MB 开销和 E2B 兼容切中痛点，加上腾讯云背书与 CNCF Landscape 收录，迅速吸引开发者关注。
uses: AI Agent 开发者：为代码解释器、自动化任务提供安全隔离的执行环境
平台工程与基础设施团队：需要高并发、高密度的沙箱调度能力
已使用 E2B 的团队：希望平滑迁移到自托管、硬件级隔离方案
安全敏感场景：运行不可信代码时要求硬件级隔离与轻量开销

en.tag: Instant, hardware-isolated secure sandbox service for AI agents
en.what: CubeSandbox is a high-performance secure sandbox service open-sourced by Tencent Cloud, built on RustVMM and KVM. It creates hardware-isolated sandboxes in under 60ms with less than 5MB memory overhead, is E2B SDK compatible, and scales from single-node to multi-node clusters for safe AI agent code execution.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based core service, RustVMM/KVM virtualization integration, an E2B-compatible API layer, quickstart and deployment docs (docs/guide, docs/index.md), Chinese documentation, a changelog, and a cubesandbox client package on PyPI.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go, it relies on RustVMM and KVM for hardware-level virtualization isolation, exposes an E2B SDK-compatible API, ships a PyPI client package, and is licensed under Apache 2.0.
en.hot: It quickly reached 12,512 stars with 259 added today, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending (Go). The AI agent boom makes secure code-execution sandboxes essential, and CubeSandbox's 60ms startup, 5MB overhead, and E2B compatibility hit the sweet spot—boosted by Tencent Cloud backing and CNCF Landscape listing.
uses: AI agent developers: provide isolated execution for code interpreters and automated tasks
Platform and infra teams: need high-concurrency, high-density sandbox scheduling
Teams already on E2B: want to migrate to a self-hosted, hardware-isolated solution
Security-sensitive workloads: run untrusted code with hardware-level isolation and low overhead

zh.tag: 一键本地运行开源大模型的跨平台工具
zh.what: Ollama 是一个让用户轻松在本地运行和管理开源大模型的工具，支持 Kimi、GLM、DeepSeek、Qwen、Gemma 等众多模型。它提供命令行界面、REST API 和多种编程语言库，方便集成到现有应用或作为 AI 助手使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Ollama 的完整源代码，包括安装脚本、命令行工具、REST API 服务器、模型管理功能，以及 Python 和 JavaScript 客户端库的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，底层依赖 llama.cpp 等推理后端，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 和 Docker。
zh.hot: Ollama 已获得 18 万星标，本月新增近 3000，因其让本地运行大模型变得极其简单，成为开发者和 AI 爱好者的首选工具。
uses: 开发者希望在本地快速测试或运行开源模型，无需复杂配置
需要将大模型集成到自己的应用或代理中的团队
关注隐私，希望数据不出本机的个人用户

en.tag: Run open-source LLMs locally with one command
en.what: Ollama is a tool that lets users easily run and manage open-source LLMs locally, supporting models like Kimi, GLM, DeepSeek, Qwen, Gemma, and more. It provides a CLI, REST API, and libraries for multiple languages, making it easy to integrate into existing apps or use as an AI assistant.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Ollama, including installation scripts, CLI tools, REST API server, model management features, and documentation/examples for Python and JavaScript client libraries.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging inference backends like llama.cpp, supporting macOS, Windows, Linux, and Docker.
en.hot: With 180k stars and nearly 3k added this month, Ollama is the go-to tool for developers and AI enthusiasts due to its simplicity in running LLMs locally.
uses: Developers who want to quickly test or run open-source models locally without complex setup
Teams needing to integrate LLMs into their applications or agents
Privacy-conscious users who prefer to keep data on their own machines

zh.tag: 开源去中心化持续文件同步工具
zh.what: Syncthing 是一个持续文件同步程序，可在两台或多台电脑之间自动同步文件。它不依赖中心服务器，设备之间直接点对点连接，强调数据安全、防丢失与抗攻击。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心同步引擎、命令行与 Web GUI、Docker 部署说明、构建脚本以及各平台打包配置，另有完整的入门与安全文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖标准库与少量第三方库，提供 Web GUI，支持 Docker 运行，发布二进制带 GPG 签名并内置自动升级机制。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源同步工具，Syncthing 已积累 88781 颗星，本周新增 298 星并登上 Go 周榜第 14 名，说明在隐私与自托管需求下持续受到关注。
uses: 需要跨设备同步文件但不想依赖云服务的个人用户
注重数据隐私、希望自托管同步方案的小团队
在 NAS、服务器或 Docker 环境中部署文件同步的运维人员
研究去中心化同步协议与 Go 网络编程的开发者

en.tag: Open-source continuous file synchronization, decentralized by design
en.what: Syncthing is a continuous file synchronization program that keeps files in sync between two or more computers. It works peer-to-peer without a central server, prioritizing data safety, security against attackers, and ease of use.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based sync engine, CLI and web GUI, Docker deployment docs, build scripts, and packaging configs for multiple platforms, plus getting-started and security documentation.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go with a small set of dependencies, it ships a web GUI, supports Docker, and offers GPG-signed release binaries with a built-in auto-upgrade mechanism.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source sync tool, Syncthing has gathered 88,781 stars, adding 298 this week and ranking 14th on the Go weekly trending list, showing sustained interest in privacy and self-hosting.
uses: Individuals who want cross-device file sync without relying on cloud services
Small teams prioritizing privacy and self-hosted sync solutions
Ops engineers deploying file sync on NAS, servers, or Docker
Developers studying decentralized sync protocols and Go networking

zh.tag: 开源可自托管的轻量 Markdown 速记工具
zh.what: Memos 是一个开源、可自托管的短笔记工具，主打快速捕捉想法。用 Markdown 记录日常笔记、链接、工作日志和片段，按时间线组织，数据完全由自己掌控。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 后端服务、Web 前端界面、Docker 部署配置，以及浏览器 Web Clipper 扩展，整体是一个可直接自托管运行的完整应用。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 编写，前端为 Web 应用，支持 Docker 一键部署，数据存储于本地卷，采用 MIT 许可证。
zh.hot: 凭借 63k+ stars 和极简自托管理念长期受欢迎，本周新增 279 星并登上 Go 周榜第 18 名，反映出用户对数据自主和轻量笔记工具的持续需求。
uses: 希望数据完全自托管、注重隐私的个人用户
需要快速记录碎片想法和日志的知识工作者
想搭建轻量笔记服务的开发者和自托管爱好者

en.tag: Open-source, self-hosted lightweight Markdown note-taking tool
en.what: Memos is an open-source, self-hosted tool for short-form notes, built for quick capture. It stores daily notes, links, work logs, and snippets as Markdown in a chronological timeline that you fully control.
en.content: The repo contains a Go backend, a web frontend, Docker deployment configs, and a browser Web Clipper extension, forming a complete self-hostable application.
en.stack: Backend written in Go, with a web frontend, one-command Docker deployment, local volume storage, and MIT license.
en.hot: With 63k+ stars and a minimalist self-hosted philosophy, it stays popular; this week it gained 279 stars and ranked 18th on the Go trending list, reflecting ongoing demand for data ownership and lightweight note tools.
uses: Individuals who want fully self-hosted, privacy-focused note-taking
Knowledge workers needing to quickly capture fragmented thoughts and logs
Developers and self-hosting enthusiasts wanting a lightweight notes service

zh.tag: Kubernetes 上的有状态单例沙箱编排器，为 AI 代理运行时与强化学习提供隔离环境
zh.what: agent-sandbox 是 Kubernetes SIG Apps 下的项目，提供 Sandbox CRD 与控制器，用于声明式管理隔离、有状态、单例的工作负载。它把底层容器隔离交给 gVisor、Kata Containers 等安全运行时，自身专注于沙箱编排，适合 AI 代理运行时和强化学习等场景。
zh.content: 仓库核心是 Sandbox CRD 与控制器，另有 extensions 模块提供 SandboxTemplate、SandboxClaim、SandboxWarmPool 等扩展 CRD，并附有 examples、docs 站点与 roadmap。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 编写，基于 Kubernetes controller 模式与 CRD/Operator 机制，依赖 RuntimeClass 对接 gVisor、Kata Containers 等安全沙箱运行时。
zh.hot: AI 代理与强化学习需要大量隔离、有状态且可快速分配的运行环境，而 Kubernetes 原生 Deployment/StatefulSet 并不贴合这一模型；项目本周新增 114 star、总计 3893 star，登上 Go 周榜第 7。
uses: AI 代理平台团队：为每个代理会话提供隔离、有状态且可持久化的运行沙箱
强化学习工程团队：批量创建和回收训练/推理环境，缩短环境准备时间
Kubernetes 平台工程师：需要单容器 VM 式体验而非无状态副本或编号 StatefulSet 的场景
安全敏感场景：借助 gVisor/Kata 等运行时隔离不可信代码或第三方代理插件

en.tag: A Kubernetes sandbox orchestrator for isolated, stateful singleton workloads like AI agent runtimes and RL
en.what: agent-sandbox is a Kubernetes SIG Apps project that provides a Sandbox CRD and controller for declaratively managing isolated, stateful, singleton workloads. It delegates low-level container isolation to secure runtimes like gVisor or Kata Containers, focusing on sandbox orchestration for AI agent runtimes and reinforcement learning.
en.content: At its core are the Sandbox CRD and controller, plus an extensions module with SandboxTemplate, SandboxClaim, and SandboxWarmPool CRDs, along with examples, a docs site, and a roadmap.
en.stack: Written in Go, it follows the Kubernetes controller pattern with CRDs/operators, and relies on RuntimeClass to integrate secure sandbox runtimes such as gVisor and Kata Containers.
en.hot: AI agents and RL need many isolated, stateful, quickly allocatable runtimes, which native Deployments/StatefulSets don't fit well; the project gained 114 stars this week for 3,893 total, ranking 7th on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: AI agent platform teams: give each agent session an isolated, stateful, persistent runtime sandbox
RL engineering teams: batch-create and recycle training/inference environments to cut setup time
Kubernetes platform engineers: scenarios needing a single-container VM-like experience instead of stateless replicas or numbered StatefulSets
Security-sensitive workloads: isolate untrusted code or third-party agent plugins via gVisor/Kata runtimes

zh.tag: 纯 Go 读写 Excel 电子表格的高性能库
zh.what: Excelize 是一个用纯 Go 编写的库，用于读写 XLAM、XLSM、XLSX、XLTM、XLTX 等格式的电子表格文件，兼容 Microsoft Excel 2007 及以后版本生成的文件。它支持复杂组件的高兼容性，并提供流式 API 以处理海量数据的工作表。

zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言（要求 Go 1.26.0 或更高版本），依赖标准库及少量第三方包，通过 Go Modules 管理。
zh.hot: 凭借纯 Go 实现、高兼容性和流式处理能力，Excelize 已获得 20921 颗星，本周新增 23 星，位列 GitHub Trending Go 周榜第 17 名。
uses: 需要在 Go 应用中生成或解析 Excel 报表的后端开发者
处理大数据量电子表格并追求内存效率的数据工程师
希望避免依赖 Office 或 COM 组件的跨平台工具开发者

en.tag: Pure Go library for reading and writing Excel spreadsheets
en.what: Excelize is a pure Go library for reading and writing spreadsheet files in XLAM, XLSM, XLSX, XLTM, and XLTX formats, compatible with files generated by Microsoft Excel 2007 and later. It supports complex components with high compatibility and provides a streaming API for handling worksheets with huge amounts of data.
en.content: The repository contains the full Go library source code, examples, documentation, and CI/CD configurations, offering rich APIs for creating, reading, and modifying spreadsheets.
en.stack: Built in Go (requires Go 1.26.0 or later), depending on the standard library and a few third-party packages, managed via Go Modules.
en.hot: With its pure Go implementation, high compatibility, and streaming capabilities, Excelize has earned 20,921 stars, adding 23 this week and ranking 17th on the GitHub Trending Go weekly list.
uses: Backend developers who need to generate or parse Excel reports in Go applications
Data engineers handling large spreadsheets with memory efficiency requirements
Cross-platform tool developers who want to avoid Office or COM dependencies

zh.tag: 自托管音乐流媒体服务器，打造个人版 Spotify

en.tag: Self-hosted music streaming server — your personal Spotify
en.what: Navidrome is an open-source, web-based music collection server and streamer that lets you listen to your own library from any browser or mobile device. It implements the Subsonic/Airsonic API, so it works with a wide range of existing clients without paying for music subscriptions.

zh.tag: 生产级容器编排与集群管理的事实标准
zh.what: Kubernetes（K8s）是一个开源系统，用于跨多台主机管理容器化应用，提供部署、维护与扩缩容的基础机制。它源自 Google 十五年大规模生产经验（Borg 系统），并融合了社区最佳实践，现由 CNCF 托管。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Kubernetes 核心控制平面与节点组件源码（apiserver、kubelet、scheduler、controller-manager 等）、命令行工具 kubectl、测试套件、文档与构建脚本，并含 staging 目录用于发布可复用的库组件。
zh.stack: 以 Go 语言开发，依赖 etcd 作为集群状态存储，使用容器运行时接口（CRI）对接 Docker/containerd 等，构建依赖 Go 工具链或 Docker 环境（make / make quick-release）。
zh.hot: 作为云原生领域的基石项目，K8s 长期稳居 GitHub 最受关注仓库之列，累计 127,840 颗星，本周再增 574 星并进入 Go 语言周榜第 19 名，热度源于其不可替代的行业地位与持续活跃的社区贡献。
uses: 平台与 DevOps 工程师：用于搭建和管理生产级容器集群
云原生应用开发者：借助 K8s API 部署、扩缩容与运维微服务
企业架构师：评估多云/混合云容器编排与标准化方案
开源贡献者：参与核心组件开发、文档与社区治理

en.tag: The de facto standard for production-grade container orchestration and cluster management
en.what: Kubernetes (K8s) is an open source system for managing containerized applications across multiple hosts, providing the basic mechanisms for deployment, maintenance, and scaling. It builds on a decade and a half of Google's production experience with Borg, combined with community best practices, and is hosted by the CNCF.
en.content: The repo contains the source for Kubernetes core control plane and node components (apiserver, kubelet, scheduler, controller-manager, etc.), the kubectl CLI, test suites, docs, build scripts, and a staging directory for publishing reusable library components.
en.stack: Written in Go, it relies on etcd for cluster state, uses the Container Runtime Interface (CRI) to integrate with Docker/containerd and others, and builds via a Go toolchain or Docker environment (make / make quick-release).
en.hot: As the cornerstone of cloud native, K8s remains one of GitHub's most-starred repos with 127,840 stars, adding 574 this week to rank 19th on the Go trending weekly list, driven by its irreplaceable industry role and a continuously active community.
uses: Platform and DevOps engineers: build and operate production-grade container clusters
Cloud native developers: deploy, scale, and operate microservices via the K8s API
Enterprise architects: evaluate multi-cloud/hybrid container orchestration and standardization
Open source contributors: work on core components, docs, and community governance

zh.tag: 支撑 E2B 云与自托管的 Firecracker 微虚拟机运行时
zh.what: E2B Runtime 是 E2B 云背后的完整后端，包含控制面 API、节点编排器、VM 内代理、边缘路由和模板构建器。它为每个 AI 代理会话提供独立的 Linux 微虚拟机，可从快照秒级恢复、运行不可信代码，并在代理停止时暂停。
zh.content: 仓库包含控制面 API、节点编排器、VM 内代理、边缘路由、模板构建器，以及可在单机运行的 Embed 包。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 1.26 编写，基于 Firecracker microVM、userfaultfd 懒加载和写时复制根文件系统，采用 Apache-2.0 许可。
zh.hot: 作为 E2B 云的开源核心，它解决了 AI 代理安全执行不可信代码的痛点，今日新增 33 星，登上 Go 日榜第 12 名。
uses: AI 代理平台开发者 —— 需要为代理提供安全隔离的执行环境
基础设施工程师 —— 希望自托管或嵌入 Firecracker 微虚拟机运行时
企业团队 —— 需要专用部署和快照恢复能力
开源贡献者 —— 对 Go 和虚拟化技术感兴趣

en.tag: The Firecracker microVM runtime powering E2B Cloud and self-hosted deployments
en.what: E2B Runtime is the complete backend behind E2B Cloud, including the control-plane API, per-node orchestrator, in-VM agent, edge router, and template builder. It gives every AI agent session its own isolated Linux microVM that resumes from a snapshot, runs untrusted code, and can pause when the agent stops.
en.content: The repo contains the control-plane API, per-node orchestrator, in-VM agent, edge router, template builder, and an Embed package for single-machine use.
en.stack: Written in Go 1.26, built on Firecracker microVMs, userfaultfd lazy paging, and copy-on-write root filesystems, licensed under Apache-2.0.
en.hot: As the open-source core of E2B Cloud, it solves the pain of safely executing untrusted agent code, gaining 33 stars today and ranking #12 on the Go daily trending list.
uses: AI agent platform developers — need secure isolated execution environments for agents
Infrastructure engineers — want to self-host or embed a Firecracker microVM runtime
Enterprise teams — require dedicated deployments and snapshot resume capabilities
Open-source contributors — interested in Go and virtualization

zh.tag: 免费开源的跨平台 2D/3D 游戏引擎

en.what: Godot is a feature-packed, cross-platform game engine for creating 2D and 3D games from a unified interface. It ships with a comprehensive set of common tools and supports one-click export to desktop, mobile, web, and console platforms.

en.tag: Open-source professional finance terminal for market analytics, research and economic data

zh.tag: 专为 RTX 5090 打造的单卡 C++/CUDA 推理引擎
zh.what: NInfer 是一个从零编写的 C++/CUDA 推理引擎，专门针对单张 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 上的特定 Qwen 检查点进行极致优化。它支持文本、图像和视频输入，可通过本地 CLI 或兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic 的 HTTP API 调用。运行时高度特化：单 GPU、单常驻模型、启动时固定 1 到 8 个并发请求容量。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++/CUDA 源码、CMake 构建系统，以及五个预注册的模型工件（Qwen3.6-27B、Qwen3.8-27B、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 groupwise-int 与 nvfp4 版本）。每个工件内嵌 tokenizer、聊天模板和媒体前端资源，需从 Hugging Face 单独下载。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 C++20、CUDA 13.1+（仅支持 sm_120a 架构）、CMake 3.28+、Ninja，并依赖 FFmpeg 开发库（libavformat/libavcodec/libavutil/libswscale）和 libcurl。要求 64 位 Linux 系统。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1306 颗星，总星数达 1600，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 C++ 第 10 名。它精准切中了 RTX 5090 用户对本地高性能单卡推理的需求，且以极致特化换取性能，在 AI 推理社区引发关注。
uses: 拥有 RTX 5090 并希望在本地运行 Qwen 大模型的开发者
需要低延迟、高吞吐单卡推理服务的 AI 应用部署者
对 C++/CUDA 推理引擎实现感兴趣的系统级工程师
想通过 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容 API 接入本地模型的研究人员

en.tag: A from-scratch C++/CUDA inference engine tuned for single-GPU RTX 5090
en.what: NInfer is a from-scratch C++/CUDA inference engine purpose-built for explicitly registered Qwen checkpoints on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090. It handles text, image, and video prompts via a local CLI or OpenAI-/Anthropic-compatible HTTP APIs. The runtime is deliberately specialized: one GPU, one resident model, and a startup-fixed capacity of one to eight active requests.
en.content: The repo contains C++/CUDA source code, a CMake build system, and five pre-registered model artifacts (groupwise-int and nvfp4 variants of Qwen3.6-27B, Qwen3.8-27B, and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B). Each artifact embeds its tokenizer, chat template, and media frontend resources, and must be downloaded separately from Hugging Face.
en.stack: Tech stack: C++20, CUDA 13.1+ (sm_120a only), CMake 3.28+, Ninja, plus FFmpeg dev libraries (libavformat/libavcodec/libavutil/libswscale) and libcurl. Requires a 64-bit Linux system.
en.hot: It gained 1,306 stars this month (1,600 total), ranking #10 on GitHub Trending's monthly C++ list. It hits a sweet spot for RTX 5090 owners seeking high-performance local single-GPU inference, and its extreme specialization for speed has caught the AI inference community's attention.
uses: Developers with an RTX 5090 who want to run Qwen models locally
AI application deployers needing low-latency, high-throughput single-GPU inference
Systems engineers interested in C++/CUDA inference engine implementation
Researchers wanting to access local models via OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs

zh.tag: 基于 Citra 的开源 3DS 模拟器，支持 PC 与移动端。

en.tag: An open-source 3DS emulator based on Citra, supporting PC and mobile.

Homebrew developers — use the emulator for debugging and testing.
Game preservation researchers — for research and preservation of the 3DS ecosystem.

zh.tag: 轻量级多协议多源命令行下载工具

zh.hot: 作为一款经典且功能强大的下载工具，aria2 持续受到开发者欢迎，目前拥有超过 42,000 颗星，本周新增 198 星，位列 GitHub Trending 周榜 C++ 分类第 18 名。

喜欢命令行操作和自动化脚本的开发者或系统管理员
需要集成下载功能到自有应用中的开发者（通过 JSON-RPC/XML-RPC）
希望利用 BitTorrent 协议进行文件分发和共享的用户

en.tag: Lightweight multi-protocol & multi-source command-line download utility
en.what: aria2 is a lightweight, cross-platform command-line download utility that supports multiple protocols including HTTP/HTTPS, FTP, SFTP, BitTorrent, and Metalink. It can download files from multiple sources simultaneously, aiming to utilize maximum download bandwidth, and can even upload data from HTTP/FTP downloads to the BitTorrent swarm.

en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, with dependencies on libraries such as OpenSSL, libssh2, libxml2, and zlib, and supports compilation and execution on Linux, macOS, Windows, and other platforms.
en.hot: As a classic and powerful download tool, aria2 continues to be popular among developers, with over 42,000 stars and 198 new stars this week, ranking 18th on the GitHub Trending weekly list for C++.
uses: Users who need to download large files efficiently or accelerate downloads from multiple sources
Developers or system administrators who prefer command-line operations and automation scripts
Developers who need to integrate download capabilities into their own applications (via JSON-RPC/XML-RPC)
Users who want to utilize the BitTorrent protocol for file distribution and sharing

zh.tag: 用 ESP32-CAM 把老式水电气表数字化的边缘 AI 方案

需要低成本远程抄表方案的物业或小型公用事业运营者
对 ESP32 与 TensorFlow Lite 嵌入式 AI 感兴趣的开发者

en.tag: Edge AI on ESP32-CAM to digitize old water, gas and power meters
en.what: This is an edge-computing project built on the ESP32-CAM that photographs traditional mechanical water, power and gas meters and uses an on-device neural network to read the digits, turning analog meters into connected smart devices. Everything runs locally without the cloud, keeping it cheap and easy to deploy.
en.content: The repo ships C++ firmware source (code/), TensorFlow Lite models and training tools, a web configuration interface, 3D-printable casing files, MkDocs documentation, plus flashing tools and release packages.
en.stack: Written mainly in C++ and running on the ESP32, it integrates TensorFlow Lite Micro for on-device inference, with a web frontend and SD-card storage, built on the ESP-IDF toolchain.
en.hot: With 8,731 stars and 45 added today, it tops the C++ daily trending list; it applies edge AI to the very practical task of meter reading, with cheap hardware and thorough docs that appeal to DIY and IoT enthusiasts.
uses: DIY hobbyists wanting to connect old water, power or gas meters to their smart home
Teachers and students doing IoT or edge-computing coursework
Property managers or small utilities needing low-cost remote meter reading
Developers curious about ESP32 and TensorFlow Lite embedded AI

zh.tag: GTA 5 增强版的开源作弊菜单 DLL
zh.what: 《GTA 5: Enhanced》的实验性修改菜单（mod menu）：编译成 DLL 后用 Xenos 等注入器在游戏主菜单注入，按 INSERT 或 Ctrl+\ 呼出菜单。建议配合 FSL 把存档数据重定向到本地磁盘以保号，且需要关闭 BattlEye 反作弊（目前没有 BE 绕过，公共战局会被心跳检测踢出）。
zh.content: C++ 源码 + 一份简短 README，讲清使用步骤（FSL → 下载 nightly release → 注入器 → 关 BattlEye → 注入）和常见问题修复（掉线、存档消失、游戏起不来）。
zh.stack: C++，DLL 注入式单机/联机修改器，依赖外部注入器和 FSL，GPL-2.0；默认分支 enhanced。
zh.hot: 它面向 GTA5 增强版 Mod 社区的具体需求，并延续 YimMenu 项目路线，为需要开源菜单的用户提供选择。
uses: GTA5 单机玩家 —— 刷车刷钱体验全部游戏内容
mod 开发者 —— 基于源码学习或二次开发游戏菜单
离线娱乐 —— 关 BattlEye 后在私人战局整活

en.tag: The open-source mod menu DLL for GTA 5: Enhanced
en.what: An experimental mod menu for GTA 5: Enhanced: compile to a DLL, inject at the main menu with an injector like Xenos, then press INSERT or Ctrl+\ to open. Pairing with FSL (redirecting save data to local disk) is recommended to protect your account, and BattlEye anti-cheat must be disabled (there's no BE bypass — public sessions will kick you via heartbeat checks).
en.content: C++ source plus a short README covering the workflow (FSL → nightly release → injector → disable BattlEye → inject) and fixes for common issues (disconnects, missing saves, game won't launch).
en.stack: C++, a DLL-injection single/multiplayer mod menu relying on external injectors and FSL; GPL-2.0; default branch enhanced.
en.hot: It targets a concrete need in the GTA5 Enhanced modding community and continues the familiar YimMenu project line for users seeking an open menu.
uses: GTA5 single-player fans — unlock vehicles and cash to experience all content
mod developers — learn from or fork the source for custom game menus
Offline fun — mess around in private sessions with BattlEye off

zh.tag: OpenAI Whisper 语音识别模型的纯 C/C++ 高性能推理实现
zh.what: whisper.cpp 是 OpenAI Whisper 自动语音识别模型的 C/C++ 移植版，无需依赖即可运行。它面向多平台提供高性能、可离线、端侧部署的语音转文字能力。
zh.content: 核心实现集中在 include/whisper.h 与 src/whisper.cpp，其余依赖 ggml 机器学习库；仓库还包含 iOS、Android、WASM、Java 等多平台示例与绑定。
zh.stack: 纯 C/C++ 编写，基于 ggml 张量库，支持 ARM NEON、Metal、Core ML、AVX、Vulkan、CUDA、ROCm、OpenVINO 等硬件加速与整数量化。
zh.hot: 凭借 53668 颗星与本周 192 新增，它稳居 C++ 周榜第 13 名，是端侧语音识别最受信赖的开源方案之一。
uses: 需要在手机、树莓派等边缘设备上离线运行语音识别的开发者
希望把语音转文字集成进桌面或移动应用的工程师
研究 ASR 模型量化与跨平台推理优化的技术团队
对隐私敏感、要求数据不出本地的语音处理场景

en.tag: High-performance C/C++ inference of OpenAI's Whisper ASR model
en.what: whisper.cpp is a dependency-free C/C++ port of OpenAI's Whisper automatic speech recognition model. It delivers high-performance, offline, on-device speech-to-text across many platforms.
en.content: The core lives in include/whisper.h and src/whisper.cpp, with the rest built on the ggml ML library; the repo also ships examples and bindings for iOS, Android, WASM, Java and more.
en.stack: Written in plain C/C++ on top of the ggml tensor library, with ARM NEON, Metal, Core ML, AVX, Vulkan, CUDA, ROCm and OpenVINO acceleration plus integer quantization.
en.hot: With 53,668 stars and 192 added this week, it ranks 13th on the C++ trending list, cementing its status as a go-to open-source solution for on-device speech recognition.
uses: Developers needing offline speech recognition on phones, Raspberry Pi and other edge devices
Engineers integrating speech-to-text into desktop or mobile apps
Teams researching ASR quantization and cross-platform inference optimization
Privacy-sensitive scenarios where audio must stay on-device

zh.tag: 通用列式内存格式与多语言工具箱，加速数据交换与分析
zh.what: Apache Arrow 定义了一种高效的列式内存格式，并提供了多语言库，用于在不同系统间快速交换数据和在内存中进行分析。它包含 IPC 格式、Flight RPC 协议、ADBC 数据库连接等组件，旨在消除数据序列化开销。
zh.content: 仓库包含列式格式规范、IPC 格式、Flight RPC 协议定义，以及 C++、Python、Java、Go、JavaScript 等多语言实现，还有 Gandiva 表达式编译器和 ADBC 驱动。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 实现，提供 C GLib、.NET、Go、Java、JavaScript、Julia、Python 等语言绑定，依赖 LLVM（用于 Gandiva）和 CMake 构建系统。
zh.hot: 作为大数据和 AI 领域的关键基础设施，Arrow 被众多知名项目（如 Pandas、Spark、DuckDB）集成，拥有 17k+ stars，今日新增 7 星，持续受到关注。
uses: 数据工程师和分析师 —— 用于构建高效的数据管道和内存分析应用
数据库和查询引擎开发者 —— 集成 Arrow 格式以加速数据交换
AI/ML 工程师 —— 在特征工程和模型训练中利用列式内存格式
跨语言系统架构师 —— 使用 Arrow 实现多语言环境下的零拷贝数据共享

en.tag: Universal columnar format and multi-language toolbox for fast data interchange and in-memory analytics
en.what: Apache Arrow defines an efficient columnar in-memory format and provides multi-language libraries for fast data interchange and in-memory analytics across systems. It includes the IPC format, Flight RPC protocol, ADBC database connectivity, and more, aiming to eliminate data serialization overhead.
en.content: The repository contains the columnar format specification, IPC format, Flight RPC protocol definitions, and multi-language implementations in C++, Python, Java, Go, JavaScript, etc., plus the Gandiva expression compiler and ADBC drivers.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++, with bindings for C GLib, .NET, Go, Java, JavaScript, Julia, Python, etc., depending on LLVM (for Gandiva) and the CMake build system.
en.hot: As critical infrastructure in big data and AI, Arrow is integrated by many well-known projects (e.g., Pandas, Spark, DuckDB), with 17k+ stars and 7 new stars today, maintaining steady attention.
uses: Data engineers and analysts — for building efficient data pipelines and in-memory analytics applications
Database and query engine developers — integrating Arrow format to accelerate data exchange
AI/ML engineers — leveraging columnar memory format in feature engineering and model training
Cross-language system architects — using Arrow for zero-copy data sharing in multi-language environments

zh.tag: 跨平台开源 RGB 灯效统一控制工具，摆脱厂商软件
zh.what: OpenRGB 是一个开源的 RGB 灯光控制软件，通过逆向工程协议直接与硬件通信，让用户在一个应用里统一管理不同品牌的 RGB 设备。它支持 Windows、Linux 和 MacOS，无需安装任何厂商官方软件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 编写的核心应用、设备驱动、Qt 图形界面、命令行工具、SDK 以及文档和截图，是 GitLab 主仓库的镜像。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，图形界面基于 Qt，构建系统为 qmake/CMake，依赖 libusb、hidapi 等底层库与硬件通信。
zh.hot: RGB 生态碎片化严重，用户苦厂商软件久矣，OpenRGB 提供统一开源方案，已获 4476 星，本周新增 69 星，登上 GitHub C++ 周榜第 15 名。
uses: 拥有多品牌 RGB 设备、希望统一控制的 PC 玩家与装机爱好者
在 Linux 或 MacOS 上使用 RGB 硬件、缺乏官方软件支持的用户
希望通过 SDK 或命令行将灯效集成到第三方软件或自动化脚本的开发者
需要跨多台电脑同步灯效的网吧、工作室或展示场景运维人员

en.tag: Cross-platform open-source RGB lighting control without vendor software
en.what: OpenRGB is an open-source RGB lighting control application that talks directly to hardware via reverse-engineered protocols, letting users manage RGB devices from different brands in one app. It runs on Windows, Linux, and MacOS without requiring any manufacturer software.
en.content: The repo contains the C++ core application, device drivers, a Qt GUI, CLI tools, an SDK, plus documentation and screenshots; it is a mirror of the GitLab main repository.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ with a Qt-based GUI, built via qmake/CMake, and depends on low-level libraries like libusb and hidapi for hardware communication.
en.hot: RGB ecosystems are heavily fragmented and users are tired of vendor bloatware; OpenRGB offers a unified open-source solution, earning 4,476 stars with 69 added this week, ranking 15th on GitHub's weekly C++ trending list.
uses: PC gamers and builders with multi-brand RGB devices who want unified control
Linux or MacOS users whose RGB hardware lacks official software support
Developers integrating lighting into third-party software or scripts via SDK/CLI
IT staff needing synchronized lighting across multiple PCs in cafes, studios, or displays

zh.tag: 用 React 构建原生应用的跨平台框架
zh.what: React Native 让你用 React 和 JavaScript 编写代码，渲染为 Android、iOS 等平台的原生 UI 组件。它提供原生手势、文本缩放和无障碍支持，并可通过原生模块扩展平台能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含框架核心源码（C++/Java/Objective-C 等）、React 组件与 API、文档、示例和构建工具，以及贡献指南和社区支持文件。
zh.stack: 主要用 C++ 编写，同时包含 Java、Objective-C、JavaScript 等；依赖 React、Node.js、npm 包管理，并支持 Android/iOS 原生工具链。
zh.hot: 作为跨平台移动开发的事实标准，React Native 拥有超过 12.6 万 star，今日新增 22 星，持续吸引开发者关注。
uses: 移动应用开发者：用一套代码构建 Android 和 iOS 原生应用。
React 前端开发者：将 Web 技能扩展到移动端开发。
需要快速迭代的团队：利用 Fast Refresh 实现秒级热更新。
希望复用原生模块的项目：通过原生模块调用平台特定功能。

en.tag: A framework for building native apps with React
en.what: React Native lets you write React and JavaScript code that renders to native UI components on Android, iOS, and more. It offers native gestures, text scaling, accessibility, and extensibility via native modules.
en.content: The repo contains core framework source (C++/Java/Objective-C, etc.), React components and APIs, documentation, examples, build tooling, plus contribution guides and community support files.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with Java, Objective-C, and JavaScript; depends on React, Node.js, npm, and supports Android/iOS native toolchains.
en.hot: As the de facto standard for cross-platform mobile development, React Native has over 126k stars and gained 22 today, continuously attracting developer attention.
uses: Mobile app developers: build native Android and iOS apps with one codebase.
React web developers: extend web skills to mobile development.
Teams needing fast iteration: use Fast Refresh for instant updates.
Projects needing native modules: call platform-specific features from JavaScript.

zh.tag: Tenstorrent AI 加速器的开源算子库与底层内核编程模型
zh.what: TT-Metalium 是面向 Tenstorrent 硬件的底层内核编程模型，TT-NN 则是构建其上的 Python/C++ 神经网络算子库。它为 Tenstorrent 的 AI 加速卡提供从底层内核到高层算子的完整软件栈。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TT-NN 算子库、TT-Metalium 内核编程接口、模型示例（如 Llama 3.3 70B、Qwen 2.5 7B 等）以及安装文档和性能基准。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Python，依赖 CMake 构建系统，支持 Tenstorrent 的 Wormhole 和 Blackhole 等硬件。
zh.hot: 作为 Tenstorrent 开源软件栈的核心，随着 AI 硬件竞争加剧和开源生态发展，本周获得 13 颗新星，登上 C++ 周榜第 10 名。
uses: AI 硬件开发者：为 Tenstorrent 加速卡编写和优化底层内核
机器学习工程师：在 Tenstorrent 硬件上部署和优化神经网络模型
研究人员：探索新型 AI 加速器编程模型和算子实现

en.tag: Open-source operator library and low-level kernel programming model for Tenstorrent AI accelerators
en.what: TT-Metalium is a low-level kernel programming model for Tenstorrent hardware, while TT-NN is a Python/C++ neural network operator library built on top of it. It provides a full software stack from low-level kernels to high-level operators for Tenstorrent AI accelerators.
en.content: The repository contains the TT-NN operator library, TT-Metalium kernel programming interfaces, model demos (e.g., Llama 3.3 70B, Qwen 2.5 7B), installation docs, and performance benchmarks.
en.stack: Primarily C++ and Python, with CMake build system, supporting Tenstorrent Wormhole and Blackhole hardware.
en.hot: As the core of Tenstorrent's open-source software stack, it gained 13 new stars this week amid growing AI hardware competition and open-source ecosystem development, ranking 10th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: AI hardware developers: write and optimize low-level kernels for Tenstorrent accelerators
Machine learning engineers: deploy and optimize neural network models on Tenstorrent hardware
Researchers: explore novel AI accelerator programming models and operator implementations

zh.tag: 跨显卡厂商的通用超分与帧生成桥接工具
zh.what: OptiScaler 是一款游戏画质增强工具，允许玩家在已支持 DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS 的游戏中替换超分方案，并管理帧生成功能。它还能通过实验性 OptiFG 在 DX12 游戏中启用帧生成，甚至支持 Nukem 模组将 DLSSG 转为 FSR3 帧生成。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 源代码、编译脚本、安装说明、已知问题列表以及详细的 Wiki 文档，并提供稳定版和 nightly 版下载。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 DirectX 12、Vulkan 等图形 API，并涉及 DLSS、FSR、XeSS 等超分技术。
zh.hot: 凭借跨显卡厂商的通用超分与帧生成能力，解决了玩家在非 Nvidia 显卡上无法使用 DLSS 等痛点，已获得 10726 颗星，今日新增 60 星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 分类第 13 名。
uses: PC 游戏玩家：希望在非 Nvidia 显卡上使用 DLSS 或启用帧生成功能。
游戏模组爱好者：想要自定义游戏画质设置，替换超分方案。
技术研究者：对超分和帧生成技术跨平台实现感兴趣。
低配置玩家：通过帧生成提升游戏流畅度。

en.tag: Universal upscaling and frame generation bridge across GPU vendors
en.what: OptiScaler is a tool that lets you replace upscalers in games already supporting DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS, and manage frame generation. It can enable frame generation in DX12 games via experimental OptiFG, and supports the Nukem mod to convert DLSSG to FSR3 frame generation.
en.content: The repo contains C++ source code, build scripts, installation instructions, a known issues list, and detailed Wiki documentation, with stable and nightly releases available.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it depends on graphics APIs like DirectX 12 and Vulkan, and integrates upscaling technologies such as DLSS, FSR, and XeSS.
en.hot: With its cross-vendor upscaling and frame generation capabilities, it solves the pain point of using DLSS on non-Nvidia GPUs, earning 10,726 stars with 60 added today, ranking 13th on GitHub Trending daily list for C++.
uses: PC gamers: want to use DLSS or enable frame generation on non-Nvidia GPUs.
Game modding enthusiasts: want to customize graphics settings and replace upscalers.
Tech researchers: interested in cross-platform implementations of upscaling and frame generation.
Low-spec players: improve game smoothness through frame generation.

zh.tag: Google 出品的 C++ 微基准测试支持库
zh.what: google/benchmark 是一个用于对代码片段进行微基准测试的 C++ 库，用法类似单元测试框架。开发者只需在 benchmark::State 循环中编写被测代码并用 BENCHMARK 宏注册，即可获得稳定的耗时统计与结果输出。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心头文件与源码（如 registration.h、state.h）、CMake/Bazel 构建脚本、docs 用户指南与工具文档、Python 绑定以及完整的测试套件。
zh.stack: 使用 C++ 编写，库本身兼容 C++11，但构建需要 C++17 工具链；依赖 CMake 或 Bazel 构建，并提供 Python 绑定与 GoogleTest 风格 API。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 维护的基准测试事实标准，它已积累 10414 颗星，本周新增 23 星并登上 GitHub Trending C++ 周榜第 17 名，持续被性能敏感项目采用。
uses: C++ 开发者需要对函数或代码片段做微基准测试与性能回归对比
性能工程师在 CI 中监控关键路径耗时变化
库作者为开源项目提供可复现的基准测试套件
学习 C++ 性能测量方法与 GoogleTest 风格 API 的开发者

en.tag: Google's microbenchmark support library for C++
en.what: google/benchmark is a C++ library for microbenchmarking code snippets, with an API similar to unit testing frameworks. Developers write the code under test inside a benchmark::State loop and register it with the BENCHMARK macro to get stable timing statistics and reports.
en.content: The repo contains core headers and sources (registration.h, state.h), CMake/Bazel build scripts, docs including the user guide and tooling docs, Python bindings, and a full test suite.
en.stack: Written in C++, the library itself works with C++11 but requires a C++17 toolchain to build; it uses CMake or Bazel and ships Python bindings with a GoogleTest-style API.
en.hot: As Google's de facto standard for benchmarking, it has accumulated 10,414 stars, gained 23 this week, and ranks 17th on the GitHub Trending C++ weekly chart, remaining widely adopted by performance-sensitive projects.
uses: C++ developers who need to microbenchmark functions or code snippets and compare performance regressions
Performance engineers monitoring latency changes of critical paths in CI
Library authors providing reproducible benchmark suites for open-source projects
Developers learning C++ performance measurement and GoogleTest-style APIs

zh.tag: 无膨胀、零依赖的 C++ 即时模式 GUI 库
zh.what: Dear ImGui 是一个面向 C++ 的轻量级图形界面库，采用即时模式（immediate mode）设计，直接输出优化后的顶点缓冲，可在任何支持 3D 管线的应用中渲染。它不依赖外部库，渲染器无关，主要用于快速构建内容创作、可视化和调试工具。
zh.content: 仓库核心是少量 C++ 源文件（imgui.cpp、imgui_draw.cpp、imgui_widgets.cpp 等）与头文件，另含示例、后端绑定、文档和测试引擎。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，无外部依赖；通过后端适配 OpenGL、Vulkan、DirectX、SDL、GLFW 等渲染与平台层。
zh.hot: 作为游戏与工具开发领域的常青库，累计 76,266 星，本周仍新增 130 星并登上 C++ 周榜第 19 名，说明其即时模式 GUI 方案持续被广泛采用。
uses: 游戏引擎与编辑器开发者，用于快速搭建调试面板和内部工具
图形/渲染工程师，需要在 3D 管线中叠加轻量 UI
工具链与引擎团队，追求零依赖、可嵌入的 C++ 界面方案
学习即时模式 GUI 架构与 C++ 工程实践的学生和研究者

en.tag: Bloat-free, dependency-light immediate-mode GUI library for C++
en.what: Dear ImGui is a lightweight immediate-mode GUI library for C++ that outputs optimized vertex buffers renderable in any 3D-pipeline-enabled application. It is self-contained with no external dependencies and renderer-agnostic, aimed at building content creation, visualization, and debug tools quickly.
en.content: The repo centers on a handful of C++ source files (imgui.cpp, imgui_draw.cpp, imgui_widgets.cpp, etc.) and headers, plus examples, backend bindings, docs, and a test engine.
en.stack: Pure C++ with no external dependencies; backends adapt it to OpenGL, Vulkan, DirectX, SDL, GLFW, and more.
en.hot: A long-standing staple in game and tool development, it has 76,266 stars and still gained 130 this week, ranking 19th on the C++ weekly trending list, showing continued wide adoption of its immediate-mode approach.
uses: Game engine and editor developers building debug panels and internal tools fast
Graphics/rendering engineers needing lightweight UI overlaid on a 3D pipeline
Toolchain and engine teams wanting a zero-dependency, embeddable C++ UI solution
Students and researchers studying immediate-mode GUI architecture and C++ engineering

zh.tag: 把廉价 ESP32 触摸屏变成 Home Assistant 智能家居控制面板
zh.what: EspControl 是一个基于 ESPHome 的固件项目，让用户把便宜的 ESP32 触摸屏变成专用的智能家居控制面板。无需写代码或编辑 YAML，通过浏览器安装固件、连上 WiFi 并接入 Home Assistant 后，即可在屏幕内置设置页里挑选要显示的按钮和传感器。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ESP32 触摸屏固件源码（C++/ESPHome 配置）、浏览器网页安装器、屏幕内置的配置页面，以及文档站和示例截图（如 7 英寸与 4 英寸 4848S040 面板）。
zh.stack: 主要用 C++ 编写，构建在 ESPHome/ESP32 之上，通过 Home Assistant 原生 API 在本地网络通信，前端配置页为网页形式。
zh.hot: 本周新增 60 star、总数 1039，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜 C++ 第 20 名；它切中了智能家居用户想要「专用实体面板而非手机 App」的刚需，且免代码安装降低了门槛。

想为家人和访客提供简单实体按钮、避免他们使用 HA App 的场景

en.tag: Turn an affordable ESP32 touchscreen into a Home Assistant smart home control panel
en.what: EspControl is an ESPHome-based firmware project that turns affordable ESP32 touchscreens into dedicated smart home control panels. No coding or YAML editing is needed: install the firmware from a browser, connect to WiFi, add it to Home Assistant, then pick the buttons and sensors to show from the screen's built-in setup page.
en.content: The repo contains the ESP32 touchscreen firmware source (C++/ESPHome configs), a browser-based web installer, the on-device configuration page, plus a documentation site and example screenshots (e.g. 7-inch and 4-inch 4848S040 panels).
en.stack: Written mainly in C++ and built on ESPHome/ESP32, it talks to Home Assistant over the local network via the native API, with a web-based configuration front end.
en.hot: It gained 60 stars this week (1,039 total) and hit #20 on GitHub Trending's weekly C++ list; it taps the real demand for a dedicated physical panel instead of a phone app, while its no-code install lowers the barrier.
uses: Home Assistant users who want daily controls on a dedicated screen by the door, hallway, or bedside
Everyday households that don't want to code or edit YAML and prefer an out-of-the-box panel
Scenarios where family and guests get simple physical buttons instead of the HA app
ESP32/ESPHome tinkerers who enjoy customizing local smart home hardware

zh.tag: AI 代理技能，一键生成可验证的交互式系统架构图
zh.what: Archify 是一个 AI 代理技能，可将代码库或系统描述转化为精美的交互式系统地图。它支持五种图表类型、四种预设、明暗主题和内置品牌标识，并能生成自包含的 HTML 文件，方便演示和分享。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、文档、示例和生成器代码，支持通过 npx 命令安装到 Raven、Cursor、Claude Code 等代理。提供项目页面、场景指南和画廊，展示不同用例。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML，使用 TypeScript 生成确定性校验的 JSON IR，并输出 HTML、PNG、SVG、WebM 等格式。依赖 npx 进行安装，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 18k+ 星标和日增千星的势头，Archify 满足了开发者对可视化架构文档的迫切需求，尤其在 AI 辅助开发场景下，能快速生成可验证的图表，提升代码审查和沟通效率。
uses: 开发者希望在代码审查前快速生成架构对比图，确保变更可验证。
技术写作者或架构师需要为系统设计生成交互式演示文档，便于向团队或客户展示。
AI 代理用户希望将代码库映射为可视化图表，以便更直观地理解系统结构和数据流。

en.tag: Agent skill that turns codebases into beautiful, verifiable interactive architecture diagrams
en.what: Archify is an agent skill that transforms a codebase or system description into a polished, interactive system map. It supports five diagram types, four presets, dark/light themes, and built-in brand marks, producing self-contained HTML files for easy presentation and sharing.
en.content: The repository contains skill definitions, documentation, examples, and generator code, installable via npx into agents like Raven, Cursor, and Claude Code. It includes a project page, scenario guide, and gallery showcasing various use cases.
en.stack: Primarily HTML-based, using TypeScript to generate deterministically checked JSON IR, outputting HTML, PNG, SVG, WebM, and more. Installed via npx, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 18k+ stars and a daily gain of 1k, Archify addresses the urgent need for visual architecture documentation, especially in AI-assisted development, enabling quick generation of verifiable diagrams that boost code review and communication efficiency.
uses: Developers who want to quickly generate architecture comparison diagrams before code review to ensure changes are verifiable.
Technical writers or architects needing interactive presentation documents for system designs to share with teams or clients.
AI agent users who want to map codebases into visual diagrams for better understanding of system structure and data flow.

zh.tag: DHH 打造的精致现代 Linux 发行版
zh.what: Omarchy 是一个由 DHH（Ruby on Rails 创始人）打造的 Linux 发行版，注重美观、现代和明确的观点。它提供了一套完整的桌面环境，包括终端、编辑器、AI 工具等，并配有详尽的用户手册。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 manual/ 目录，内含 51 篇 Markdown 格式的手册章节，涵盖入门、导航、应用、配置等主题。此外还有安装脚本和配置文件，用于构建和定制系统。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Shell 脚本进行系统配置和安装，依赖 Linux 生态中的各种开源工具（如 Neovim、终端模拟器等）。手册使用 Markdown 编写，并托管在 learn.omacom.io。
zh.hot: 凭借 DHH 的知名度和对美观、现代体验的强调，Omarchy 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本周新增 6475 星，总星数达 34824，登上趋势榜第三。
uses: 喜欢 DHH 风格、追求开箱即用且美观的 Linux 桌面用户
希望从 Mac/Windows 迁移到 Linux 并希望有完整指南的用户
对 Linux 发行版定制和配置感兴趣的开发者

en.tag: A beautiful, modern & opinionated Linux distro by DHH
en.what: Omarchy is a Linux distribution created by DHH (creator of Ruby on Rails), focusing on beauty, modernity, and strong opinions. It provides a complete desktop environment including terminal, editor, AI tools, and comes with an extensive user manual.
en.content: The repository contains a manual/ directory with 51 Markdown chapters covering topics like getting started, navigation, applications, and configuration. It also includes installation scripts and configuration files for building and customizing the system.
en.stack: Primarily uses Shell scripts for system configuration and installation, relying on various open-source tools from the Linux ecosystem (e.g., Neovim, terminal emulators). The manual is written in Markdown and hosted on learn.omacom.io.
en.hot: Thanks to DHH's fame and the emphasis on beautiful, modern experience, Omarchy quickly gained popularity on GitHub, adding 6,475 stars this week to reach 34,824 total, ranking #3 on the trending list.
uses: Linux desktop users who appreciate DHH's style and want a beautiful, out-of-the-box experience
Users migrating from Mac/Windows to Linux who want a comprehensive guide
Developers interested in customizing and configuring a Linux distribution

zh.tag: Claude 社区插件市场，只读镜像，每日同步

zh.tag: 一键开启沉浸式多智能体课堂
zh.what: OpenMAIC 是一个开源的多智能体交互式课堂平台，让用户通过点击即可获得沉浸式的多智能体学习体验。它模拟真实课堂环境，由多个 AI 智能体扮演不同角色（如教师、学生），进行互动教学。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端界面（Next.js/React）、后端逻辑（LangGraph 编排）、智能体配置、部署模板（Vercel）、文档和社区资源。支持 OpenClaw 集成和 Lemonade 本地 AI。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Next.js 16、React 19、LangGraph 1.1 构建，支持多种 LLM 提供商（如 OpenAI、Anthropic）的 API 密钥配置。
zh.hot: 凭借创新的多智能体教学理念和极简的一键部署体验，在 GitHub 上迅速走红，24 小时内新增 907 星，总星数突破 2.2 万，位列 Trending 日榜第 5。
uses: 教育工作者：快速搭建 AI 驱动的互动课堂，探索新型教学模式。
AI 开发者：研究多智能体协作与交互，参考其架构和实现。
学习者：通过沉浸式多智能体对话，获得个性化学习体验。
开源爱好者：部署和定制自己的智能体课堂，参与社区贡献。

en.tag: One-click immersive multi-agent learning classroom
en.what: OpenMAIC is an open-source multi-agent interactive classroom platform that provides an immersive learning experience with one click. It simulates a real classroom where multiple AI agents play different roles (e.g., teacher, students) to conduct interactive teaching.
en.content: The repo includes frontend UI (Next.js/React), backend logic (LangGraph orchestration), agent configurations, deployment templates (Vercel), documentation, and community resources. Supports OpenClaw integration and Lemonade local AI.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, using Next.js 16, React 19, LangGraph 1.1, and supports multiple LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) via API keys.
en.hot: Its innovative multi-agent teaching concept and one-click deployment experience have made it viral on GitHub, gaining 907 stars in 24 hours, surpassing 22k total stars, and ranking #5 on the daily trending list.
uses: Educators: Quickly set up AI-driven interactive classrooms to explore new teaching models.
AI developers: Study multi-agent collaboration and interaction, referencing its architecture and implementation.
Learners: Gain personalized learning experiences through immersive multi-agent dialogues.
Open-source enthusiasts: Deploy and customize their own agent classroom, contributing to the community.

en.tag: Industrial prompt engine & template library for GPT-Image2
en.what: This is a prompt engineering resource library for the GPT-Image2 image generation model, featuring 500+ reverse-engineered cases and 20+ industrial templates, treating prompts as code for management and reuse. It provides a visual website for browsing and copying prompts, with continuous updates.
