Prompt engineers: learn from reverse-engineered cases and extract reusable skills.
Product teams: manage prompts as code for industrial generation workflows.

zh.tag: Cursor 官方插件规范与插件集合
zh.what: 这是 Cursor 官方维护的插件规范与插件仓库，定义了 agent 插件如何以独立目录加 .cursor-plugin/plugin.json 清单的形式组织。仓库同时收录了一批面向开发者工具、框架和 SaaS 产品的官方插件，覆盖代码审查、任务编排、学习记忆等场景。
zh.content: 仓库根目录下每个插件是一个独立目录，各自带有 .cursor-plugin/plugin.json 清单，README 用表格列出插件名、作者、分类与描述。已收录 teaching、continual-learning、cursor-team-kit、thermos、create-plugin、ralph-loop、orchestrate、pstack、advisor、grok-voice 等十余个插件。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，插件以清单文件加目录结构的形式分发，部分插件依赖 Cursor SDK 与 CLI 能力。整体是围绕 Cursor agent 生态的插件化扩展方案。
zh.hot: 本月新增 4683 star，总 star 达 7254，冲上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 3 名。Cursor 官方亲自下场定义插件规范，加上 agent 工具链正处风口，让开发者迅速涌入关注。
uses: Cursor 深度用户：想用官方插件扩展 agent 的代码审查、编排与学习能力
插件开发者：需要遵循官方规范脚手架并发布自己的 agent 插件
团队工程负责人：关注 CI、代码评审与本地自动化的内部工作流插件
AI 工具链研究者：想了解 agent 插件规范与生态的组织方式

en.tag: Cursor plugin spec and official plugin collection
en.what: This is Cursor's official plugin specification and plugin collection, defining how agent plugins are structured as standalone directories with a .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest. It also ships a set of official plugins for popular developer tools, frameworks, and SaaS products, covering code review, task orchestration, and learning memory.
en.content: Each plugin lives in its own directory at the repo root with a .cursor-plugin/plugin.json manifest, and the README tabulates name, author, category, and description. It already includes a dozen-plus plugins such as teaching, continual-learning, cursor-team-kit, thermos, create-plugin, ralph-loop, orchestrate, pstack, advisor, and grok-voice.
en.stack: The primary language is TypeScript, and plugins are distributed as manifest files plus directory structures, with some relying on the Cursor SDK and CLI capabilities. Overall it is a plugin-based extension scheme around the Cursor agent ecosystem.
en.hot: It gained 4,683 stars this month for a total of 7,254, reaching No. 3 on GitHub Trending's monthly chart. Cursor itself stepping in to define the plugin spec, amid the agent tooling boom, quickly drew developer attention.
uses: Heavy Cursor users: extend agent code review, orchestration, and learning via official plugins
Plugin developers: scaffold and publish their own agent plugins following the official spec
Team engineering leads: interested in internal workflow plugins for CI, code review, and local automation
AI tooling researchers: want to understand how agent plugin specs and ecosystems are organized

zh.tag: 用 Rust 写的本地优先罗技 Options+ 替代品
zh.what: OpenLogi 是一个开源的罗技外设配置工具，通过 HID++ 协议直接与设备通信，支持按键重映射、DPI 调节和 SmartShift 等功能。它无需罗技账号，不收集遥测数据，所有配置以本地 TOML 文件保存，强调隐私和本地优先。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个组件：OpenLogi GUI（GPUI 桌面应用，提供交互式鼠标图示、按键动作选择器、DPI 预设、SmartShift、RGB 键盘灯效、按应用配置文件等）、OpenLogi agent（后台服务，负责输入钩子和设备 I/O）以及相关的文档和配置示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，GUI 基于 GPUI（Zed 编辑器所用的框架），通过 HID++ 协议与罗技设备通信，支持 Logi Bolt、Unifying 接收器、蓝牙直连和 USB 连接。
zh.hot: 作为罗技官方 Options+ 的开源替代品，它解决了用户对官方软件臃肿、遥测和账号要求的痛点，在 Rust 社区和追求隐私的用户中迅速走红，GitHub 星标已超 8600，今日新增 115。
uses: 罗技外设用户：希望摆脱官方 Options+ 的臃肿和遥测，获得本地优先的配置体验
Rust 开发者：对 GPUI 桌面应用开发或 HID++ 协议实现感兴趣的开发者
隐私倡导者：拒绝账号绑定和数据收集，偏好开源软件的用户

en.tag: A native, local-first Logitech Options+ alternative in Rust
en.what: OpenLogi is an open-source Logitech peripheral configuration tool that communicates directly with devices via HID++, supporting button remapping, DPI adjustment, and SmartShift. It requires no Logitech account, collects no telemetry, and stores all configuration in local TOML files, emphasizing privacy and local-first principles.
en.content: The repository contains three components: OpenLogi GUI (a GPUI desktop app with interactive mouse diagram, per-button action picker, DPI presets, SmartShift, RGB keyboard lighting, per-application profiles), OpenLogi agent (background service owning input hook and device I/O), plus documentation and config examples.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, the GUI is built with GPUI (the framework used by Zed editor), communicates with Logitech devices via HID++ protocol, supporting Logi Bolt, Unifying receivers, Bluetooth-direct, and USB connections.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Logitech's official Options+, it addresses user pain points with bloat, telemetry, and account requirements, quickly gaining popularity in the Rust community and among privacy-conscious users, with over 8.6k stars and 115 added today.
uses: Logitech peripheral users who want a local-first config experience without bloat and telemetry
Rust developers interested in GPUI desktop app development or HID++ protocol implementation
Privacy advocates who reject account requirements and data collection, preferring open-source software

zh.tag: 一个菜单栏图标，替代十几个付费 Mac 应用
zh.what: Vorssaint 是一个免费开源的 macOS 菜单栏工具包，将音量控制、系统监控、窗口管理等多种实用功能整合到一个菜单栏图标中。它旨在替代多个付费应用，提供简洁统一的用户体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Swift 项目源码，包括菜单栏面板（如混音器、系统监控、窗口控制）、文档、CI 配置和发布资源。
zh.stack: 使用 Swift 开发，面向 macOS 14+ 和 Apple Silicon，采用 GPL-3.0 许可证，并依赖 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1.1 万星，总星数达 1.5 万，因其免费开源、功能强大且替代多个付费应用而广受欢迎，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。
uses: 希望减少付费 Mac 应用数量、追求性价比的用户
需要快速访问音量、系统监控和窗口管理的效率工作者
对开源和隐私保护有要求的 macOS 用户

en.tag: One menu bar icon replacing a dozen paid Mac apps
en.what: Vorssaint is a free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit that consolidates volume control, system monitoring, window management, and other utilities into a single menu bar icon. It aims to replace multiple paid apps with a clean, unified experience.
en.content: The repository contains the full Swift project source, including menu bar panels (mixer, system monitor, window controls), documentation, CI config, and release assets.
en.stack: Built with Swift, targeting macOS 14+ and Apple Silicon, licensed under GPL-3.0, and uses GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: Gained 11k stars this month, reaching 15k total, popular for being free, open-source, and replacing multiple paid apps, trending on GitHub.
uses: Users wanting to reduce paid Mac apps and seek cost-effectiveness
Productivity workers needing quick access to volume, system monitoring, and window controls
macOS users who value open-source and privacy

zh.tag: 用 Apple 虚拟化框架在 Mac 上启动虚拟 iPhone 的命令行工具
zh.what: vphone-cli 是一个 Swift 编写的命令行工具，借助 Apple 的 Virtualization.framework 和 PCC 研究用虚拟机基础设施，在 Apple Silicon Mac 上创建并启动虚拟 iPhone。它把下载固件、打补丁、DFU 恢复、安装自定义固件到首次开机整合成一条命令。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 主程序、跨平台编译的 guest 守护进程 vphoned、工具链安装与构建脚本（scripts/setup_tools.sh、build.sh），以及多语言 README 和演示截图。
zh.stack: 基于 Swift 与 Apple Virtualization.framework，依赖 Xcode/iOS SDK，并需要 python@3.13、aria2、openssl@3、ldid-procursus、keystone、libusb、ipsw 等通过 Homebrew 安装的工具。
zh.hot: 本月新增 6183 star，总 star 近 1.4 万，冲上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 12 名；在 Mac 上跑虚拟 iPhone 并支持越狱固件变体，对 iOS 安全研究和逆向社区极具吸引力。
uses: iOS 安全研究者，用于在隔离虚拟机中分析系统与固件
逆向工程师，需要可复现的越狱 iPhone 环境
开发者在 Mac 上测试 iOS 应用与设备行为
对 Apple 虚拟化与 PCC 基础设施感兴趣的技术爱好者

en.tag: CLI tool that boots a virtual iPhone on Mac via Apple's Virtualization.framework
en.what: vphone-cli is a Swift command-line tool that creates and boots a virtual iPhone on Apple Silicon Macs using Apple's Virtualization.framework and PCC research VM infrastructure. It bundles firmware download, patching, DFU restore, custom firmware install and first boot into a single command.
en.content: The repo ships the CLI app, a cross-compiled guest daemon called vphoned, toolchain setup and build scripts (scripts/setup_tools.sh, build.sh), plus multilingual READMEs and a demo screenshot.
en.stack: Built on Swift and Apple's Virtualization.framework, requiring Xcode/iOS SDK and Homebrew tools such as python@3.13, aria2, openssl@3, ldid-procursus, keystone, libusb and ipsw.
en.hot: It gained 6,183 stars this month for a total near 14k, ranking 12th on GitHub Trending monthly; running a virtual iPhone on Mac with jailbreak firmware variants strongly appeals to iOS security and reverse-engineering communities.
uses: iOS security researchers analyzing systems and firmware in isolated VMs
Reverse engineers needing a reproducible jailbroken iPhone environment
Developers testing iOS apps and device behavior on a Mac
Enthusiasts curious about Apple virtualization and PCC infrastructure

zh.tag: 为 AI 编程助手提供 38 种编辑级图表模板
zh.what: 这是一个为 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Codex 和 Pi）设计的技能包，提供 38 种编辑级质量的图表类型。它生成自包含的 HTML+SVG 文件，无需构建步骤或外部依赖，并强调无阴影、无 Mermaid 风格的设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含 38 种图表类型的定义，每种都有浅色、深色和全编辑三种静态变体，以及文档和截图。还包含语义模式系统，可将行为与布局分离，并支持从 draw.io 或 Mermaid 源重绘图表。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML 和 SVG，无 JavaScript 或外部图像依赖。设计为与 Claude Code、Codex、Pi 等 AI 代理兼容，并支持 Agent Skills 标准。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得超过 30.9k 星标，今日新增 437 星。它解决了 AI 生成图表质量差的痛点，提供了设计师认可的高质量模板，并持续更新新图表类型。
uses: 开发者使用 Claude Code 或 Codex 生成架构图、流程图等，避免手动调整样式
内容创作者需要快速制作编辑级图表，用于博客、文档或演示
团队希望统一图表风格，通过读取网站自动匹配品牌视觉

en.tag: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi
en.what: A skill pack for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex, and Pi, offering 38 editorial-quality diagram types. It generates self-contained HTML+SVG files with no build step or external dependencies, emphasizing a clean design without shadows or Mermaid-style output.
en.content: The repo contains definitions for 38 diagram types, each with minimal light, minimal dark, and full-editorial static variants, plus docs and screenshots. It also includes a semantic pattern system that separates behavior from layout, and can redraw draw.io or Mermaid sources.
en.stack: Primarily HTML and SVG, with no JavaScript or external image dependencies. Designed to work with AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Pi, and compatible with Agent Skills.
en.hot: The repo has gone viral on GitHub with over 30.9k stars and 437 stars today. It addresses the pain point of low-quality AI-generated diagrams by offering designer-approved templates, and it continuously adds new diagram types.
uses: Developers using Claude Code or Codex to generate architecture diagrams, flowcharts, etc., without manual styling
Content creators needing quick editorial-quality diagrams for blogs, docs, or presentations
Teams wanting consistent diagram styling, with automatic brand matching by reading a website

zh.tag: Google 时序预测基础模型，支持多变量与协变量
zh.what: TimesFM 是 Google Research 开发的预训练时序基础模型，用于时间序列预测。它采用 decoder-only 架构，在大量时序数据上预训练，能够进行零样本预测。最新 3.0 版本支持原生多变量预测和协变量，并在多个基准上排名第一。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型源码、预训练权重（Hugging Face）、示例和文档。代码结构分版本管理，最新 3.0 在根目录，旧版本归档在 v1 子目录。
zh.stack: 基于 PyTorch 实现，依赖 Hugging Face Transformers 等。提供 pip 包安装，支持 Python。
zh.hot: 近期发布 3.0 版本，带来多变量预测和协变量支持，在三大基准上排名第一，引发社区关注。今日新增 1618 star，总星标超 3 万。
uses: 时间序列预测研究者：用于零样本预测和模型对比实验
数据科学家：快速进行多变量预测，无需大量训练数据
企业应用开发者：集成到 BigQuery ML 或 Vertex AI 进行规模化预测

en.tag: Google's pretrained time-series foundation model for forecasting, with multivariate & covariate support
en.what: TimesFM is a pretrained time-series foundation model by Google Research for time-series forecasting. It uses a decoder-only architecture pretrained on diverse time-series data, enabling zero-shot forecasting. The latest 3.0 version natively supports multivariate forecasting and covariates, ranking #1 on multiple benchmarks.
en.content: The repo contains model source code, pretrained weights (on Hugging Face), examples, and docs. Code is organized by version; latest 3.0 is at root, older versions archived under v1.
en.stack: Implemented in PyTorch, leveraging Hugging Face Transformers. Installable via pip, Python-based.
en.hot: The recent 3.0 release with native multivariate forecasting and covariates, achieving #1 on three major benchmarks, has sparked interest. Gained 1,618 stars today, total over 30k.
uses: Time-series researchers: for zero-shot forecasting and model benchmarking
Data scientists: for quick multivariate forecasting without extensive training data
Enterprise developers: integrating with BigQuery ML or Vertex AI for scalable forecasting

zh.tag: 2小时从零训练64M超小语言模型，全流程开源教程
zh.what: MiniMind 是一个从零开始训练超小语言模型（64M参数）的开源项目，仅需3块钱成本和2小时即可在单张消费级GPU上完成训练。项目覆盖从数据清洗、预训练到SFT、RLHF、Agentic RL等完整链路，并扩展了视觉、多模态等变体。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的训练代码、模型结构定义、数据预处理脚本、训练教程和多个模型变体（如MiniMind-V、MiniMind-O）。所有核心算法均用PyTorch原生实现，不依赖高层封装库。
zh.stack: 基于Python和PyTorch，从零实现Transformer、MoE、LoRA、DPO、PPO等算法，不依赖transformers/trl等库。
zh.hot: 以极低成本（3元/2小时）训练LLM的颠覆性理念，加上全流程开源和教程性质，吸引了大量希望深入理解LLM的开发者。56k星标和日增近500星，说明其精准切中了个人开发者复现大模型的需求。
uses: LLM初学者：通过从零实现和训练，深入理解大模型内部机制，而非仅使用现成库。
个人开发者/研究者：在消费级GPU上快速实验预训练、微调、RLHF等全流程。
教育场景：作为高校或培训机构的AI课程实战项目，低成本复现前沿技术。
对模型压缩和高效训练感兴趣者：探索64M小模型的性能边界和扩展方向。

en.tag: Train a 64M LLM from scratch in 2h with full pipeline, open-source tutorial
en.what: MiniMind is an open-source project to train a tiny 64M-parameter LLM from scratch, costing only $0.4 and 2 hours on a single consumer GPU. It covers the full pipeline from data cleaning, pretraining to SFT, RLHF, Agentic RL, and extends to vision and multimodal variants.
en.content: The repo contains full training code, model architecture definitions, data preprocessing scripts, tutorials, and several model variants (e.g., MiniMind-V, MiniMind-O). All core algorithms are implemented natively in PyTorch without high-level wrappers.
en.stack: Built with Python and PyTorch, implementing Transformer, MoE, LoRA, DPO, PPO from scratch, without relying on libraries like transformers/trl.
en.hot: The disruptive idea of training an LLM for just $0.4 and 2 hours, combined with full open-source pipeline and tutorial nature, attracts developers eager to understand LLMs deeply. With 56k stars and ~500 daily additions, it hits the need for personal reproduction of LLMs.
uses: LLM beginners: gain deep understanding of LLM internals by implementing and training from scratch, not just using off-the-shelf libraries.
Individual developers/researchers: quickly experiment with pretraining, fine-tuning, RLHF on consumer GPUs.
Educational settings: as a hands-on project for AI courses, reproducing cutting-edge techniques at low cost.
Those interested in model compression and efficient training: explore the performance limits of 64M small models.

zh.tag: 聚合34家免费LLM提供商的统一API网关
zh.what: FreeLLMAPI 是一个开源项目，将数十家免费 LLM 提供商的免费额度聚合到一个 OpenAI 兼容的 /v1 端点后面。它提供智能路由、自动故障转移和加密密钥管理，让开发者无需管理多个 API 密钥即可访问大量免费模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 TypeScript 编写的 API 网关，支持 Docker 自托管、桌面应用（macOS/Windows）和 Android 应用。它提供了一个仪表板，用于监控每月 token 预算，并包含一个自动更新的模型目录。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，支持 Docker 部署，并提供桌面和移动端应用。依赖 OpenAI 兼容 API 标准，集成多个 LLM 提供商。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得近 2 万星标，日增 174 星。它解决了开发者对免费 LLM 资源分散、难以管理的痛点，提供了一站式解决方案。
uses: 个人开发者：快速集成多个免费 LLM，无需单独注册和付费。
原型开发：在项目初期使用免费模型验证想法，降低开发成本。
学习与研究：探索不同 LLM 的能力，进行对比实验。
自动化工具：为聊天机器人、内容生成等应用提供统一 API 接口。

en.tag: Unified API gateway aggregating 34 free LLM providers
en.what: FreeLLMAPI is an open-source project that aggregates free tiers from dozens of LLM providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint. It offers smart routing, automatic failover, and encrypted key management, allowing developers to access a vast array of free models without managing multiple API keys.
en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript-based API gateway with Docker self-hosting, desktop apps for macOS/Windows, and an Android app. It includes a dashboard for monitoring monthly token budgets and an auto-updating model catalog.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Docker deployment and desktop/mobile apps. Relies on OpenAI-compatible API standards and integrates multiple LLM providers.
en.hot: The project has gained nearly 20k stars with 174 new stars today, addressing the pain point of scattered free LLM resources by offering a one-stop solution.
uses: Individual developers: Quickly integrate multiple free LLMs without separate registrations and payments.
Prototyping: Validate ideas with free models in early stages, reducing development costs.
Learning and research: Explore capabilities of different LLMs and run comparative experiments.
Automation tools: Provide a unified API for chatbots, content generation, and more.

zh.tag: 为专业 AI 编程代理打造的安全验证技能注册表
zh.what: 这是一个面向 AI 编程代理的技能注册表，提供经过验证、测试且安全的能力包，用于扩展 Antigravity、Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等工具。它针对市面上超过 13% 的技能存在严重漏洞的问题，主打安全可信。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能包集合、MCP 服务器实现、文档站点以及贡献指南，以 TypeScript 编写的 CLI 和库形式发布到 npm。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript（100%）和 Node.js（>=22），使用 Nx Cloud 进行构建，采用 semantic-release 管理版本，并发布为 npm 包 @tech-leads-club/agent-skills。
zh.hot: 项目今日新增 265 星，总星数达 5658，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 4 名，反映出开发者对 AI 代理技能安全性的高度关注。
uses: AI 编程代理用户，希望安全地扩展 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具的能力
开发团队，需要为内部 AI 代理引入经过验证的技能包
安全工程师，关注 AI 技能供应链漏洞并寻求可信来源
技能贡献者，想要发布和维护经过审核的代理技能

en.tag: The secure, validated skill registry for professional AI coding agents
en.what: This is a skill registry for AI coding agents, offering verified, tested, and safe capability packages to extend tools like Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot. It addresses the fact that over 13% of marketplace skills contain critical vulnerabilities, focusing on security and trust.
en.content: The repo contains a collection of skill packages, an MCP server implementation, documentation site, and contribution guidelines, published to npm as a TypeScript CLI and library.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript (100%) and Node.js (>=22), using Nx Cloud for builds, semantic-release for versioning, and published as the npm package @tech-leads-club/agent-skills.
en.hot: It gained 265 stars today, reaching 5,658 total and ranking 4th on GitHub Trending daily, reflecting strong developer interest in the security of AI agent skills.
uses: AI coding agent users who want to safely extend tools like Claude Code and Cursor
Development teams needing verified skill packages for internal AI agents
Security engineers concerned about AI skill supply chain vulnerabilities and seeking trusted sources
Skill contributors who want to publish and maintain vetted agent skills

zh.tag: 开源 SEO 分析平台，支持 AI Agent 与 MCP 工具链集成
zh.what: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、外链审计与站点诊断等核心 SEO 工作流。它采用按量付费模式，用户只需接入自己的 DataForSEO API 密钥即可使用，无需订阅。同时，它内置 MCP 服务器和可复用的 Agent Skills，让 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等 AI 代理直接调用 SEO 数据完成自动化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的前后端应用代码与现代化 UI，支持 Docker 和 Cloudflare 自托管，内置 MCP 服务器以及预设的 Agent Skills（如 keyword-research、competitor-analysis、link-prospecting）。文档涵盖 API 密钥配置、Google Search Console 接入、SEO 成本参考及本地开发指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，前端采用现代 UI 框架，后端依赖 DataForSEO API 获取 SEO 数据，并通过 MCP 协议与外部 AI Agent 通信；支持 Docker 容器化部署与 Cloudflare 边缘托管。
zh.hot: 在 SEO 工具普遍昂贵且功能臃肿的背景下，它以开源、按量付费、可自托管的定位迅速获得关注；4,405 Stars 中本月新增 2,187 颗，登上 GitHub TypeScript 月榜第 17 名，其对 MCP 与 AI Agent 的原生集成进一步放大了开发者与增长团队的兴趣。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 无需订阅高价 SaaS，用自有 API 密钥低成本完成 SEO 监控与关键词研究。
AI 工程师 / Agent 开发者 —— 通过 MCP 将实时 SEO 数据接入 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等智能体，实现自动化内容策略。
增长与营销团队 —— 利用预设 Agent Skills 快速完成竞品分析、外链挖掘和排名追踪。
隐私敏感企业 —— 支持 Docker/Cloudflare 自托管，完全掌控数据与成本。

en.tag: Open-source SEO suite with AI agent & MCP integration for self-hosting
en.what: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, offering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlink audits, and site audits. It uses a pay-as-you-go model with your own DataForSEO API key instead of expensive subscriptions. It also exposes an MCP server and reusable Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw can interact directly with SEO data.
en.content: The repository contains a full-stack application with a modern UI, supporting Docker and Cloudflare self-hosting, along with a built-in MCP server and pre-built Agent Skills (e.g., keyword-research, competitor-analysis, link-prospecting). Documentation covers API key setup, Google Search Console integration, SEO cost references, and local development guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, it features a modern frontend UI, relies on the DataForSEO API for search data, and communicates with external AI agents via the MCP protocol. It supports Docker containerization and Cloudflare edge hosting.
en.hot: It gained rapid traction as a free, pay-as-you-go, self-hostable alternative to expensive and bloated SEO suites; with 4,405 stars and 2,187 added this month alone—ranking 17th on GitHub's monthly TypeScript trending list—its native MCP and AI Agent support has further driven interest from developers and growth teams.
uses: Indie developers and small teams —— Avoid expensive subscriptions by using your own API key for low-cost SEO monitoring and keyword research.
AI engineers and agent builders —— Feed real-time SEO data into Claude Code, OpenClaw, or other agents via MCP for automated content strategy.
Growth and marketing teams —— Use pre-built Agent Skills to quickly run competitor analysis, link prospecting, and rank tracking.
Privacy-conscious organizations —— Self-host via Docker or Cloudflare to maintain full control over data and costs.

zh.tag: 原生 macOS 启动器：热键、剪贴板历史，内存不到 100MB
zh.what: Tinycast 是一款完全原生的 macOS 启动器，用一个全局热键呼出命令面板，快速启动应用、搜索文件、查看剪贴板历史。它还内置计算器、快捷链接、Snippets 和 Apple 快捷指令，并能运行真实的 Raycast 扩展。
zh.content: 仓库为 Swift 编写的 macOS 应用源码，包含 SwiftUI/AppKit 界面、启动器与热键逻辑、剪贴板历史、Spotlight 文件搜索、计算器、Quicklinks、Snippets 等模块，并附有截图与文档。
zh.stack: 使用 Swift 6.0 与 SwiftUI/AppKit 构建，零第三方依赖，无 Electron、无遥测，要求 macOS 26 及以上，采用 AGPL-3.0 许可。
zh.hot: 今日新增 1179 星、总星 5595，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 4。它切中了用户对轻量、原生、无 Electron 的 macOS 启动器的需求，还兼容 Raycast 扩展。
uses: macOS 用户想用轻量原生启动器替代 Raycast/Alfred
注重隐私、不希望有遥测或 Electron 开销的开发者
需要剪贴板历史、快捷链接和 Snippets 的效率工具爱好者
想用 Swift 学习原生 macOS 应用开发的开发者

en.tag: A tiny native macOS launcher with hotkeys and clipboard history under 100 MB RAM
en.what: Tinycast is a fully native macOS launcher that summons a command palette with one global hotkey to launch apps, search files, and browse clipboard history. It also packs a calculator, quicklinks, snippets, Apple Shortcuts, and can run real Raycast extensions.
en.content: The repo contains the Swift source of a macOS app, including SwiftUI/AppKit UI, launcher and hotkey logic, clipboard history, Spotlight file search, calculator, Quicklinks, and Snippets modules, plus screenshots and docs.
en.stack: Built with Swift 6.0 and SwiftUI/AppKit, zero third-party dependencies, no Electron and no telemetry, requires macOS 26+, licensed under AGPL-3.0.
en.hot: It gained 1,179 stars today (5,595 total) and hit #4 on GitHub Trending daily. It taps demand for a lightweight, native, Electron-free macOS launcher that also runs Raycast extensions.
uses: macOS users seeking a lightweight native launcher to replace Raycast/Alfred
Developers who care about privacy and avoiding telemetry or Electron overhead
Power users wanting clipboard history, quicklinks, and snippets
Developers learning native macOS app development with Swift

zh.tag: 把任意 AI 代理变成科学家的技能库，覆盖生物、化学、医学等 163 个技能
zh.what: 这是一个开源的科学 Agent 技能库，提供 163 个即用型技能和 100+ 科学数据库，覆盖生物学、化学、医学和药物发现。它兼容 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI 代理，并遵循开放的 Agent Skills 标准，让任何 AI 代理都能执行科学任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、测试用例、文档和示例，以及一个可选的本地 AI 协同科学家工具 K-Dense BYOK。技能以标准格式组织，便于集成和扩展。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Agent Skills 标准，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 3.47 万星标和 17.5 万科学家用户，它填补了 AI 代理在科学领域应用的空白，成为最受欢迎的科学技能库。
uses: 科研人员：快速让 AI 代理执行文献分析、实验设计等任务。
开发者：为 AI 代理集成科学技能，构建垂直领域应用。
教育者：在教学中使用 AI 辅助科学探索，提升学生参与度。

en.tag: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist with 163 validated skills and 100+ scientific databases.
en.what: An open-source library of scientific Agent Skills, offering 163 ready-to-use skills and 100+ scientific databases across biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. It works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and other AI agents, following the open Agent Skills standard, enabling any agent to perform scientific tasks.
en.content: The repo contains skill definitions, tests, documentation, examples, and an optional local AI co-scientist tool K-Dense BYOK. Skills are organized in a standard format for easy integration and extension.
en.stack: Primarily Python-based, relying on the Agent Skills standard, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 34.7k stars and 175k+ scientist users, it fills a gap in AI agent applications for science, becoming the most popular scientific skills library.
uses: Researchers: quickly enable AI agents to perform literature analysis, experiment design, etc.
Developers: integrate scientific skills into AI agents to build domain-specific applications.
Educators: use AI-assisted scientific exploration in teaching to boost student engagement.

zh.tag: 截图秒变前端代码的AI工具
zh.what: 这是一个利用AI将截图、设计稿、Figma设计甚至屏幕录制转换为干净、可运行的前端代码（如HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue）的工具。用户只需上传图片或录制视频，即可获得对应的功能原型或代码实现。
zh.content: 仓库包含React/Vite前端和FastAPI后端，支持多种技术栈（HTML+Tailwind、React+Tailwind、Vue+Tailwind等），并集成多个AI模型（如Gemini、GPT、Claude）用于代码生成和图像处理。
zh.stack: 主要使用Python（FastAPI）作为后端，前端采用React/Vite，依赖OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini等AI模型API，以及Replicate用于图像生成和编辑。
zh.hot: 凭借75.5K星标和今日新增326星，该工具因其直观的“截图转代码”功能而广受欢迎，大幅降低了前端开发门槛，尤其适合快速原型制作。
uses: 前端开发者快速将设计稿或截图转化为可用的HTML/CSS/React代码
产品经理或设计师验证UI概念，无需手动编写代码
教育场景中教学前端开发，通过示例直观展示代码生成

en.tag: Turn screenshots into clean frontend code with AI
en.what: This is a tool that uses AI to convert screenshots, mockups, Figma designs, and even screen recordings into clean, functional frontend code (e.g., HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue). Users upload an image or recording and get a working prototype or code implementation.
en.content: The repo includes a React/Vite frontend and a FastAPI backend, supporting multiple stacks (HTML+Tailwind, React+Tailwind, Vue+Tailwind, etc.) and integrating several AI models (e.g., Gemini, GPT, Claude) for code generation and image processing.
en.stack: Primarily Python (FastAPI) backend with React/Vite frontend, relying on AI model APIs from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Replicate for image generation/editing.
en.hot: With 75.5K stars and +326 today, this tool is popular for its intuitive 'screenshot-to-code' capability, significantly lowering the barrier for frontend development, especially for rapid prototyping.
uses: Frontend developers quickly convert design mockups or screenshots into usable HTML/CSS/React code
Product managers or designers validate UI concepts without manually writing code
Educational settings for teaching frontend development by visually demonstrating code generation

zh.tag: 开源零加价 LLM 网关，统一路由 BYOK 与 1000+ 模型

zh.hot: 2.87 万星标，日增 150，登上日榜第 6。它让非专家也能一键去除模型审查，且效果媲美人工调优，引发广泛关注。

en.tag: Fully automatic censorship removal for language models via TPE-based optimization
en.what: Heretic is a tool that removes censorship (safety alignment) from transformer-based language models without expensive post-training. It combines directional ablation (abliteration) with a TPE-based parameter optimizer to automatically find high-quality parameters that minimize refusals and KL divergence from the original model, preserving intelligence.
en.content: The repository contains a full Python implementation, CLI, automatic optimization pipeline, support for dense, MoE, and hybrid models (e.g., Qwen3.5), along with example configs and benchmark results.
en.stack: Built with Python, leveraging PyTorch, Transformers, and Optuna for TPE-based optimization, implementing directional ablation.
en.hot: With 28.7k stars and +150 daily, ranking #6 on the daily trend, it enables non-experts to decensor models with one command, rivaling manual abliteration, sparking wide interest.
uses: AI researchers and developers seeking to remove model censorship quickly without performance loss.
Practitioners interested in safety alignment mechanisms and directional ablation techniques.
General users who need to customize model behavior or remove content restrictions without deep technical knowledge.

zh.hot: 在 AI 代理需要访问真实网页但常被反爬拦截的背景下，该仓库提供了有效的解决方案，今日新增 117 星，总星数达 9236，登上 JavaScript 趋势榜第六。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要让代理访问受保护网站（如搜索、社交媒体）时，可集成此浏览器绕过检测。
数据采集工程师：用于爬取 Cloudflare 保护的网站，替代易被识别的无头浏览器。
自动化测试人员：作为 Puppeteer/Playwright 的替代，进行需要真实浏览器指纹的测试。
个人 AI 助手项目：如 jo，需要稳定、低内存的浏览器后端。

en.tag: Stealth headless browser for AI agents, bypassing bot detection
en.what: camofox-browser is an anti-detection browser server for AI agents, built on Camoufox (a Firefox fork). It bypasses Cloudflare and bot detection via C++-level fingerprint spoofing, and offers a REST API for agents, serving as a drop-in replacement for Puppeteer/Playwright.
en.content: The repository contains a full browser server implementation with REST API, element refs, session isolation, cookie import, file upload, proxy support, and more. It includes startup scripts and an npm package for easy integration.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript and Node.js, powered by Camoufox (a C++-patched Firefox fork), exposing functionality via REST API. Leverages npm ecosystem and runs cross-platform.
en.hot: With AI agents needing to browse real websites but often blocked by anti-bot measures, this repo offers a working solution, gaining 117 stars today and reaching 9236 total, ranking #6 on the JavaScript trending list.
uses: AI agent developers: integrate this browser to access protected sites (e.g., search, social media) while bypassing detection.
Data scraping engineers: use it to crawl Cloudflare-protected websites, replacing easily fingerprintable headless browsers.
Automation testers: as a drop-in replacement for Puppeteer/Playwright for tests requiring real browser fingerprints.
Personal AI assistant projects: like jo, needing a stable, low-memory browser backend.

zh.tag: Stremio 官方 Web UI，自由流媒体一站式媒体中心
zh.what: Stremio Web 是 Stremio 的官方网页界面，提供自由流媒体体验。它允许用户通过插件发现电影、剧集和频道，并同步跨设备的媒体库。

开发者想要学习如何构建基于 WASM 的复杂前端应用。

en.what: Stremio Web is the official web UI of Stremio, offering freedom to stream. It lets users discover movies, series, and channels via addons, and syncs library and progress across devices.

Media enthusiasts who enjoy extending functionality via addons.

zh.tag: 免费领取高颜值 .is-a.dev 子域名的开源注册服务
zh.what: is-a.dev 是一个面向开发者的免费子域名服务，任何人都可以为自己搭建的个人网站、博客或项目申请一个简洁好看的 .is-a.dev 子域名。申请者通过向仓库提交 Pull Request 来登记自己的 DNS 记录，合并后几分钟内即可生效。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 domains 目录，里面按子域名存放一份份 JSON 配置文件，记录该子域名的 DNS 记录；此外还有文档链接、滥用举报模板和 Discord 社区入口。

预算有限但希望拥有专业感网址的学生与开源爱好者
需要为小型项目或演示站点快速绑定域名的团队
想学习 DNS 记录与 GitHub PR 协作流程的新手

en.tag: A free service giving developers a sweet-looking .is-a.dev subdomain
en.what: is-a.dev is a free subdomain service that lets any developer claim a clean, sweet-looking .is-a.dev subdomain for their personal site, blog, or project. You register by opening a pull request with your DNS records, and they go live within minutes of being merged.

uses: Indie developers wanting a clean domain for a personal homepage, blog, or portfolio
Students and open-source hobbyists who want a professional-looking URL on a budget
Teams needing a quick domain for a small project or demo site
Beginners learning DNS records and the GitHub PR workflow

zh.tag: 用属性在HTML中直接实现AJAX、CSS过渡、WebSocket和SSE的轻量库
zh.what: htmx 是一个轻量级、无依赖的 JavaScript 库，允许你直接在 HTML 中使用属性（如 hx-post、hx-swap）来发起 AJAX 请求、应用 CSS 过渡、使用 WebSocket 和服务器发送事件。它旨在通过扩展 HTML 的超文本能力，简化现代用户界面的构建，让你无需编写大量 JavaScript 代码即可实现动态交互。
zh.content: 仓库包含 htmx 的源代码、文档网站、示例、扩展（如 ws、sse）以及贡献指南。核心是一个约 14k min.gz'd 的 JavaScript 文件，可通过 CDN 或 npm 安装。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，无外部依赖。开发依赖包括 Node.js 和 npm，用于本地开发和测试。
zh.hot: htmx 因其极简的编程模型而广受欢迎，让开发者无需编写复杂 JavaScript 即可实现现代交互。尽管今日新增 star 不多（32），但总星数已接近 5 万，反映出其在开发者社区中的持续热度。
uses: 后端开发者希望用简单方式增强 HTML 页面交互，而不想写大量前端 JS
全栈开发者寻求轻量级替代 React/Vue 的方案，用于快速原型或小型项目
喜欢 HATEOAS 和超媒体理念的开发者，希望构建符合 REST 架构的 Web 应用

en.tag: A lightweight library that lets you use AJAX, CSS Transitions, WebSockets and Server Sent Events directly in HTML with attributes
en.what: htmx is a lightweight, dependency-free JavaScript library that allows you to use AJAX, CSS Transitions, WebSockets and Server Sent Events directly in HTML using attributes like hx-post and hx-swap. It aims to simplify building modern user interfaces by extending HTML's hypertext capabilities, enabling dynamic interactions without writing much JavaScript.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of htmx, documentation website, examples, extensions (like ws, sse), and contribution guidelines. The core is a ~14k min.gz'd JavaScript file that can be installed via CDN or npm.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript with no external dependencies. Development dependencies include Node.js and npm for local development and testing.
en.hot: htmx is popular for its minimalist programming model, allowing developers to implement modern interactions without writing complex JavaScript. Although today's new stars are modest (32), the total star count is approaching 50k, reflecting its sustained popularity in the developer community.
uses: Backend developers who want to enhance HTML page interactions in a simple way without writing lots of frontend JS
Full-stack developers seeking a lightweight alternative to React/Vue for quick prototypes or small projects
Developers who embrace HATEOAS and hypermedia principles to build RESTful web applications

zh.tag: 定制官方 Spotify 客户端的命令行工具

希望为 Spotify 开发主题或扩展的开发者
需要在多平台统一定制 Spotify 的进阶玩家

zh.tag: 基于 WebGL2/WebGPU 的开源浏览器 3D 游戏引擎

zh.hot: 凭借 16847 颗星和本月新增 371 星登上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 月榜第 15 名，反映出 Web 端 3D 与 WebGPU 生态持续升温，开发者对轻量、免插件的浏览器游戏引擎需求旺盛。
uses: Web 前端与全栈开发者，希望在浏览器中快速构建 3D 游戏或交互应用
游戏与可视化团队，需要免插件、跨设备的 3D 发布方案
AR/VR 开发者，利用 WebXR 打造沉浸式网页体验
教育或产品演示场景，用 3D 交互提升内容表现力

en.tag: Open-source browser 3D game engine built on WebGL2 and WebGPU
en.what: PlayCanvas Engine is an open-source game engine for building interactive 3D apps, games and visualizations that run in any browser on any device. It supports WebGL2, WebGPU, WebXR and glTF, letting developers ship cross-platform 3D experiences without plugins.
en.content: The repo contains the engine's core source (rendering, entity-component system, physics, animation, asset loading), examples, user manual and API reference, plus READMEs in English, Chinese, Japanese and Korean.
en.stack: Written in JavaScript and installable via npm (npm install playcanvas), it relies on WebGL2/WebGPU graphics APIs and integrates glTF asset support and WebXR.

uses: Web front-end and full-stack developers who want to build 3D games or interactive apps in the browser
Game and visualization teams needing a plugin-free, cross-device 3D publishing solution
AR/VR developers building immersive web experiences with WebXR
Education or product demo scenarios that use 3D interaction to enhance engagement

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理像最懒的高级工程师一样写最少代码
zh.what: Ponytail 是一个 JavaScript 库/技能包，注入到 AI 代理中，使其倾向于生成极简代码，避免过度工程。它通过内置的“懒人”提示和规则，让代理在实现功能时优先使用浏览器原生能力或现有依赖，从而大幅减少代码量、成本和延迟。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、CLI 工具、基准测试脚本和文档。核心是注入到代理的提示词和规则集，支持 20 多种代理；基准测试展示了在真实仓库上的代码量减少（平均 54%，最高 94%）。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 JavaScript，通过 npm 分发，兼容多种 AI 代理（如 Claude Code）。依赖较少，核心是提示词工程。
zh.hot: 11 万星且日增近千，因为直击 AI 编程痛点：过度工程。它用幽默的“懒人”形象，承诺减少代码量、成本和延迟，且保持安全，引发开发者共鸣。
uses: AI 编程工具使用者：希望减少 AI 生成的冗余代码，提升代码质量。
团队技术负责人：想降低维护成本，让 AI 代理产出更简洁的代码。
对提示工程感兴趣者：学习如何通过提示词约束 AI 行为。

en.tag: Makes your AI agent write minimal code like a lazy senior dev
en.what: Ponytail is a JavaScript library/skill pack that injects a 'lazy senior dev' mindset into AI agents, pushing them to write minimal code and avoid over-engineering. It uses built-in prompts and rules to make agents prefer native browser features or existing dependencies, cutting code volume, cost, and latency.
en.content: The repo contains the core library, CLI tools, benchmark scripts, and docs. The core is a set of prompts and rules injected into agents, supporting 20+ agents; benchmarks show code reduction (mean 54%, up to 94%) on real repos.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, distributed via npm, compatible with 20+ AI agents (e.g., Claude Code). Minimal dependencies, core is prompt engineering.
en.hot: 111k stars with ~1k daily, because it hits the pain point of AI coding: over-engineering. With a humorous 'lazy dev' persona, it promises less code, lower cost, and faster execution while staying safe, resonating with developers.
uses: AI coding tool users: want to reduce redundant code and improve code quality.
Tech leads: aim to lower maintenance costs and get cleaner code from AI agents.
Prompt engineering enthusiasts: learn how to constrain AI behavior via prompts.

zh.tag: AI 代理全自动管理 YouTube 频道，免费 Gemini 可用

uses: 内容创作者：希望自动化视频生成和发布，节省时间。
营销人员：需要批量生成视频内容以扩大品牌影响力。
开发者：对 AI 代理工作流和自动化管道感兴趣，可二次开发。
初学者：无需编程经验，通过引导式设置即可上手。

en.tag: Fully automated YouTube channel management with AI agents, works with free Gemini or OpenAI
en.what: This is a tool that uses AI agents to fully automate YouTube channel management. It can automatically create, optimize, and publish videos, running 24/7 without manual intervention. It works with the free Gemini API or OpenAI, and requires no coding.

uses: Content creators: who want to automate video generation and publishing to save time.
Marketers: needing to produce video content at scale for brand reach.
Developers: interested in AI agent workflows and automation pipelines, can customize.
Beginners: no coding experience needed, guided setup makes it easy to start.

zh.tag: 让 AI 写作更像人：检测并改写 AI 腔的智能体技能
zh.what: 这是一个可移植的 AI 代理技能，用于审计和重写内容，去除常见的 AI 写作模式（如“Certainly!”、空洞的修饰语等）。它支持重写、检测和原地编辑三种模式，并可选语音风格（casual/professional 等），兼容 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex 等主流代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个可安装的 skill 定义（SKILL.md）、检测引擎（JavaScript 实现）、演示 GIF 和文档。核心是一个规则驱动的检测器，可标记 13 类 AI 写作模式，并执行多轮重写以彻底清除残留。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，采用规则/模式匹配而非机器学习，轻量且可嵌入任何 agentskills.io 兼容的代理。无外部依赖，MIT 许可。
zh.hot: 3,598 星且单日新增 133，登上 JavaScript 趋势榜第 8。AI 生成内容泛滥，开发者急需让输出“去 AI 味”的工具，而它恰好以 agent skill 形式即插即用。
uses: 内容创作者：用 Claude Code 等代理批量改写文章，去除 AI 腔，提升可读性。
开发者：在 CI 或本地用 Detect 模式审计 AI 生成的文档/提交信息，避免机械感。
团队：统一内容风格，通过 voice profile 定制专业、轻松或温暖等语气。
AI 代理开发者：集成此 skill 到自定义代理，增强文本后处理能力。

en.tag: Audit & rewrite AI-sounding text into natural prose, as a portable agent skill
en.what: A portable skill for AI agents that audits and rewrites content to remove common AI writing patterns ('AI-isms'). It offers three modes—rewrite, detect, and edit-in-place—plus optional voice profiles, and works with agents like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Codex.
en.content: The repo contains a portable skill definition (SKILL.md), a JavaScript-based detection engine, a demo GIF, and docs. The core is a rule-driven detector that flags 13 categories of AI patterns and performs multi-pass rewriting to catch leftovers.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, using rule/pattern matching rather than ML, so it's lightweight and embeddable in any agentskills.io-compatible agent. No external dependencies, MIT licensed.
en.hot: With 3,598 stars and +133 today, it hit #8 on the JavaScript trending list. As AI-generated content floods the web, developers crave tools to make output sound human, and this skill plugs directly into their favorite agents.
uses: Content creators: use with Claude Code to rewrite articles in bulk, removing AI-isms for better readability.
Developers: run Detect mode in CI or locally to audit AI-generated docs/commit messages for robotic tone.
Teams: standardize content tone via voice profiles (casual, professional, warm, etc.).
Agent builders: integrate this skill into custom agents to enhance text post-processing.

zh.tag: 基于 GPUI 的 Rust 跨平台桌面 UI 组件库
zh.what: GPUI Kit 是一个用于构建高性能跨平台桌面应用的 Rust 框架，提供 60+ 生产级 UI 组件和完整的数据、布局、编辑能力。它基于 Zed 编辑器使用的 GPUI 构建，并支持 JavaScript 扩展。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个子 crate：gpui-base（无样式行为、状态和基础设施）、gpui-shell（JavaScript 扩展）、gpui-component（完整样式化 UI 系统）。主 crate 重新导出所有层，应用只需依赖 gpui-kit 即可。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 GPUI（Zed 编辑器使用的 GPU 加速 UI 框架），支持 macOS、Windows、Linux，集成 Tree-sitter、LSP 等。
zh.hot: 凭借 13.9K stars 和日增 179 登顶 Rust 日榜，因为它是首个将 GPUI 从 Zed 中解耦并打包成通用组件库的项目，填补了 Rust 桌面 UI 生态的空白。
uses: Rust 开发者希望用 Rust 构建跨平台桌面应用，并追求高性能和原生体验。
需要数据表格、虚拟列表、代码编辑器等复杂组件的桌面应用开发场景。
希望复用 Zed 编辑器 UI 能力但不想直接依赖 Zed 的团队。
对 GPUI 感兴趣，想学习其架构或基于 gpui-base 自定义 UI 系统的开发者。

en.tag: Rust desktop UI component library built on GPUI for cross-platform apps
en.what: GPUI Kit is a Rust framework for building high-performance cross-platform desktop apps, offering 60+ production-ready UI components and full data, layout, and editing capabilities. It is built on GPUI, the UI framework used by Zed editor, and supports JavaScript extensions.
en.content: The repo contains three sub-crates: gpui-base (unstyled behavior, state, and infrastructure), gpui-shell (JavaScript extensions), and gpui-component (complete styled UI system). The main crate re-exports all layers, so apps only need to depend on gpui-kit.
en.stack: Built on Rust and GPUI (GPU-accelerated UI framework used by Zed editor), supports macOS, Windows, Linux, integrates Tree-sitter, LSP, etc.
en.hot: With 13.9K stars and +179 today, it tops the Rust daily chart as the first project to decouple GPUI from Zed and package it as a general-purpose component library, filling a gap in the Rust desktop UI ecosystem.
uses: Rust developers who want to build cross-platform desktop apps with high performance and native feel.
Desktop app development requiring complex components like data tables, virtual lists, and code editors.
Teams that want to reuse Zed's UI capabilities without depending on Zed directly.
Developers interested in GPUI, learning its architecture, or building custom UI systems on gpui-base.

zh.tag: 一条命令为你的硬件找到最合适的 LLM 模型
zh.what: llmfit 是一个终端工具，能根据你的系统 RAM、CPU 和 GPU 自动检测硬件，并为数百个模型和提供商评分，告诉你哪些模型能在你的机器上流畅运行。它提供交互式 TUI 和经典 CLI 两种模式，支持多 GPU、MoE 架构、动态量化选择、速度估算以及本地运行时提供商（如 Ollama、llama.cpp 等）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、TUI 和 CLI 实现、基准测试指南（docs/benchmarking.md）、TUI 指南（docs/tui.md），以及用于演示的 demo.gif 和图标资源。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和模型推理后端（Ollama、llama.cpp、MLX 等），通过 crates.io 分发。
zh.hot: 星标数达 32k，今日新增近 200，因其解决了本地 LLM 选型的痛点，且新版本支持基准测试并贡献结果，让用户获得真实硬件上的实测数据，迅速走红。
uses: 本地 LLM 爱好者：快速找到适合自己电脑配置的模型，避免下载后跑不动的尴尬。
开发者：在开发环境中评估不同模型的性能，优化推理速度和资源占用。
硬件评测者：通过基准测试功能，分享自己机器上的实测数据，帮助社区完善模型适配信息。

en.tag: One command to find the right LLM for your hardware
en.what: llmfit is a terminal tool that detects your hardware and scores hundreds of models across quality, speed, fit, and context dimensions, telling you which ones will run well on your machine. It features an interactive TUI and classic CLI mode, supporting multi-GPU setups, MoE architectures, dynamic quantization, speed estimation, and local runtime providers like Ollama and llama.cpp.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, TUI and CLI implementations, benchmarking guide (docs/benchmarking.md), TUI guide (docs/tui.md), plus demo.gif and icon assets.
en.stack: Built with Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and model inference backends (Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, etc.), distributed via crates.io.
en.hot: With 32k stars and ~200 new today, it solves the pain point of choosing the right local LLM, and the new benchmarking feature lets users contribute real measured data, driving its popularity.
uses: Local LLM enthusiasts: quickly find models that fit your hardware, avoiding downloads that won't run.
Developers: evaluate model performance in dev environments to optimize inference speed and resource usage.
Hardware reviewers: use benchmarking to share real measured data and improve community model-fit information.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理提供跨工具、跨机器的长期记忆与交接协议
zh.what: ai-memory 为 AI 编码 CLI 提供长期记忆层，让不同厂商的代理共享同一份项目记忆。中途退出 Claude Code 后，可在同目录用 Codex 继续任务，无需重新解释架构、失败尝试和未决问题。记忆存放在自托管服务器上，支持跨机器与团队共享。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的单二进制服务端与生命周期钩子，记忆以 git 管理的普通 Markdown wiki 为真源，数据库只是可重建的派生索引。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 1.95+ 编写，MIT 许可，依赖自托管服务器与 git 仓库，默认路径零 LLM 调用、无需 API key。
zh.hot: 本月新增 5269 星、总数达 6694，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 13 名，切中多代理协作中记忆孤岛的痛点。
uses: 在多个 AI 编码 CLI 之间切换的开发者，希望任务无缝交接
需要跨台式机与笔记本共享项目记忆的个人开发者
希望团队共享代理会话知识并保留审计日志的工程团队
偏好用 Markdown 和 git 管理记忆、不想维护向量库的用户

en.tag: Long-term memory and handoff protocol for AI coding agents across tools and machines
en.what: ai-memory provides a long-term memory layer for AI coding CLIs, letting agents from different vendors share one project memory. Quit Claude Code mid-task, open Codex in the same directory, and continue without re-explaining the architecture, failed approaches, or open questions. Memory lives on a self-hosted server, enabling cross-machine and team sharing.
en.content: The repo contains a single Rust binary server plus lifecycle hooks; memory's source of truth is a git-backed wiki of plain Markdown files, with the database as a rebuildable derived index.
en.stack: Written in Rust 1.95+ under MIT license, relying on a self-hosted server and git repo; the default path uses zero LLM calls and needs no API key.
en.hot: Gained 5,269 stars this month for 6,694 total, ranking 13th on GitHub Trending monthly, hitting the pain point of memory silos in multi-agent workflows.
uses: Developers switching between multiple AI coding CLIs who want seamless task handoff
Solo developers wanting shared project memory across desktop and laptop
Engineering teams needing shared agent session knowledge with audit logs
Users who prefer Markdown and git over maintaining a vector store

zh.tag: 本地优先的跨平台个人 AI 超级智能体
zh.what: OpenHuman 是一款面向 Mac、Windows 和 Linux 的开源个人 AI，强调本地优先的记忆能力、智能体编排与深度研究。它把「记住一切的大脑」、编排器和研究员三合一，让个人数据留在本地。

想用 Rust 构建或扩展桌面 AI 智能体的开发者

en.tag: A local-first personal AI superintelligence for Mac, Windows and Linux
en.what: OpenHuman is an open source personal AI for Mac, Windows and Linux, built around local-first memory, agent orchestration and deep research. It combines a brain that remembers everything, an orchestrator and a deep researcher into one local-first assistant.
en.content: The repo ships a Rust core, a GitBook docs directory (gitbooks/) with demo screenshots, plus community links to Discord, Reddit and X.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust as a cross-platform desktop app; docs are built with GitBook, with community and distribution via GitHub Discussions, Discord and Product Hunt.
en.hot: It landed Product Hunt daily and weekly top-post badges, and has reached 39,586 stars with 3,715 added this month, ranking 20th on the Rust monthly trending list — its local-first privacy pitch rides today's wave.

Knowledge workers and researchers needing long-term memory and deep research capabilities
Developers who want to build or extend a desktop AI agent in Rust

zh.tag: 为无服务器计算打造的安全高速 microVM 虚拟化技术
zh.what: Firecracker 是 AWS 开源的轻量级虚拟化技术，用 microVM 运行容器与函数工作负载。它把硬件虚拟化的安全隔离性与容器的速度、灵活性结合起来，专为多租户无服务器场景设计。
zh.content: 核心是一个基于 Linux KVM 的虚拟机监控器（VMM），采用极简设计，剔除多余设备与 guest 功能以缩小内存占用和攻击面；仓库还包含构建工具链、快速入门与生产主机配置文档。
zh.stack: 主要用 Rust 编写，依赖 Linux KVM 与 Unix/Linux 主机环境，可通过 Docker 开发容器和 bash 脚本构建。
zh.hot: 作为 AWS Lambda 与 Fargate 的底层虚拟化引擎，Firecracker 是云原生安全隔离的事实标准之一，本月新增 707 star、总数达 36739，稳居 Rust 月榜第 12 名。
uses: 云平台与无服务器服务商：需要安全多租户隔离的容器/函数运行环境
容器运行时开发者：如 Kata Containers、Flintlock 等集成 microVM 隔离
基础设施与安全工程师：评估轻量虚拟化的启动速度、内存开销与攻击面
学习虚拟化与 KVM 的 Rust 开发者：研究生产级 VMM 实现

en.tag: Secure and fast microVMs for serverless computing
en.what: Firecracker is an open-source virtualization technology from AWS that runs container and function workloads inside lightweight microVMs. It combines the security and isolation of hardware virtualization with the speed and flexibility of containers, purpose-built for multi-tenant serverless services.
en.content: At its core is a minimalist KVM-based virtual machine monitor (VMM) that strips out unnecessary devices and guest-facing features to cut memory footprint and attack surface; the repo also ships a build toolchain, quickstart guide, and production host setup docs.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, it relies on Linux KVM and a Unix/Linux host, and can be built via a Docker dev container and bash scripts.
en.hot: As the virtualization engine behind AWS Lambda and Fargate, Firecracker is a de facto standard for secure cloud-native isolation, gaining 707 stars this month for a total of 36,739 and ranking 12th on the monthly Rust trending list.
uses: Cloud and serverless providers needing secure multi-tenant isolation for containers and functions
Container runtime developers integrating microVM isolation, such as Kata Containers and Flintlock
Infrastructure and security engineers evaluating lightweight virtualization for boot speed, memory overhead, and attack surface
Rust developers learning virtualization and KVM by studying a production-grade VMM

zh.tag: 跨 50+ 编程工具的 AI 技能统一管理桌面应用

en.tag: A lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools
en.what: Skills Manager is a lightweight desktop app to manage, sync, and organize AI agent skills across 50+ coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, and Gemini CLI. It provides a unified skill library, allowing users to install skills from Git repos, local folders, archives, or the skills.sh marketplace, with support for global, agent, and project workspaces.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust-based desktop app source code, featuring a unified skill library, marketplace browsing, global/agent/project workspaces, backup and multi-device sync, along with UI screenshots and a concept map.

Development teams: ensure consistent skill configurations across members via backup and multi-device sync.
Skill developers: publish skills to the marketplace and use workspaces for testing and deployment.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写的轻量级 Bitwarden 兼容密码服务器
zh.what: Vaultwarden 是 Bitwarden 客户端 API 的非官方服务端实现，用 Rust 编写，兼容官方 Bitwarden 客户端。它专为自托管场景设计，在资源占用上远低于官方服务，适合在低配服务器或家庭 NAS 上运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Rust 服务端源码、Docker 部署文件、数据库迁移脚本以及 Web 管理界面等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Rocket 框架、Diesel ORM 和 SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL 数据库，支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 67,526 颗星和今日新增 115 星登上 GitHub 日榜第 10 名，其轻量、自托管友好的特性深受隐私意识强的用户欢迎。

在低配服务器或 NAS 上部署密码库的运维人员
注重数据隐私、不愿依赖官方云服务的团队

en.tag: A lightweight Bitwarden-compatible password server rewritten in Rust
en.what: Vaultwarden is an unofficial server implementation of the Bitwarden Client API, written in Rust and compatible with official Bitwarden clients. It is designed for self-hosted deployments where running the official resource-heavy service may not be ideal, offering a much lighter footprint.
en.content: The repository contains the full Rust server source code, Docker deployment files, database migration scripts, and a web admin interface.
en.stack: Primarily built with Rust, using the Rocket framework, Diesel ORM, and SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL databases, with Docker deployment support.
en.hot: With 67,526 stars and 115 new stars today, it ranks 10th on GitHub Trending daily, popular among privacy-conscious users for its lightweight, self-hosting-friendly nature.
uses: Individuals or families wanting to self-host a password manager
Sysadmins deploying a password vault on low-spec servers or NAS
Teams prioritizing data privacy over official cloud services
Developers or integrators needing a Bitwarden-compatible API

Users with ChatGPT Plus/Pro plans who can seamlessly integrate their existing subscription for coding.
Tech teams needing a lightweight, scriptable tool for code generation and modification.

zh.tag: 友好且类型安全的可扩展系统编程语言
zh.what: Gleam 是一门静态类型编程语言，旨在构建类型安全且可扩展的系统。它编译到 Erlang 和 JavaScript，让开发者能利用 BEAM 虚拟机的并发与容错能力，或在前端/Node.js 环境中运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Gleam 编译器的 Rust 源代码、标准库、构建工具以及文档和示例。主要目录有 compiler-core（编译器核心）、compiler-cli（命令行工具）和 test 等。
zh.stack: Gleam 编译器使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Rust 生态的库如 serde、clap 等。运行时目标为 Erlang/OTP 和 JavaScript，因此需要相应的运行时环境。
zh.hot: Gleam 因其友好的错误信息、强大的类型系统和多目标编译能力而受到关注，本月新增 194 颗星，总星数达 21894，在 GitHub Trending 月榜（Rust）中排名第 15。
uses: 希望构建高并发、容错后端系统的开发者，可利用 Erlang 生态。
需要类型安全且能编译到 JavaScript 的前端或全栈开发者。
对函数式编程和静态类型语言感兴趣的学习者与研究者。

en.tag: A friendly language for building type-safe, scalable systems
en.what: Gleam is a statically typed programming language designed for building type-safe and scalable systems. It compiles to Erlang and JavaScript, allowing developers to leverage the concurrency and fault-tolerance of the BEAM virtual machine or run in frontend/Node.js environments.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust source code for the Gleam compiler, standard library, build tool, and documentation/examples. Key directories include compiler-core (compiler core), compiler-cli (CLI tool), and test.
en.stack: The Gleam compiler is written in Rust, depending on Rust ecosystem crates like serde and clap. Runtime targets are Erlang/OTP and JavaScript, requiring corresponding runtime environments.
en.hot: Gleam gains attention for its friendly error messages, powerful type system, and multi-target compilation. It added 194 stars this month, reaching 21,894 total stars, ranking 15th on GitHub Trending monthly (Rust).
uses: Developers building highly concurrent, fault-tolerant backend systems leveraging the Erlang ecosystem.
Frontend or full-stack developers needing type safety with JavaScript compilation.
Learners and researchers interested in functional programming and statically typed languages.
Teams seeking alternatives to TypeScript or Elixir for building scalable applications.

zh.tag: 更聪明的 cd 命令，记住常用目录实现秒级跳转

zh.hot: 作为经典效率工具，zoxide 已积累 39,323 颗星，今日再增 57 星并登上 Rust 日榜第 18 名，说明终端用户对快速导航的需求持续旺盛。
uses: 经常在终端中切换目录的开发者与运维人员，可大幅减少 cd 输入
使用 bash、zsh、fish 等主流 shell 并希望提升命令行效率的用户
喜欢 fzf 交互式选择、追求个性化终端工作流的高级用户

en.tag: A smarter cd command that remembers your most-used directories for instant jumps
en.what: zoxide is a smarter cd command inspired by z and autojump. It remembers which directories you use most frequently so you can jump to them in just a few keystrokes, while still working like a regular cd command across all major shells.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core binary, shell init scripts and completions, installation and configuration docs, third-party integration examples, plus a demo GIF.
en.stack: Written in Rust, distributed via crates.io, built with Nix support, and relies on fzf for interactive selection.
en.hot: As a classic productivity tool, zoxide has reached 39,323 stars, gaining 57 more today and ranking 18th on the Rust daily trending list, showing sustained demand for fast terminal navigation.
uses: Developers and sysadmins who frequently switch directories in the terminal and want to cut down on cd typing
Users of bash, zsh, fish and other major shells looking to boost command-line efficiency
Power users who enjoy fzf interactive selection and a personalized terminal workflow

zh.tag: 开源版 Loom：快速录屏、本地剪辑与可自托管分享
zh.what: Cap 是一个开源的屏幕录制与视频分享工具，定位为 Loom 的替代品。它支持录制屏幕、摄像头和麦克风，提供即时分享链接与本地精修编辑，并可自托管或接入自有 S3 存储，让团队完全掌控数据。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面端应用（基于 Tauri）、Web 仪表盘与后端服务，提供 Instant 与 Studio 两种录制模式，以及评论、转录、分析、团队工作区和自定义域名等功能。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，桌面端使用 Tauri 框架，前端为 Web 应用，支持 S3 兼容存储与自托管部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 22,346 颗星与本月新增 1,552 星登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Rust 第 21 名，反映出开发者对开源、可自托管录屏协作工具的强烈需求。
uses: 需要快速录制产品演示、Bug 报告或异步站会的开发与产品团队
希望摆脱 Loom 订阅、要求数据自主可控并支持自托管的企业
需要为教程、设计评审或客户更新制作精修视频的内容创作者
关注开源 Rust/Tauri 桌面应用架构的开发者与贡献者

en.tag: Open source Loom alternative: fast screen recording, local editing, self-hostable sharing
en.what: Cap is an open source screen recording and video sharing tool positioned as a Loom alternative. It captures screen, camera, and microphone, offers instant share links plus polished local editing, and can be self-hosted or backed by your own S3 storage so teams fully own their data.
en.content: The repo contains a desktop app built on Tauri, a web dashboard, and backend services, offering Instant and Studio recording modes plus comments, transcripts, analytics, team workspaces, and custom domains.
en.stack: Primary language is Rust, with the desktop app built on Tauri, a web frontend, and support for S3-compatible storage and self-hosted deployment.
en.hot: With 22,346 stars and 1,552 added this month, it ranks 21st on GitHub Trending's monthly Rust list, reflecting strong demand for an open source, self-hostable screen recording and collaboration tool.
uses: Dev and product teams needing fast product demos, bug reports, or async standups
Enterprises wanting to leave Loom and keep data self-hosted and under control
Content creators polishing tutorials, design reviews, or client update videos
Developers interested in the open source Rust/Tauri desktop app architecture

zh.tag: 为 LLM 应用按成本与能力智能路由模型，兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 原生 API
zh.what: Switchyard 为每次 LLM 调用挑选最便宜但仍能完成任务的模型，从而在保持准确率的同时降低总成本。它不改变你的 agent 代码，而是作为路由层插入现有网关或独立代理中。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心库 switchyard-libsy、LLM 客户端 switchyard-llm-client、独立代理服务器 switchyard-server，以及 NeMo Relay 插件和 LiteLLM 集成示例。
zh.stack: 以 Rust 为主，提供 Python 包 nemo-switchyard 和 Rust crate switchyard-libsy，可嵌入 LiteLLM、NeMo Relay 或自建网关。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1493 stars，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Rust 第 7 名，反映出开发者对 LLM 成本优化与多模型路由的强烈需求。
uses: 正在构建 LLM agent 或应用的开发者，希望在不改代码的情况下降低推理成本
需要跨多个模型提供商做基准测试和性能/成本权衡的团队
已有 LiteLLM 或 NeMo Relay 网关、想加入智能路由能力的平台工程师
想用 Claude Code、Codex CLI 等工具但希望按轮次自动选择模型的高级用户

en.tag: Route LLM calls across models and providers while keeping native OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility
en.what: Switchyard picks the cheapest model that can still do the job for each LLM call, cutting total cost while preserving accuracy. It requires no changes to your agent code, acting as a routing layer inside existing gateways or as a standalone proxy.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core library switchyard-libsy, an LLM client switchyard-llm-client, a standalone proxy server switchyard-server, plus a NeMo Relay plugin and LiteLLM integration examples.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, with a Python package nemo-switchyard and Rust crate switchyard-libsy, embeddable into LiteLLM, NeMo Relay, or custom gateways.
en.hot: It gained 1,493 stars this month and ranked 7th on GitHub Trending's monthly Rust list, reflecting strong demand for LLM cost optimization and multi-model routing.
uses: Developers building LLM agents or apps who want to cut inference costs without changing code
Teams benchmarking across multiple model providers and balancing cost versus performance
Platform engineers with existing LiteLLM or NeMo Relay gateways who want to add smart routing
Power users of Claude Code, Codex CLI, or similar tools who want per-turn model selection

zh.tag: 纯 Rust 的即时模式 GUI 库，Web 与原生通吃
zh.what: egui 是一个用纯 Rust 编写的简单、快速、高度可移植的即时模式 GUI 库。它既能跑在 Web 上，也能原生运行于 Linux、Mac、Windows、Android，还能嵌入各种游戏引擎。官方框架 eframe 让开发者用同一套代码构建跨平台应用。
zh.content: 仓库以 Rust crate 形式组织，核心是 egui 库，配套官方框架 eframe，另有 examples/ 示例目录、集成适配层以及文档与 Discord 社区。
zh.stack: 纯 Rust 实现，禁止 unsafe，依赖极少；通过 eframe 支持 Web（WASM）、桌面与 Android，可对接 wgpu/glow 等渲染后端。
zh.hot: 已积累约 30,602 颗星，本月新增 573，位列 GitHub Trending 月榜 Rust 第 23 名；Rust GUI 生态长期缺位，egui 以易用和跨平台成为热门选择。
uses: Rust 开发者想快速给自己的工具或原型加上图形界面
需要一套代码同时发布 Web 与桌面应用的团队
游戏或引擎开发者想在渲染循环里嵌入调试/编辑器 UI
对 unsafe 敏感、追求内存安全 GUI 方案的项目

en.tag: An easy-to-use immediate mode GUI in pure Rust, running on both web and native
en.what: egui is a simple, fast and highly portable immediate mode GUI library written in pure Rust. It runs on the web, natively on Linux/Mac/Windows/Android, and inside your favorite game engine. The official eframe framework lets you build cross-platform apps from a single codebase.
en.content: The repo is organized as Rust crates: the core egui library, the official eframe framework, an examples/ folder, integration adapters, plus docs and a Discord community.
en.stack: Pure Rust with unsafe forbidden and minimal dependencies; eframe targets Web (WASM), desktop and Android, and can plug into renderers like wgpu/glow.
en.hot: It has around 30,602 stars with 573 added this month, ranking 23rd on GitHub Trending's monthly Rust list; with Rust's GUI ecosystem long underserved, egui stands out for ease of use and portability.
uses: Rust developers who want to quickly add a GUI to tools or prototypes
Teams that need one codebase shipping both web and desktop apps
Game or engine developers embedding debug/editor UI in the render loop
Projects sensitive to unsafe code that want a memory-safe GUI solution

zh.tag: 谷歌开源的 AI 文件类型识别工具，毫秒级精准检测
zh.what: Magika 是谷歌开源的 AI 文件内容类型检测工具，利用深度学习模型识别文件真实格式，而非仅依赖扩展名。它基于约 1 亿样本、200 多种内容类型训练，平均准确率约 99%，单 CPU 即可毫秒级完成识别。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心实现与预训练模型，并提供 Python、Node.js、Go 等多语言绑定、命令行工具及测试数据集。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 编写以保证性能，模型体积仅几 MB，通过 PyPI、NPM、Go module 等渠道分发，并提供 Python/JS/Go 接口。
zh.hot: 作为谷歌安全团队实际用于 Gmail、Drive、Safe Browsing 的成熟工具，且已集成 VirusTotal 与 abuse.ch，本月新增 703 star，累计 18.6k，热度持续。
uses: 安全工程师：用于恶意文件检测与内容策略路由
开发者：在应用中集成精准的文件类型识别能力
数据平台团队：清洗和分类海量异构文件
研究人员：研究 AI 文件类型检测与模型优化

en.tag: Google's AI-powered file type detection, accurate in milliseconds
en.what: Magika is Google's open-source AI-powered file content type detection tool that identifies a file's true format using deep learning rather than relying on extensions. Trained on ~100M samples across 200+ content types, it reaches ~99% average accuracy and runs in milliseconds even on a single CPU.
en.content: The repo ships a Rust core with a pretrained model, plus Python, Node.js, and Go bindings, a CLI, and test datasets.
en.stack: The core is written in Rust for performance, with a model of only a few MB, distributed via PyPI, NPM, and Go modules with Python/JS/Go APIs.
en.hot: As a mature tool actually used by Google security for Gmail, Drive, and Safe Browsing, and integrated with VirusTotal and abuse.ch, it gained 703 stars this month, reaching 18.6k total.
uses: Security engineers: malware detection and content policy routing
Developers: integrate accurate file type identification into apps
Data platform teams: clean and classify massive heterogeneous files
Researchers: study AI file type detection and model optimization

zh.tag: 快速、节省磁盘空间的 Node.js 包管理器
zh.what: pnpm 是一个快速且节省磁盘空间的 Node.js 包管理器，通过内容寻址存储来链接文件，避免重复下载。它支持 monorepo，提供严格的依赖访问控制，并具有确定性的锁文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 pnpm 的完整源代码、文档、基准测试脚本，以及一个用 Rust 编写的实验性 CLI 移植版本（pacquet）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript/TypeScript 编写，并包含 Rust 组件（pacquet）。依赖 Node.js 生态，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。
zh.hot: pnpm 因其卓越的性能和磁盘效率而广受欢迎，在 GitHub 上拥有 36,310 颗星，并持续获得关注。其 Rust 移植版本也吸引了开发者的兴趣。
uses: 适用于大型 monorepo 项目，可显著减少依赖安装时间和磁盘占用。
适合对包管理性能有严格要求的开发团队，尤其是 CI/CD 环境。
适合希望使用严格依赖隔离和确定性锁文件的 Node.js 开发者。

en.tag: Fast, disk space efficient package manager for Node.js
en.what: pnpm is a fast and disk space efficient package manager for Node.js. It links files from a single content-addressable storage to avoid duplication, supports monorepos, enforces strict dependency access, and provides deterministic lockfiles.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, benchmark scripts, and an experimental Rust port of the CLI called pacquet.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript/TypeScript with a Rust component (pacquet). Depends on Node.js ecosystem, supports Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.hot: pnpm is popular for its superior performance and disk efficiency, with 36,310 stars on GitHub and ongoing attention. Its Rust port also attracts developers.
uses: Ideal for large monorepo projects, significantly reducing install time and disk usage.
Suitable for teams with strict performance requirements, especially in CI/CD environments.
Great for Node.js developers who want strict dependency isolation and deterministic lockfiles.

zh.tag: 命令行下载 App Store 的 ipa 包工具
zh.what: ipatool 是一个命令行工具，允许用户从 App Store 搜索 iOS、iPadOS、tvOS 和 visionOS 应用，并下载其 ipa 文件。它支持认证、搜索、购买和列出已购应用等操作。

zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 App Store 的 API，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，可通过 Homebrew 安装。
zh.hot: 该工具为开发者和安全研究人员提供了便捷的 ipa 下载方式，在 GitHub 上获得 1 万+ star，今日新增 58 个，登上日榜第 8 名。
uses: iOS 开发者需要获取 ipa 包进行测试或分析
安全研究人员分析应用包内容
需要备份或归档 App Store 应用的用户

en.tag: CLI tool to search and download ipa packages from App Store
en.what: ipatool is a command-line tool that allows users to search for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS apps on the App Store and download their ipa files. It supports authentication, searching, purchasing, and listing purchased apps.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of a Go-based CLI tool with subcommands like auth, search, purchase, and list-purchases, supporting text and JSON output formats, along with a demo GIF and detailed documentation.
en.stack: Developed in Go, it relies on the App Store API and supports Windows, Linux, and macOS, installable via Homebrew.
en.hot: This tool provides a convenient way for developers and security researchers to download ipa files, gaining over 10k stars on GitHub with 58 new stars today, ranking 8th on the daily trending list.
