Security researchers analyzing app package contents
Users who want to back up or archive App Store apps

zh.tag: 自托管信息聚合仪表盘，把所有订阅源集中到一个页面
zh.what: Glance 是一个轻量、高度可定制的自托管仪表盘，把 RSS、Reddit、Hacker News、YouTube、Twitch、天气、股价、Docker 状态和服务器指标等各类信息流汇聚到统一界面。它通过 YAML 配置文件定义页面与小组件，支持多标签页、自定义 CSS 和主题，并针对移动端做了优化。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的服务端源码、docs 下的配置与主题文档、预配置页面示例、Logo 与截图资源，以及社区小组件仓库的链接。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，前端使用极简的原生 JavaScript，配置采用 YAML，可编译为小于 20MB 的单文件二进制，并提供同样小巧的 Docker 镜像。
zh.hot: 凭借 37090 颗星和本月新增 756 星登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Go 语言第 4 名，其低内存占用、少依赖和高度可定制的特性正好契合自托管社区对轻量聚合面板的需求。
uses: 自托管爱好者：想把 RSS、社交动态和服务器状态集中到一个私人主页
家庭实验室与 Homelab 用户：需要监控 Docker 容器和服务器指标
注重隐私的用户：不希望依赖第三方在线仪表盘服务
移动端用户：希望在手机上随时查看个性化信息流

en.tag: A self-hosted dashboard that puts all your feeds in one place
en.what: Glance is a lightweight, highly customizable self-hosted dashboard that aggregates RSS, Reddit, Hacker News, YouTube, Twitch, weather, market prices, Docker container status, and server stats into one unified interface. It uses YAML configuration to define pages and widgets, supports multiple tabs, custom CSS and themes, and is optimized for mobile devices.
en.content: The repo contains the Go server source code, configuration and theme docs under docs/, preconfigured page examples, logo and screenshot assets, plus links to the community widgets repository.
en.stack: Written in Go with minimal vanilla JavaScript on the frontend, configured via YAML, and shipped as a single sub-20MB binary plus an equally small Docker image.
en.hot: With 37,090 stars and 756 added this month, it ranks 4th on the GitHub Trending monthly Go list, as its low memory usage, few dependencies, and high customizability match the self-hosting community's demand for a lightweight aggregation panel.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts who want RSS, social feeds, and server status on one private homepage
Homelab users who need to monitor Docker containers and server metrics
Privacy-conscious users who prefer not to rely on third-party online dashboards
Mobile users who want to check a personalized feed on the go

zh.tag: 用命令行自动化 App Store Connect 全流程的 Go 工具
zh.what: 这是一个用 Go 编写的 App Store Connect 命令行工具，把 TestFlight、构建、提交审核、签名、分析、截图、订阅管理等 iOS/macOS/tvOS/visionOS 发布流程搬到终端里。它面向脚本和 CI/CD 设计，可以在 IDE、流水线或本地一键完成原本要在网页后台反复点击的操作。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 Go 实现的 asc 命令，包含大量子命令与文档；还提供 asc install-skills 安装 25 个 Agent Skills，把常见工作流封装成可复用的技能包，并附带 Homebrew、安装脚本和 WinGet 等分发方式。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，通过 go.mod 管理依赖，提供 Homebrew、curl 安装脚本和 WinGet 等安装方式，并支持作为 Agent Skills 集成到 AI 编码助手。
zh.hot: 本周新增 663 star、总数达 7232，并登上 GitHub Trending Go 周榜第 4 名。它切中了 iOS 开发者对发布流程自动化的刚需，加上 Agent Skills 与 CI/CD 场景的契合，热度快速攀升。
uses: iOS/macOS 开发者：想把 TestFlight、构建和提交审核从网页后台搬到命令行
DevOps/CI 工程师：需要在流水线中自动完成签名、上传和发布
使用 AI 编码助手的团队：通过 asc install-skills 把发布流程变成可复用技能
独立开发者与小团队：希望用脚本减少 App Store Connect 上的重复手工操作

en.tag: A fast, scriptable Go CLI for automating the App Store Connect API
en.what: A Go-based CLI for the App Store Connect API that automates TestFlight, builds, submissions, signing, analytics, screenshots, subscriptions and more across iOS, macOS, tvOS and visionOS. It is built for scripting and CI/CD, letting you run release workflows from a terminal, IDE or pipeline instead of the web dashboard.
en.content: The repo centers on the Go-based asc command with many subcommands and docs, plus asc install-skills which installs 25 agent skills for common workflows. It also ships Homebrew, install-script and WinGet distribution paths.
en.stack: Written in Go with go.mod, distributed via Homebrew, a curl install script and WinGet, and integrable as Agent Skills for AI coding assistants.
en.hot: It gained 663 stars this week for a total of 7,232, ranking 4th on GitHub Trending's weekly Go chart. It hits a real pain point in iOS release automation, and its Agent Skills plus CI/CD fit are driving rapid adoption.
uses: iOS/macOS developers who want TestFlight, builds and submissions in the terminal instead of the web UI
DevOps/CI engineers automating signing, uploads and releases in pipelines
Teams using AI coding assistants that want release workflows as reusable skills via asc install-skills
Indie developers and small teams looking to script away repetitive App Store Connect chores

zh.tag: 基于 Envoy 的开源 AI 与 Agent 流量控制平面
zh.what: Agent Router 为应用团队提供统一的、兼容 OpenAI 的 API，用来访问各类托管模型、自托管推理服务以及 MCP 服务器。平台团队则可以在一个地方集中管理凭证、路由、配额、故障转移和用量归因，由 Envoy 与 Envoy Gateway 来执行这些策略。
zh.content: 仓库包含控制平面与数据平面的 Go 实现、aigw CLI、Kubernetes CRD（如 AIGatewayRoute、AIServiceBackend、BackendSecurityPolicy）、Helm charts 以及文档站点。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，构建在 Envoy 与 Envoy Gateway 之上，遵循 Apache 2.0 许可，支持 Kubernetes 部署与 OpenAI 兼容接口。
zh.hot: 作为 Envoy AI Gateway 更名后的 Agentic AI Foundation 项目，它切中了多模型统一接入与治理的痛点，本月新增 188 star，累计 2121 star，登上 GitHub Trending Go 月榜第 6 名。
uses: 需要统一接入多家模型供应商并集中治理凭证与配额的平台团队
希望用 OpenAI 兼容接口快速切换或回退模型的应用开发者
在 Kubernetes 上自托管推理服务并需要分层网关的运维人员
想为 MCP 服务器和 Agent 工具链增加路由与限流能力的团队

en.tag: The open source control plane for AI and agent traffic, powered by Envoy
en.what: Agent Router gives application teams one consistent, OpenAI-compatible API for every model and tool, from hosted providers to self-hosted inference and MCP servers. Platform teams keep credentials, routing, quotas, failover, and usage attribution in one place, enforced by Envoy and Envoy Gateway.
en.content: The repo contains Go implementations of the control and data planes, the aigw CLI, Kubernetes CRDs (AIGatewayRoute, AIServiceBackend, BackendSecurityPolicy), Helm charts, and a documentation site.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go, built on Envoy and Envoy Gateway, licensed under Apache 2.0, with Kubernetes deployment and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
en.hot: As the renamed Envoy AI Gateway under the Agentic AI Foundation, it addresses the pain of unified multi-model access and governance, gaining 188 stars this month for a total of 2,121 and ranking #6 on GitHub Trending's monthly Go list.
uses: Platform teams needing unified access to multiple model providers with centralized credential and quota governance
Application developers wanting an OpenAI-compatible API to quickly switch or fail over models
Ops teams self-hosting inference on Kubernetes and needing a two-tier gateway pattern
Teams wanting to add routing and rate limiting to MCP servers and agent toolchains

zh.tag: 开源 Linux 服务器管理面板，兼 AI 管理平台
zh.what: 1Panel 是一个现代开源的 Linux 服务器管理面板，提供直观的 Web 界面来管理服务器、网站、数据库、容器等。它还集成了轻量级 AI 管理功能，支持部署和管理 AI 应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的面板源码、文档（多语言）、安装脚本、Docker 镜像配置等。主要目录包括 cmd、frontend、backend、docs 等。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 语言，前端采用 Vue.js，依赖 Docker 和 Docker Compose 进行容器管理，支持多种数据库（如 MySQL、PostgreSQL）。
zh.hot: 1Panel 拥有超过 250 万自托管用户，GitHub 星标 36,831，本月新增 452，因其功能全面且易用而广受欢迎。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队快速管理多台 Linux 服务器，无需命令行操作。
需要部署和管理 Docker 容器、网站、数据库的系统管理员。
希望轻松运行 AI 应用或模型，并集成到服务器管理中的用户。
教育或学习用途，用于理解服务器管理面板的架构与实现。

en.tag: Open-source Linux server management panel with AI platform capabilities
en.what: 1Panel is a modern, open-source Linux server management panel offering an intuitive web interface to manage servers, websites, databases, containers, and more. It also integrates lightweight AI management features for deploying and managing AI applications.
en.content: The repository contains full panel source code, multi-language documentation, installation scripts, Docker image configurations, etc. Main directories include cmd, frontend, backend, docs.
en.stack: Backend is written in Go, frontend uses Vue.js, relies on Docker and Docker Compose for container management, supports multiple databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL).
en.hot: With over 2.5M self-hosters and 36,831 GitHub stars (452 added this month), 1Panel is popular for its comprehensive features and ease of use.
uses: Individual developers or small teams quickly manage multiple Linux servers without CLI operations.
System administrators needing to deploy and manage Docker containers, websites, and databases.
Users who want to easily run AI applications or models integrated into server management.
Educational or learning purposes to understand the architecture of a server management panel.

zh.tag: 支持 S3、POSIX 与 Iceberg 的分布式存储系统，单机可扛数十亿文件
zh.what: SeaweedFS 是一个简单且高度可扩展的分布式文件系统，目标是存储数十亿文件并快速提供访问。单个 weed 二进制即可同时提供 S3 对象存储、POSIX 文件系统和基于 S3 Tables 的湖仓能力，所有数据共享同一份底层存储。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心服务与命令行工具（weed），以及 Docker、Helm/Kubernetes 部署配置、客户端 SDK（Java/Maven 等）、白皮书与 Wiki 文档。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，提供 Docker 镜像、Helm Chart 与 Maven 客户端；支持 S3 API、POSIX 挂载、Iceberg 表格式以及云存储分层缓存。
zh.hot: 34,651 颗星、本月新增 628，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Go 第 20 名；在对象存储与湖仓一体需求上升的背景下，其 O(1) 磁盘访问和横向扩展能力持续吸引关注。
uses: 需要自建 S3 兼容对象存储、替代 MinIO 的团队与运维工程师
为海量小文件、图片、视频等场景寻找高吞吐存储后端的开发者
希望用同一套存储同时支撑文件系统与 Iceberg 湖仓的数据平台团队
在 Kubernetes 上部署有状态存储、关注水平扩展与云分层缓存的架构师

en.tag: Distributed storage for S3, POSIX and Iceberg tables, scaling to billions of files
en.what: SeaweedFS is a simple, highly scalable distributed file system built to store billions of files and serve them fast. A single weed binary provides an S3 object store, a POSIX file system, and a lakehouse with S3 Tables, all over the same data.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based core services and the weed CLI, plus Docker and Helm/Kubernetes deployment configs, client SDKs (Java/Maven, etc.), whitepapers and wiki docs.
en.stack: Written in Go, shipped with Docker images, Helm charts and a Maven client; supports the S3 API, POSIX mounts, Iceberg table format, and cloud storage tiering/caching.
en.hot: With 34,651 stars and 628 added this month, it ranks 20th on GitHub's monthly Go trending list; as object storage and lakehouse needs grow, its O(1) disk access and horizontal scaling keep drawing attention.
uses: Teams and SREs building self-hosted S3-compatible object storage as a MinIO alternative
Developers needing a high-throughput storage backend for massive small files, images or videos
Data platform teams wanting one storage layer for both file systems and Iceberg lakehouse tables
Architects deploying stateful storage on Kubernetes with horizontal scaling and cloud tiering in mind

zh.tag: 为 Web 应用提供单点登录与多因素认证的门户
zh.what: Authelia 是一个开源的身份认证服务器，为 Web 应用提供单点登录（SSO）和多因素认证（MFA）功能。它可作为反向代理的认证层，支持 LDAP、OIDC 等集成，并已通过 OpenID 认证，且为后量子密码学做好准备。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 语言编写的核心服务、命令行工具、配置示例、文档站点（authelia.com）以及用于构建和测试的 CI/CD 配置。代码结构清晰，包含认证、授权、会话管理等模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多种 Go 库，支持 LDAP、OIDC、TOTP、U2F 等协议。前端可能涉及少量 JavaScript，用于登录页面。
zh.hot: 本月新增 359 星，总星数达 2.88 万，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 10。其安全性和对现代认证标准的支持吸引了大量自托管和隐私敏感用户。
uses: 自托管服务（如 Nextcloud、Grafana）的统一登录与二次验证
企业或团队内部应用的单点登录，集成现有 LDAP 或 OIDC
希望为 Web 应用添加安全认证层，但不希望使用商业 SSO 的开发者
对后量子密码学感兴趣，希望提前适配未来安全标准的技术团队

en.tag: Single Sign-On and Multi-Factor Authentication portal for web apps
en.what: Authelia is an open-source authentication server providing Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for web applications. It acts as an authentication layer for reverse proxies, integrates with LDAP and OIDC, and is OpenID Certified and Post-Quantum Cryptography Ready.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based core service, command-line tools, configuration examples, documentation site (authelia.com), and CI/CD setup for building and testing. The code is well-organized into modules for authentication, authorization, session management, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging various Go libraries. Supports LDAP, OIDC, TOTP, U2F, and other protocols. The frontend may include minimal JavaScript for the login page.
en.hot: With 359 new stars this month and a total of 28.8k stars, it ranks 10th on the Go trending list. Its security focus and support for modern auth standards attract many self-hosters and privacy-conscious users.
uses: Centralized login and 2FA for self-hosted services like Nextcloud and Grafana
SSO for internal enterprise apps, integrating with existing LDAP or OIDC
Developers wanting to add secure auth to web apps without commercial SSO
Tech teams interested in post-quantum cryptography readiness

zh.tag: 专为 Kubernetes 打造的不可变安全 Linux 发行版
zh.what: Talos Linux 是一个专为运行 Kubernetes 而设计的现代 Linux 发行版，主打安全、不可变与极简。它没有 shell 和交互式控制台，所有系统管理都通过 API 完成，并使用双向 TLS（mTLS）认证保护访问。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Talos 操作系统的完整源码（Go 编写），涵盖内核配置、系统服务、API 接口、安装与升级工具，以及配套的文档与社区协作文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，深度集成 Kubernetes 与容器运行时，依赖 Linux 内核、mTLS 及不可变基础设施理念，采用原子更新机制。
zh.hot: 凭借 11143 颗星和本月新增 240 星登上 GitHub Go 月榜第 15 名，反映出社区对安全、可预测的 Kubernetes 底层操作系统的强烈需求。
uses: 运维与平台工程师：用于构建安全、不可变的 Kubernetes 节点
企业 IT 团队：需要减少配置漂移并简化集群升级
安全敏感场景：希望缩小攻击面并通过 API 管理主机
Kubernetes 爱好者：想体验无 shell 的极简操作系统

en.tag: A modern, immutable, secure Linux distribution built for Kubernetes
en.what: Talos Linux is a modern Linux distribution purpose-built for running Kubernetes, emphasizing security, immutability, and minimalism. It has no shell or interactive console; all system management is done via an API secured with mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication.
en.content: The repo contains the full source of the Talos OS written in Go, covering kernel configs, system services, the API layer, install/upgrade tooling, plus documentation and community files.
en.stack: Primarily built in Go, deeply integrated with Kubernetes and container runtimes, relying on the Linux kernel, mTLS, and immutable-infrastructure principles with atomic updates.
en.hot: With 11,143 stars and 240 added this month, ranking 15th on GitHub's monthly Go trending list, it reflects strong community demand for a secure, predictable Kubernetes OS.
uses: DevOps and platform engineers building secure, immutable Kubernetes nodes
Enterprise IT teams needing to reduce config drift and simplify cluster upgrades
Security-sensitive environments wanting a smaller attack surface and API-driven host management
Kubernetes enthusiasts curious about a minimal OS with no shell

zh.tag: 本地化光伏充电与家庭能源管理系统
zh.what: evcc 是一个可扩展的电动汽车充电控制器与家庭能源管理系统，核心目标是在不依赖云服务的前提下实现本地能源管理。它能根据光伏发电、电价与电池状态智能调节充电功率，让电动车尽量用太阳能充电。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 Go 编写的核心程序，附带 Web UI 截图与配置示例，支持 Docker 镜像、Home Assistant 集成以及 Weblate 多语言翻译。文档站 docs.evcc.io 单独维护，涵盖充电桩、智能开关、热泵等设备支持列表。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，提供 Docker 镜像与 Home Assistant 插件，支持 OCPP、EEBus、Modbus 等协议，通过 MQTT/REST 与各类充电桩、逆变器、智能开关和热泵通信。
zh.hot: 凭借 7235 颗星与今日新增 6 星登上 Go 日榜第 17 名，反映出欧洲能源价格高企下，用户对本地化、免云的光伏充电方案需求旺盛。
uses: 拥有光伏与电动车的家庭用户，希望最大化自用太阳能充电
智能家居玩家，想用 Home Assistant 统一管理充电与用电
充电桩厂商或集成商，需要开源、可扩展的充电控制方案
关注能源独立与隐私、不愿依赖云服务的极客用户

en.tag: Local solar charging and home energy management system
en.what: evcc is an extensible EV charge controller and home energy management system designed to run locally without relying on cloud services. It intelligently adjusts charging power based on solar generation, electricity prices, and battery state so EVs charge primarily on solar energy.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based core application, a web UI, configuration examples, Docker images, Home Assistant integration, and Weblate translations. Documentation lives separately at docs.evcc.io, covering supported chargers, smart switches, heat pumps, and more.
en.stack: Written in Go, distributed as Docker images and a Home Assistant add-on, supporting OCPP, EEBus, and Modbus protocols. It communicates with chargers, inverters, smart switches, and heat pumps via MQTT/REST.
en.hot: With 7,235 stars and 6 added today, it ranks 17th on the Go daily trending list, reflecting strong demand for local, cloud-free solar charging amid high European energy prices.
uses: Homeowners with solar panels and EVs wanting to maximize self-consumed solar charging
Smart home enthusiasts integrating charging and energy management via Home Assistant
Charger vendors or integrators seeking an open, extensible charging control solution
Privacy-conscious users who want energy independence without cloud dependency

zh.tag: 自托管网页文件管理器，功能强大且免费
zh.what: FileBrowser Quantum 是一个自托管的网页文件管理器，让用户通过浏览器轻松访问和管理文件。它提供现代响应式界面，支持用户管理、访问控制、文件分享、预览和编辑等高级功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的文件浏览器应用，支持多源配置、OIDC/LDAP/JWT 等多种登录方式，以及实时搜索、缩略图（办公、视频、专辑封面、3D模型）等功能。提供 config.yaml 配置文件和 Docker 镜像。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖前端技术（如 JavaScript/CSS）构建响应式界面，支持 Docker 部署，并集成多种认证协议（OIDC, LDAP, JWT）。
zh.hot: 本月新增 488 星，总星数达 8168，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 21 名。作为 filebrowser 的大幅改进分支，它提供了更丰富的功能和更好的用户体验，且完全免费开源，吸引了大量自托管用户。
uses: 个人用户：在家庭服务器或 NAS 上部署，随时随地通过浏览器管理文件。
团队协作：利用用户管理和分享功能，实现文件的安全共享与协作。
开发者：作为自托管文件管理解决方案，可集成到现有系统中，支持多种认证方式。
运维人员：通过 Docker 快速部署，提供轻量级文件访问入口。

en.tag: Powerful free self-hosted web file manager
en.what: FileBrowser Quantum is a self-hosted web-based file manager that allows users to easily access and manage files through a browser. It offers a modern responsive interface with advanced features for user management, access control, sharing, file preview, and editing.
en.content: The repository contains a full-featured file browser application with multi-source configuration, multiple login methods (OIDC, LDAP, JWT), real-time search, and thumbnails for office, video, album art, and 3D models. It includes a config.yaml file and Docker images.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with frontend technologies (JavaScript/CSS) for the responsive UI, supports Docker deployment, and integrates authentication protocols like OIDC, LDAP, and JWT.
en.hot: Gained 488 stars this month, reaching 8,168 total, ranking #21 on the Go trending list. As a massive fork of filebrowser with enhanced features and UX, it attracts many self-hosters due to being free and open-source.
uses: For individuals: deploy on home servers or NAS to manage files from anywhere via browser.
For teams: use user management and sharing features for secure file collaboration.
For developers: integrate as a self-hosted file management solution with multiple auth methods.
For admins: quick Docker deployment for a lightweight file access point.

zh.tag: 终端里的 Winamp 风格音乐播放器，支持海量流媒体与本地音乐
zh.what: cliamp 是一个在终端中运行的复古风格音乐播放器，灵感来自 Winamp。它不仅能播放本地音乐文件，还支持 YouTube、Spotify、SoundCloud、Bilibili、网易云音乐等众多流媒体平台，以及 Navidrome、Plex、Jellyfin 等媒体服务器。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的终端播放器主程序，支持频谱可视化、参数均衡器和播放列表管理。还提供了 Android 移动客户端和安装脚本、Homebrew、AUR、Nix 等多种安装方式。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，基于 Bubbletea 和 Lip Gloss 构建 TUI，Beep 处理音频，go-librespot 支持 Spotify。依赖 ALSA（Linux）和 FLAC、Vorbis 等编解码库。
zh.hot: 凭借复古 Winamp 情怀与强大的多平台流媒体支持，cliamp 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 4220 颗星，本月新增 1100 星，位列 Go 趋势月榜第 14 名。
uses: 终端爱好者与复古 UI 粉丝 —— 在命令行中享受 Winamp 风格的播放体验。
需要统一播放多平台音乐的用户 —— 一个播放器搞定本地、流媒体和媒体服务器。
开发者与运维人员 —— 在编码或工作时用终端听音乐，不离开工作流。
Android 用户 —— 通过 cliamp mobile 在手机上收听广播、播客和相同服务器内容。

en.tag: A retro terminal music player inspired by Winamp, supporting local files and many streaming services.
en.what: cliamp is a retro terminal music player inspired by Winamp. It plays local files and streams from YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, Bilibili, NetEase Cloud Music, and many other services, as well as media servers like Navidrome, Plex, and Jellyfin.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based terminal player with a spectrum visualizer, parametric EQ, and playlist manager. It also offers an Android mobile client and multiple installation methods including script, Homebrew, AUR, and Nix.
en.stack: Built in Go with Bubbletea and Lip Gloss for TUI, Beep for audio, and go-librespot for Spotify. Depends on ALSA (Linux) and codec libraries like FLAC and Vorbis.
en.hot: With its retro Winamp nostalgia and extensive streaming support, cliamp has quickly gained popularity on GitHub, earning 4,220 stars with 1,100 added this month, ranking 14th on the Go trending monthly list.
uses: Terminal enthusiasts and retro UI fans — enjoy a Winamp-style player in the command line.
Users needing unified playback across platforms — one player for local, streaming, and media servers.
Developers and sysadmins — listen to music in the terminal without leaving the workflow.
Android users — use cliamp mobile to listen to radio, podcasts, and the same servers on phones.

zh.tag: 轻量级服务器监控平台，支持 Docker 统计、历史数据与告警
zh.what: Beszel 是一个轻量级的服务器监控平台，提供 Docker 统计、历史数据和告警功能。它拥有友好的 Web 界面，配置简单，开箱即用，并支持自动备份、多用户、OAuth 认证和 API 访问。
zh.content: 仓库包含两个主要组件：hub（基于 PocketBase 的 Web 应用，提供仪表盘）和 agent（运行在被监控系统上，收集指标）。支持 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、负载、温度等指标，并提供截图和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，hub 基于 PocketBase，agent 独立运行。支持 Docker/Podman，可通过 Docker 镜像部署，使用 SQLite 存储数据。
zh.hot: 凭借轻量级、简单易用和丰富的功能（如 Docker 统计、告警、多用户）在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本周新增 282 颗星，总星数达 24,566，位列 Go 语言周榜第 9 名。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队，需要轻量级服务器监控且不想部署重量级方案
使用 Docker 运行多个容器的用户，希望跟踪每个容器的资源使用历史
需要设置告警（如 CPU、内存、磁盘）并及时收到通知的运维人员
希望通过 OAuth 集成现有身份认证系统的企业用户

en.tag: Lightweight server monitoring with Docker stats, history, and alerts
en.what: Beszel is a lightweight server monitoring platform that includes Docker statistics, historical data, and alert functions. It has a friendly web interface, simple configuration, and is ready to use out of the box. It supports automatic backup, multi-user, OAuth authentication, and API access.
en.content: The repository contains two main components: the hub (a PocketBase-based web app providing a dashboard) and the agent (runs on monitored systems, collects metrics). It supports metrics like CPU, memory, disk, network, load, temperature, and includes screenshots and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, the hub is built on PocketBase, and the agent runs independently. Supports Docker/Podman, deployable via Docker images, uses SQLite for data storage.
en.hot: It has gained popularity on GitHub due to its lightweight nature, ease of use, and rich features (like Docker stats, alerts, multi-user). It gained 282 stars this week, reaching 24,566 total, ranking 9th on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: Individual developers or small teams needing lightweight server monitoring without heavyweight solutions
Users running multiple Docker containers who want to track resource usage history per container
Ops personnel who need to set alerts (e.g., CPU, memory, disk) and receive timely notifications
Enterprise users who want to integrate existing authentication via OAuth

zh.tag: 云原生高性能向量数据库，支撑十亿级向量检索
zh.what: Milvus 是一个为大规模场景打造的高性能向量数据库，用于高效组织和检索文本、图像、多模态等非结构化数据，为 AI 应用提供底层检索能力。它支持单机 Standalone、轻量 Milvus Lite 以及全分布式 K8s 原生部署多种形态。
zh.content: 仓库包含数据库核心引擎、分布式协调与存储组件、SDK、部署脚本（Docker/Helm）以及文档和教程，并配有 Slack、Discord 等社区入口。
zh.stack: 主要用 Go 和 C++ 编写，针对 CPU/GPU 做硬件加速，依赖 Kubernetes 实现云原生分布式部署，并提供 Python 等多种语言的客户端。
zh.hot: 作为 RAG 与 AI 应用的关键基础设施，Milvus 已积累 46122 颗星，本月新增 536 星并登上 GitHub Trending Go 月榜第 18 名，热度持续稳定。
uses: 构建 RAG、语义搜索与推荐系统的 AI 应用开发者
需要处理十亿级向量、追求高并发低延迟检索的企业团队
希望用 pip 快速上手向量检索原型的 Python 用户
在 K8s 上部署云原生数据基础设施的平台工程师

en.tag: Cloud-native high-performance vector database for billion-scale ANN search
en.what: Milvus is a high-performance vector database built for scale, organizing and searching large amounts of unstructured data such as text, images and multi-modal information to power AI applications. It ships in Standalone, lightweight Milvus Lite and fully distributed Kubernetes-native forms.
en.content: The repo contains the core database engine, distributed coordination and storage components, SDKs, deployment scripts (Docker/Helm), docs and tutorials, plus community channels like Slack and Discord.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go and C++, with hardware acceleration for CPU/GPU, Kubernetes-native distributed deployment, and clients in Python and other languages.
en.hot: As key infrastructure for RAG and AI applications, Milvus has reached 46,122 stars, adding 536 this month and ranking 18th on GitHub Trending's monthly Go list, showing steady momentum.
uses: AI developers building RAG, semantic search and recommendation systems
Enterprise teams handling billions of vectors with high concurrency and low latency
Python users who want a quick pip-install vector search prototype
Platform engineers deploying cloud-native data infrastructure on Kubernetes

zh.tag: 通用代理平台，一站式网络代理工具箱
zh.what: sing-box 是一个用 Go 编写的通用代理平台，把多种代理协议、路由规则和入站出站能力统一到一个内核里。它既能当客户端也能当服务端，覆盖从个人翻墙到自建节点分发的常见需求。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 源码为主体，包含协议实现、配置解析、路由引擎与多平台构建脚本，配套文档托管在 sing-box.sagernet.org。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，采用模块化协议抽象与 JSON 配置，依赖较少，可交叉编译到 Linux、macOS、Windows、Android 与 iOS。
zh.hot: 作为新一代代理内核，它凭统一配置和活跃维护积累了 38092 颗星，本月再增 1147，稳居 Go 月榜第 17 名。
uses: 需要统一管理多种代理协议的自建节点用户
希望用单一内核替代多款代理客户端的进阶玩家
在路由器或服务器上部署透明代理的网络爱好者
关注代理内核实现、想二次开发或集成的开发者

en.tag: The universal proxy platform for all-in-one network proxying
en.what: sing-box is a universal proxy platform written in Go that unifies multiple proxy protocols, routing rules, and inbound/outbound capabilities into a single core. It works as both client and server, covering everything from personal circumvention to self-hosted node distribution.
en.content: The repo is mainly Go source code with protocol implementations, config parsing, a routing engine, and multi-platform build scripts, with docs hosted at sing-box.sagernet.org.
en.stack: Primarily Go with a modular protocol abstraction and JSON configuration, minimal dependencies, cross-compilable to Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, and iOS.
en.hot: As a next-gen proxy core, its unified config and active maintenance have earned 38,092 stars, adding 1,147 this month and ranking 17th on the Go monthly trending list.
uses: Self-hosted node users who need to manage multiple proxy protocols in one place
Advanced users wanting a single core to replace several proxy clients
Network enthusiasts deploying transparent proxies on routers or servers
Developers interested in proxy core internals for integration or forks

zh.tag: 自托管的开源任务管理器，数据完全自主掌控
zh.what: Vikunja 是一个功能全面的任务管理工具，支持看板、列表、表格等多种视图，以及团队协作、时间跟踪、文件附件等特性。它强调用户对数据的完全掌控，可自托管部署，也提供云端托管服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含后端服务（Go 编写）、前端 Web 应用、桌面客户端（Electron）以及移动端应用（通过 Flutter 实现），并提供完整的 API 文档和安装指南。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 语言，支持 SQLite、PostgreSQL 和 MySQL 数据库；前端基于 Vue.js，桌面端使用 Electron，移动端使用 Flutter。
zh.hot: 本周新增 78 星，总星数 5258，位列 Go 语言周榜第 19 名。其自托管、数据自主的理念受到关注，且项目活跃，持续迭代。
uses: 个人用户希望完全掌控自己的任务数据，避免依赖第三方云服务
团队需要自建任务管理系统，并希望有看板、时间跟踪等高级功能
开发者想研究 Go 后端与前端分离的完整项目架构

en.tag: Self-hosted open-source task manager with full data ownership
en.what: Vikunja is a feature-rich task manager supporting kanban, list, table views, team collaboration, time tracking, file attachments, and more. It emphasizes full data ownership, allowing self-hosting or using the hosted cloud service.
en.content: The repository includes a backend service written in Go, a frontend web app, a desktop client (Electron), and mobile apps (via Flutter), along with comprehensive API docs and installation guides.
en.stack: Backend in Go with SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL support; frontend built with Vue.js; desktop via Electron; mobile via Flutter.
en.hot: Gained 78 stars this week, total 5258, ranking #19 on the Go weekly trending. Its self-hosting and data ownership philosophy attracts attention, with active development.

Teams needing a self-hosted task management system with advanced features like kanban and time tracking
Developers interested in studying a full-stack project with Go backend and separate frontend

zh.tag: 可编程的混合模型路由层，为异构 LLM 推理按需选路
zh.what: vLLM Semantic Router 是一个可编程路由层，用于构建跨异构 LLM 基础设施的 Mixture-of-Models 系统。它根据请求信号、用户偏好和应用策略，为每个请求选择或组合合适的模型路径，从而在不改动应用代码的前提下优化质量、成本、延迟、隐私与安全。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的路由核心、安装脚本（install.sh）、在线 Playground 与文档站点（website/），以及面向 Hugging Face 的模型资源与博客、论文等资料。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go 1.25，提供 curl 一键安装脚本，并支持 pip、uv 及 agent 驱动安装；配套在线 Playground、文档站与 Hugging Face 模型仓库。
zh.hot: 作为 vLLM 项目旗下新作，它切中多模型混用与异构推理的痛点，本周新增 181 star、总数达 5741，登上 GitHub Trending Go 周榜第 8 名。
uses: AI 平台工程师：需要在多模型、多算力间做统一路由与成本优化
应用开发者：希望不写死路由逻辑就能按用户偏好切换或组合模型
企业架构师：关注数据边界、隐私与安全合规的推理部署
研究者与爱好者：想体验可编程 Mixture-of-Models 路由的实验能力

en.tag: A programmable Mixture-of-Models routing layer for heterogeneous LLM inference
en.what: vLLM Semantic Router is a programmable routing layer for building Mixture-of-Models systems across heterogeneous LLM infrastructure. It evaluates request signals, user preferences, and application policies to select or compose the right model path per request, improving quality, cost, latency, privacy, and safety without hard-coding routing logic into applications.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based routing core, an install script (install.sh), an online playground and documentation site (website/), plus Hugging Face model assets, blog posts, and publications.
en.stack: Main language is Go 1.25, with a curl one-liner installer and support for pip, uv, and agent-driven installation; it ships with an online playground, docs site, and Hugging Face model repo.
en.hot: As a new vLLM-project effort, it targets the pain of mixing multiple models and heterogeneous inference; it gained 181 stars this week to reach 5,741 total, ranking #8 on GitHub Trending's weekly Go chart.
uses: AI platform engineers: need unified routing and cost optimization across multiple models and compute
App developers: want to switch or compose models by user preference without hard-coding routing
Enterprise architects: care about data boundaries, privacy, and safety compliance in inference
Researchers and enthusiasts: want to experiment with programmable Mixture-of-Models routing

zh.tag: 跨平台开源多轨音频编辑器与录音软件
zh.what: Audacity 是一款易用的多轨音频编辑器和录音软件，支持 Windows、macOS、GNU/Linux 等系统。它提供录音、编辑、混音、效果处理等功能，适合播客、音乐制作和音频修复等场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Audacity 的完整源代码，包括核心编辑器、音频引擎、效果插件、UI 资源等。当前正在开发 Audacity 4，采用全新 UI 并进行大规模重构，同时保留 3.x 分支供维护。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 wxWidgets（UI）、PortAudio（音频 I/O）等库。构建系统支持 CMake，并提供针对不同平台的构建脚本。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源音频工具，Audacity 长期拥有稳定用户群。近期因 Audacity 4 的 UI 重构和功能更新引发关注，今日新增 272 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第二。
uses: 播客制作者：录制和编辑多轨音频，添加效果和导出播客节目。
音乐爱好者：进行简单的录音、剪辑和混音，或修复老旧录音。
教育场景：用于音频教学、学生录音作业或声音实验。
音频修复：去除噪音、剪辑对话或恢复历史录音。

en.tag: Cross-platform open-source multi-track audio editor and recorder
en.what: Audacity is an easy-to-use, multi-track audio editor and recorder for Windows, macOS, GNU/Linux and other operating systems. It provides recording, editing, mixing, and effects processing, suitable for podcasting, music production, and audio restoration.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Audacity, including the core editor, audio engine, effects plugins, and UI resources. It is currently undergoing major structural change for Audacity 4, with a brand-new UI and refactorings, while maintaining the 3.x branch.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relying on wxWidgets for UI, PortAudio for audio I/O, and other libraries. The build system uses CMake, with platform-specific build scripts.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source audio tool, Audacity has a stable user base. Recent attention is driven by the UI overhaul and updates for Audacity 4, gaining 272 stars today and ranking #2 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Podcasters: record and edit multi-track audio, add effects, and export episodes.
Music enthusiasts: perform simple recording, editing, and mixing, or restore old recordings.
Educational settings: use for audio teaching, student recording assignments, or sound experiments.
Audio restoration: remove noise, edit dialogue, or recover historical recordings.

zh.tag: 高性能内存数据存储，兼容 Redis 与 Memcached
zh.what: Dragonfly 是一个现代化的内存数据存储，专为现代应用负载设计。它完全兼容 Redis 和 Memcached API，无需修改代码即可迁移。相比传统内存存储，吞吐量提升 25 倍，资源消耗降低 80%。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心引擎源码、文档、基准测试、构建指南以及多语言 README。还提供了 Docker 镜像和云服务入口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Linux 内核特性如 epoll 和 io_uring。支持 Docker 部署，并提供 Helm charts 用于 Kubernetes。
zh.hot: 作为 Redis 和 Memcached 的现代替代品，凭借惊人的性能提升和资源节省，在 C++ 社区持续火爆，今日新增 77 星，总星数达 31150。
uses: 需要高吞吐、低延迟缓存服务的后端开发团队，可无缝替代 Redis。
希望在降低基础设施成本的同时提升性能的运维和架构师。
对内存数据库内部实现感兴趣的 C++ 开发者，可阅读源码学习。

en.tag: High-performance in-memory data store, Redis & Memcached compatible
en.what: Dragonfly is a modern in-memory data store built for modern application workloads. It is fully compatible with Redis and Memcached APIs, requiring no code changes to adopt. Compared to legacy in-memory datastores, it delivers 25X more throughput and uses up to 80% less resources.
en.content: The repository contains core engine source code, documentation, benchmarks, build guides, and multi-language READMEs. It also provides Docker images and a cloud service entry point.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, leveraging Linux kernel features like epoll and io_uring. Supports Docker deployment and provides Helm charts for Kubernetes.
en.hot: As a modern replacement for Redis and Memcached, it gains popularity in the C++ community due to its impressive performance gains and resource savings, with 77 new stars today and 31,150 total.
uses: Backend teams needing high-throughput, low-latency caching, seamlessly replacing Redis.
Ops and architects aiming to cut infrastructure costs while boosting performance.
C++ developers interested in the internals of in-memory databases for learning.

zh.tag: 微软官方 WinUI 现代 Windows UI 框架
zh.what: WinUI 是微软推出的现代 UI 框架，提供丰富的控件和样式，用于构建高性能的 Windows 应用程序。当前版本 WinUI 3 作为 Windows App SDK 的一部分发布，支持 Fluent Design，并可通过 .NET 或 C++ 开发。

需要跨版本兼容（Windows 10 1809+）的 Win32 或 UWP 开发者
学习微软官方 UI 框架和 Windows App SDK 的学生或爱好者

en.tag: Microsoft's official WinUI framework for modern Windows apps
en.what: WinUI is Microsoft's modern UI framework with a rich set of controls and styles for building high-performance Windows apps. The current version, WinUI 3, ships as part of the Windows App SDK, embracing Fluent Design and supporting development with .NET or C++.

Win32 or UWP developers needing cross-version compatibility (Windows 10 1809+)
Students or enthusiasts learning Microsoft's official UI framework and Windows App SDK

zh.tag: 为魔兽世界私服注入真人般AI玩家机器人

单机怀旧玩家，想在没有真人的情况下体验组队、副本和战场
AzerothCore 模块开发者，研究 AI 行为与服务器性能优化
想搭建小型多人服务器但缺少真实玩家的社区运营者

en.tag: Player-like AI bots for AzerothCore WoW servers
en.what: This is an AzerothCore module that adds player-like bots to a World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King server. Bots can log in your alts, form parties, level up, complete quests, run raids and battlegrounds, and wander the world to simulate a real MMO experience.

Solo nostalgia players who want party, raid, and battleground experiences without real people
AzerothCore module developers researching AI behavior and server performance
Community operators building small servers but lacking real players

zh.tag: 原生高性能桌面启动器，支持 Raycast 生态扩展
zh.what: Vicinae 是一款用 C++ 编写的高性能原生桌面命令面板（启动器），可替代 Spotlight/Alfred/Raycast。开箱即用支持应用搜索、剪贴板历史、文本片段、文件搜索、浏览器标签切换、表情选择、计算器、窗口切换等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 核心源码、extra 目录下的 logo 与截图资源，以及文档站点（vicinae.com）与 Discord 社区链接；扩展体系涵盖 React/TypeScript 扩展、脚本命令和 dmenu 风格菜单。
zh.stack: 主语言为 C++，追求原生性能；扩展层使用 React/TypeScript，并兼容 Raycast 扩展与脚本生态。
zh.hot: 凭借原生 C++ 带来的速度优势与对 Raycast 生态的兼容，Vicinae 已积累近万 star（9777），今日新增 81 星并登上 GitHub C++ 日榜第 5 名。
uses: 追求极致启动速度、想摆脱 Electron 启动器的 Linux/桌面用户
希望复用 Raycast 扩展与脚本生态的开发者
需要剪贴板历史、文本片段等效率工具的日常办公人群
想用 React/TypeScript 编写自定义启动器扩展的前端开发者

en.tag: A native, high-performance desktop launcher with Raycast-compatible extensions
en.what: Vicinae is a high-performance, native command palette for the desktop, written in C++, positioned as an alternative to Spotlight/Alfred/Raycast. Out of the box it handles app search, clipboard history, snippets, file search, browser tab switching, emoji picking, calculator, and window switching.
en.content: The repo contains the C++ core source, logo and screenshot assets under extra/, plus links to the docs site (vicinae.com) and Discord community; its extension system covers React/TypeScript extensions, script commands, and dmenu-style menus.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++ for native performance; the extension layer uses React/TypeScript and is compatible with the Raycast extension and script ecosystem.
en.hot: With native C++ speed and Raycast ecosystem compatibility, Vicinae has reached nearly 10k stars (9,777), gaining 81 today and ranking 5th on GitHub's daily C++ trending list.
uses: Desktop/Linux users who want maximum launcher speed without Electron overhead
Developers who want to reuse the Raycast extension and script ecosystem
Everyday users needing clipboard history, snippets, and other productivity tools
Frontend developers who want to build custom launcher extensions in React/TypeScript

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 格式化库，快速安全的 printf/iostream 替代品
zh.what: {fmt} 是一个开源格式化库，提供快速且安全的 C stdio 和 C++ iostreams 替代方案。它实现了 C++20 的 std::format 和 C++23 的 std::print，并支持类似 Python 的格式字符串语法。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的库源码、文档、示例和测试，核心文件包括 base.h、format.h 等，支持用户自定义类型和可移植的 Unicode。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，依赖少，支持 C++11 及以上标准，使用 Dragonbox 算法进行快速浮点格式化。
zh.hot: 今日新增 963 星，总星数达 25081，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。作为 C++ 标准库格式化功能的基础，其高性能和安全性备受开发者青睐。
uses: C++ 开发者需要比 printf 或 iostream 更安全、更快速的格式化输出时使用
库作者希望实现或扩展 C++20/23 格式化功能，或为自定义类型提供格式化支持
需要高精度浮点格式化且要求正确舍入和往返保证的数值计算场景

en.tag: A modern C++ formatting library, fast and safe alternative to printf and iostreams
en.what: {fmt} is an open-source formatting library providing a fast and safe alternative to C stdio and C++ iostreams. It implements C++20's std::format and C++23's std::print, with a format string syntax similar to Python's.
en.content: The repository contains full library source code, documentation, examples, and tests, with core files like base.h and format.h, supporting user-defined types and portable Unicode.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation with minimal dependencies, supports C++11 and later, uses the Dragonbox algorithm for fast floating-point formatting.
en.hot: With 963 stars added today and 25,081 total, it tops the GitHub Trending daily chart. As the foundation for C++ standard formatting, its high performance and safety are widely appreciated.
uses: For C++ developers needing safer and faster formatting than printf or iostreams
For library authors implementing or extending C++20/23 formatting, or adding formatting support for custom types
For numerical computing scenarios requiring high-precision floating-point formatting with correct rounding and round-trip guarantees

zh.tag: 跨平台开源密码管理器，离线加密存储敏感信息
zh.what: KeePassXC 是 Windows 应用 KeePass Password Safe 的社区驱动跨平台移植版，用于安全地存储和管理用户名、密码、URL、附件与笔记等敏感信息。所有数据保存在本地加密的 KDBX 文件中，可放在任意位置，包括私有或公有云盘。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 桌面应用源码，涵盖核心数据库逻辑、GUI、密码生成器、TOTP、浏览器集成与自动输入等模块，并配有测试、CI 配置和文档。

zh.hot: 作为老牌开源密码管理器，它已积累 28739 颗星，本月新增 485 星并登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 C++ 第 17 名，反映出用户对本地优先、可审计安全工具的持续需求。
uses: 注重隐私、希望密码完全离线自管的个人用户
需要在 Windows/macOS/Linux 多平台同步使用同一密码库的用户
想审计或自行编译安全软件的开发者与安全爱好者
为团队或家庭搭建本地密码共享方案的技术人员

en.tag: Cross-platform open-source password manager with offline encrypted storage
en.what: KeePassXC is a community-driven, cross-platform port of the Windows KeePass Password Safe, built to securely store and manage sensitive data such as usernames, passwords, URLs, attachments, and notes. Everything lives in a local encrypted KDBX file that can be kept anywhere, including private or public cloud storage.
en.content: The repo holds the full C++ desktop application source, covering core database logic, GUI, password generator, TOTP, browser integration, and auto-type modules, along with tests, CI configs, and docs.
en.stack: Built mainly in C++ with the Qt framework, depending on libgcrypt, Argon2, zlib and other crypto/compression libraries, targeting Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source password manager, it has accumulated 28,739 stars with 485 added this month, ranking 17th on GitHub Trending's monthly C++ list, reflecting steady demand for local-first, auditable security tools.
uses: Privacy-conscious individuals who want fully offline, self-hosted password storage
Users who need the same password vault across Windows, macOS, and Linux
Developers and security enthusiasts who want to audit or self-compile security software
Technical users setting up local password sharing for teams or families

zh.tag: 跨平台开源 PSP 模拟器，C++ 编写，无需 BIOS 即可运行

对模拟器开发、C++ 高性能编程感兴趣的学习者

Learners interested in emulator development and high-performance C++
Developers looking to contribute code or testing to an open-source project

zh.tag: 3D打印切片与G代码生成工具

zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建文档（doc/Build.md）、资源文件（如图标）以及贡献指南。主要功能包括精确的打印参数设置、模型编辑（如涂色、切割、排列）、多项目多平台支持、多材料打印、3D 预览和命令行接口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，基于 Slic3r 构建，依赖常见的图形和几何库。支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台，Linux 通过 Flathub 分发。
zh.hot: 作为 3D 打印领域的知名开源切片软件，PrusaSlicer 持续获得关注，今日新增 13 颗星，总星数达 9296，位列 C++ 趋势榜第三。其强大的功能和活跃的社区是热度来源。
uses: 3D 打印爱好者：使用 PrusaSlicer 将模型切片并生成打印指令，支持多种打印机。
专业用户：需要精细控制打印参数和进行多材料打印的工程师或设计师。
自动化工作流：通过命令行接口在无 GUI 环境下集成切片功能。

en.tag: 3D printing slicer and G-code generator
en.what: PrusaSlicer is a software that converts 3D models into 3D printing instructions (G-code), supporting FDM and mSLA printers. Developed by Prusa Research, it is compatible with a wide range of printer brands and offers extensive printing parameter settings and model editing features.
en.content: The repository contains the complete C++ source code, build documentation (doc/Build.md), resource files (e.g., icons), and contribution guidelines. Key features include precise printing parameter settings, model editing (painting, cutting, arranging), multi-project and multi-bed support, multi-material printing, 3D preview, and a command-line interface.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, built on Slic3r, and relies on common graphics and geometry libraries. Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux; Linux is distributed via Flathub.
en.hot: As a well-known open-source slicer in 3D printing, PrusaSlicer continues to gain attention, adding 13 stars today, reaching 9296 total, ranking third on the C++ trending list. Its powerful features and active community drive its popularity.
uses: 3D printing enthusiasts: use PrusaSlicer to slice models and generate print instructions for various printers.
Professional users: engineers or designers needing precise control over print parameters and multi-material printing.
Automation workflows: integrate slicing via command-line interface in headless environments.

zh.tag: 跨平台高性能机器学习推理与训练加速器
zh.what: ONNX Runtime 是一个跨平台的机器学习推理和训练加速器，支持 PyTorch、TensorFlow/Keras 等深度学习框架以及 scikit-learn、LightGBM、XGBoost 等经典机器学习库。它通过硬件加速器、图优化和变换，在不同硬件、驱动和操作系统上提供最佳性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ONNX Runtime 的完整源代码、文档、示例和发布版本，以及用于推理和训练的示例仓库和插件执行提供程序（如 QNN）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持多种语言绑定（如 Python、C#、Java），并依赖 ONNX 格式和硬件加速库（如 CUDA、TensorRT）。
zh.hot: 作为微软开源的跨平台推理引擎，ONNX Runtime 在 AI 部署领域具有重要地位，本月新增 306 星，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 需要在多种硬件（CPU、GPU、NPU）上部署机器学习模型的开发者
希望加速 PyTorch 或 TensorFlow 模型推理的工程团队
需要跨平台（Windows、Linux、macOS）统一推理解决方案的企业
研究模型优化和硬件加速的 AI 基础设施工程师

en.tag: Cross-platform, high-performance ML inference and training accelerator
en.what: ONNX Runtime is a cross-platform inference and training accelerator for machine learning, supporting models from deep learning frameworks like PyTorch and TensorFlow/Keras, as well as classical ML libraries such as scikit-learn, LightGBM, and XGBoost. It leverages hardware accelerators, graph optimizations, and transforms to deliver optimal performance across various hardware, drivers, and operating systems.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, examples, and releases for ONNX Runtime, along with companion sample repositories for inference and training, and plugin execution providers like QNN.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with bindings for multiple languages (e.g., Python, C#, Java), and relies on the ONNX format and hardware acceleration libraries (e.g., CUDA, TensorRT).
en.hot: As Microsoft's open-source cross-platform inference engine, ONNX Runtime holds a key position in AI deployment, gaining 306 stars this month and continuing to attract developer attention.
uses: Developers deploying ML models on diverse hardware (CPU, GPU, NPU)
Engineering teams looking to accelerate PyTorch or TensorFlow model inference
Enterprises needing a unified cross-platform (Windows, Linux, macOS) inference solution
AI infrastructure engineers researching model optimization and hardware acceleration

zh.tag: 隐私优先、快速、诚实的开源浏览器
zh.what: Helium 是一款基于 Chromium 的网页浏览器，主打隐私保护、无偏见广告拦截，且无冗余功能。它旨在为用户提供干净、快速的上网体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Helium 的核心代码、补丁集（按供应商分类）、构建工具和文档。此外，还有独立的平台打包仓库（macOS、Linux、Windows）以及服务、引导和 uBlock 分支等组件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，基于 Chromium 和 ungoogled-chromium，并整合了来自 Inox、Debian、Bromite、Iridium、Brave 等项目的补丁。
zh.hot: Helium 在 GitHub 上已获得 20,749 颗星，本月新增 1,386 颗，位列 C++ 月榜第 22 名。其隐私保护和轻量级特性吸引了大量关注。
uses: 注重隐私、希望避免广告跟踪的用户
寻求轻量、快速浏览体验的普通用户
对开源浏览器感兴趣并愿意贡献的开发者

en.tag: Private, fast, and honest open-source web browser
en.what: Helium is a Chromium-based web browser focused on privacy, unbiased ad-blocking, and a bloat-free experience. It aims to deliver a clean and fast browsing experience for users.
en.content: The repository contains Helium's core code, patch sets (sorted by vendor), build tools, and documentation. Additionally, there are separate platform packaging repos (macOS, Linux, Windows) and components like services, onboarding, and a uBlock fork.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, based on Chromium and ungoogled-chromium, and incorporates patches from projects like Inox, Debian, Bromite, Iridium, and Brave.
en.hot: Helium has gained 20,749 stars on GitHub, with 1,386 added this month, ranking 22nd on the monthly C++ trending list. Its privacy-focused and lightweight features have attracted significant attention.
uses: Users who value privacy and want to avoid ad tracking
Everyday users seeking a lightweight and fast browsing experience
Developers interested in open-source browsers and willing to contribute

zh.tag: 谷歌 DeepMind 维护的通用物理仿真引擎
zh.what: MuJoCo 全称 Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact，是一个面向机器人、生物力学、图形动画与机器学习研究的通用物理引擎，专注对关节结构与环境的接触交互做快速而精确的仿真。它由 Google DeepMind 维护，提供 C API 与 Python 绑定，适合研究者与开发者使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 C++ 编写的核心仿真运行时、内置 XML 编译器与预分配数据结构，以及基于 OpenGL 的原生交互式查看器 simulate；此外还有 Python 绑定、Unity 插件、Colab 教程笔记本和完整文档。
zh.stack: 核心用 C++ 实现，依赖 OpenGL 做可视化，提供 C API、Python 绑定和 Unity 插件，配套 CMake 构建与 GitHub Actions 持续集成。
zh.hot: 作为强化学习与机器人仿真的事实标准之一，MuJoCo 长期被学术界广泛采用，本月新增 653 star、总量达 15230，位列 GitHub Trending C++ 月榜第 23 名。
uses: 强化学习与机器人研究者，用于搭建高保真仿真环境训练控制策略
生物力学与动画开发者，需要精确模拟关节与接触动力学
需要 Python 快速上手仿真的工程师，可直接使用绑定与 Colab 教程
游戏或 Unity 开发者，希望通过插件集成物理仿真能力

en.tag: A general-purpose physics simulator maintained by Google DeepMind
en.what: MuJoCo stands for Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact; it is a general-purpose physics engine built for fast, accurate simulation of articulated structures interacting with their environments, serving robotics, biomechanics, graphics, animation and machine learning. Maintained by Google DeepMind, it ships a C API plus Python bindings for researchers and developers.
en.content: The repo holds the C++ simulation runtime with a built-in XML compiler and preallocated low-level data structures, plus the OpenGL-based native interactive viewer simulate. It also includes Python bindings, a Unity plug-in, Colab tutorial notebooks and full documentation.
en.stack: The core is written in C++ with OpenGL for visualization, exposing a C API, Python bindings and a Unity plug-in, built with CMake and continuous integration via GitHub Actions.
en.hot: As a de facto standard for reinforcement learning and robotics simulation, MuJoCo is widely adopted in academia; it gained 653 stars this month for a total of 15,230, ranking 23rd on GitHub's monthly C++ trending list.
uses: Reinforcement learning and robotics researchers building high-fidelity simulation environments to train control policies
Biomechanics and animation developers needing accurate joint and contact dynamics
Engineers who want quick Python-based simulation via the bindings and Colab tutorials
Game or Unity developers looking to integrate physics simulation through the plug-in

zh.tag: 跨平台键鼠共享软件KVM
zh.what: Deskflow 是一款免费开源的键盘和鼠标共享应用，允许你使用一套键鼠控制多台电脑，并在它们之间无缝工作。它类似于软件 KVM，但无需视频切换，支持 TLS 加密、Wayland 和剪贴板共享。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Deskflow 的完整源代码，主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 Windows、macOS、Linux 等平台的构建脚本和安装包，并包含详细的构建文档和 Wiki。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 Qt 框架和 OpenSSL 等库，支持跨平台构建，包括 CMake 构建系统。
zh.hot: 该项目拥有 28964 个 Star，本月新增 819 个，在 GitHub Trending 月榜（C++）中排名第 24，因其解决多设备办公痛点且开源免费而受欢迎。
uses: 多设备办公用户 —— 使用一套键鼠控制台式机、笔记本等多台电脑，提升工作效率。
开发者和运维人员 —— 在多个操作系统间切换时保持流畅操作，无需频繁插拔外设。
家庭或小型办公室 —— 低成本实现多台电脑的键鼠共享，替代硬件 KVM。
开源爱好者 —— 可自行编译和定制，参与社区贡献。

en.tag: Cross-platform keyboard and mouse sharing software KVM
en.what: Deskflow is a free and open source keyboard and mouse sharing app that lets you control multiple computers with one keyboard and mouse, working seamlessly between them. It's like a software KVM without video, with TLS encryption, Wayland support, and clipboard sharing.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Deskflow, primarily written in C++, with build scripts and packages for Windows, macOS, and Linux, along with detailed build documentation and a wiki.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++ using the Qt framework and OpenSSL, with cross-platform support via CMake build system.
en.hot: With 28,964 stars and 819 added this month, it ranks 24th on GitHub Trending monthly (C++) and is popular for solving multi-device workflow pain points as a free open-source tool.
uses: Multi-device office users — control multiple computers (desktop, laptop) with one keyboard and mouse to boost productivity.
Developers and IT pros — switch between operating systems seamlessly without swapping peripherals.
Home or small office — share keyboard and mouse across computers at low cost, replacing hardware KVM.
Open-source enthusiasts — build and customize from source, contribute to the community.

zh.tag: 把整个项目文件夹变成可查询知识图谱的 AI 技能
zh.what: 给 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手用的 skill：输入 /graphify，它就把整个项目（代码、SQL schema、文档、PDF、图片、视频）映射成一张可查询的知识图谱，代替 grep 翻文件。代码解析走 tree-sitter AST —— 确定性、不用 LLM、完全本地；文档类内容才走模型做语义处理。不是向量索引，是真图谱，每条边标注 EXTRACTED（直接读到）还是 INFERRED（推断出来）。
zh.content: 以 CLI 形式分发（PyPI 包 graphifyy，uv tool install 或 pipx 安装），仓库含 docs/（30 多种语言 README 翻译）和交互式 graph.html 可视化产物；默认分支 v8，迭代很快。
zh.stack: Python + tree-sitter 代码解析，产出力导向 HTML 图；挂到各家 CLI 助手上当 skill 用。
zh.hot: 它用知识图谱补足纯向量检索的局限，直接回应团队构建上下文型 AI 助手时遇到的 RAG 难题。
uses: 接手中大型老项目的开发者 —— 一条命令生成知识图谱，快速搞清代码结构
AI 重度用户 —— 给 agent 换图谱上下文，替代检索不准的向量 RAG
技术文档团队 —— 把文档 / PDF / 图纸一起纳入可查询图谱

en.tag: An AI skill that turns a whole project folder into a queryable knowledge graph
en.what: A skill for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more: type /graphify and your entire project — code, SQL schemas, docs, PDFs, images, videos — is mapped into a queryable knowledge graph, replacing grep-and-scroll. Code parsing uses tree-sitter AST: deterministic, no LLM, fully local; only document content goes through a model. Not a vector index — a real graph, with every edge labeled EXTRACTED (read directly) or INFERRED.
en.content: Distributed as a CLI (PyPI package graphifyy, install via uv tool install or pipx); the repo holds docs/ (README translations in 30+ languages) and interactive graph.html visualizations; default branch v8, iterating fast.
en.stack: Python + tree-sitter, outputting force-directed HTML graphs; hooks into each CLI assistant as a skill.
en.hot: Its knowledge-graph alternative to vector-only retrieval speaks directly to limitations teams encounter when building contextual AI assistants.
uses: Developers inheriting large legacy projects — one command maps the codebase into a knowledge graph
Heavy AI users — swap vector RAG for graph context that retrieves the right thing
Docs teams — fold docs, PDFs and diagrams into one queryable graph

zh.tag: 港大出品的 AI 私人家教：个性化终身学习工作区
zh.what: 香港大学 HKUDS 实验室的「agent 原生」学习平台：聊天辅导、刷题测验、深度研究、可视化、解题、Mastery Path 掌握度练习跑在同一套 agent 循环上。支持多引擎 RAG 知识库（LlamaIndex、PageIndex、GraphRAG、LightRAG，可挂 Obsidian 库），可从任意对话呼叫 Claude Code / Codex 等子 agent；带三层可检查记忆（L1 trace / L2 摘要 / L3 综合）和 Memory Graph 溯源。
zh.content: 完整 Web 应用（Python 后端 + Next.js 16 前端），附 11 种语言 README、Docker 部署、CLI/agent-native 接口、EduHub 社区 skills 生态；发版极勤。
zh.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16，RAG 多引擎 + MCP 工具 + FAISS 向量库，Apache-2.0；2025 年 12 月底创建，有 arXiv 论文背书。
zh.hot: 它把 AI 教育与 Agent 原生工作流结合，并由高校实验室持续维护，概念清晰、可体验性强。
uses: 学生 / 自学者 —— 把教材和论文喂进去，得到 24 小时私人家教
考研 / 考证党 —— 用刷题测验 + 掌握度路径系统备考
知识管理玩家 —— 直接挂 Obsidian 库做 RAG 问答

en.tag: An AI personal tutor from HKU: a lifelong, personalized learning workspace
en.what: An 'agent-native' learning platform from HKU's HKUDS lab: chat tutoring, quizzes, deep research, visualization, problem solving and Mastery-Path practice all run on one agent loop. It supports multi-engine RAG knowledge bases (LlamaIndex, PageIndex, GraphRAG, LightRAG — even your Obsidian vault), lets you call Claude Code / Codex sub-agents from any conversation, and ships three-layer inspectable memory (L1 trace / L2 summary / L3 synthesis) with a Memory Graph for provenance.
en.content: A full web app (Python backend + Next.js 16 frontend) with READMEs in 11 languages, Docker deployment, CLI/agent-native interfaces and the EduHub community skills ecosystem; releases ship very frequently.
en.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16, multi-engine RAG + MCP tools + FAISS; Apache-2.0; created late December 2025 with an arXiv paper behind it.
en.hot: It combines AI education with an agent-native workflow and carries the credibility of a university research lab, making the concept easy to evaluate and share.
uses: Students & self-learners — feed in textbooks and papers, get a 24/7 personal tutor
Exam candidates — prepare systematically with quizzes and the mastery path
PKM enthusiasts — plug your Obsidian vault straight in for RAG Q&A

zh.tag: 专治「AI 味」网页的设计 skill，让 AI 生成的 UI 不像模板货
zh.what: Together AI 出品的设计 skill 包：装进 Claude Code、Cursor 或 Codex 后，AI 生成网页 UI 时会从 20 套主题里选宏观结构，并跑 57 项「anti-slop」检查加自我批判，拒绝 LLM 默认那套千篇一律的渐变卡片风。提供生成、hallmark audit（给现有代码打分）、hallmark redesign（换结构重写）、hallmark study（从截图/URL 提取设计 DNA）四个动词。
zh.content: 核心是 skills/hallmark/ 下的 SKILL.md + references/ 规则文件；docs/ 有 recipes 和示例，site/ 是官网及大量自包含 HTML+CSS 示例页（语言占比因此显示为 CSS）。
zh.stack: Markdown 规则 + 参考文档的 skill 包（符合 Agent Skills 规范），示例为纯 HTML/CSS，MIT，无运行时依赖，一行 npx skills add nutlope/hallmark 安装。
zh.hot: 它直指 AI 生成网站同质化这一普遍痛点，并用在线 Demo 降低验证门槛，定位清晰且易于传播。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 没有设计师，也能让 AI 生成不撞脸的官网和落地页
设计师 —— 用 hallmark study 从优秀网站提取设计 DNA 做参考
前端工程师 —— 用 audit 给存量项目打分，找出「AI 味」重灾区

en.tag: The anti-'AI-slop' design skill — AI-built UIs that don't look like templates
en.what: A design skill pack from Together AI: once installed in Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, your agent picks a macro-structure from 20 themes when generating web UIs, then runs 57 'anti-slop' checks plus self-critique — rejecting the default LLM look of identical gradient cards. Four verbs: generate, hallmark audit (score existing code), hallmark redesign (rewrite with a new structure), hallmark study (extract design DNA from a screenshot or URL).
en.content: The core is SKILL.md plus rule files under skills/hallmark/ and references/; docs/ holds recipes and examples; site/ contains the homepage and many self-contained HTML+CSS example pages (which is why the language stat reads CSS).
en.stack: A Markdown-rules skill pack (Agent Skills compliant) with pure HTML/CSS examples; MIT, zero runtime dependencies; install via npx skills add nutlope/hallmark.
en.hot: Its anti-slop positioning addresses a common complaint about AI-generated websites, while the live demo makes the claim easy to evaluate.
uses: Indie devs & small teams — generate distinctive sites and landing pages without a designer
Designers — extract design DNA from great sites with hallmark study
Frontend engineers — audit existing projects to find the worst 'AI-slop' offenders

zh.tag: 开源版 CapCut（剪映），免费跨平台视频编辑器
zh.what: 免费开源视频编辑器，对标 CapCut，目标覆盖 Web、桌面和移动端。项目正在从零重写：Editor API、插件优先架构、Rust 核心（一套代码跑桌面/移动/浏览器）、供 AI agent 调用的 MCP server、无头批量渲染模式和编辑器内置脚本页。旧版代码已迁至 opencut-classic 继续维护。
zh.content: monorepo：apps/web、apps/desktop、apps/api 三个应用，根目录 Cargo.toml（Rust 核心）；用 moonrepo + proto 管理工具链，moon run web:dev 即可起本地开发。
zh.stack: TypeScript（Web 前端）+ Rust 核心，Bun 包管理，MIT；重写期间暂不接受外部代码贡献。
zh.hot: 「开源视频剪辑工具」满足了广泛需求，Rust 重写与基于 MCP 的 AI 剪辑能力又形成了清晰的技术差异。
uses: 自媒体创作者 —— 免费替代剪映专业版，无水印跨平台剪片
开发者 / 自动化团队 —— 通过 MCP server 让 AI agent 批量剪视频
企业 —— 基于 Editor API 和插件架构搭建内部视频流水线

en.tag: The open-source CapCut alternative — free, cross-platform video editing
en.what: A free, open-source video editor rivaling CapCut, targeting web, desktop and mobile. The project is being rewritten from scratch: an Editor API, plugin-first architecture, a Rust core (one codebase for desktop/mobile/browser), an MCP server so AI agents can edit video, a headless mode for automated batch rendering, and built-in editor scripting. Legacy code lives on in opencut-classic.
en.content: A monorepo: apps/web, apps/desktop and apps/api, with a root Cargo.toml for the Rust core; toolchain managed by moonrepo + proto — `moon run web:dev` starts local dev.
en.stack: TypeScript (web frontend) + Rust core, Bun for packages, MIT; external code contributions are paused during the rewrite.
en.hot: The open-source alternative to CapCut addresses broad latent demand, while the Rust rewrite and MCP-based AI editing story give the project a distinct technical direction.
uses: Content creators — a free, watermark-free CapCut Pro alternative across platforms
Dev & automation teams — batch-edit video via AI agents over the MCP server
Companies — build internal video pipelines on the Editor API and plugin architecture

zh.tag: 开源一体化产品数据平台：分析、回放、实验、LLM 观测全包
zh.what: 知名开源产品数据平台：产品分析、Web 分析、session 回放、feature flag、A/B 实验、错误追踪、日志、问卷、数据仓库、CDP、LLM 可观测性全部集成在一个系统。最新定位「构建自驱动产品（self-driving products）」：把错误、rage click 等产品信号自动转成分析报告和 PR 供你 review 合并，可从 Slack、Web、桌面端或 MCP 操作，支持 Docker 自托管。
zh.content: 超大型 monorepo：posthog/（Django 后端）、frontend/、products/（各产品线）、rust/、services/、ee/（企业版，单独授权），大量 docker-compose 部署文件与全平台 SDK。
zh.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust 服务，底层 ClickHouse；MIT（ee/ 目录除外）。
zh.hot: 它把完整的产品分析套件与面向 Agent 的自动化能力结合，既有成熟开发者用户，也有清晰的新使用场景。
uses: 产品团队 —— 一个平台替代 GA + 回放 + 实验工具的组合订阅
注重数据合规的公司 —— 自托管部署，用户数据不出机房
AI 产品团队 —— 用 LLM 可观测性追踪自家 agent 的成本与质量

en.tag: The open-source all-in-one product data platform
en.what: The well-known open-source product data platform: product analytics, web analytics, session replay, feature flags, A/B experiments, error tracking, logs, surveys, a data warehouse, CDP pipelines and LLM observability in one system. Its latest positioning is 'self-driving products': product signals like errors and rage clicks are automatically turned into analysis reports and PRs for you to review and merge — operable from Slack, web, desktop or MCP, and self-hostable via Docker.
en.content: A huge monorepo: posthog/ (Django backend), frontend/, products/ (each product line), rust/, services/, ee/ (enterprise code, separately licensed), lots of docker-compose files and SDKs for every platform.
en.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust services over ClickHouse; MIT (except ee/).
en.hot: The project combines a broad product-analytics suite with an agent-facing automation narrative, giving an established developer audience a clear reason to revisit it.
uses: Product teams — replace the GA + replay + experimentation stack with one platform
Compliance-sensitive companies — self-host so user data never leaves your infra
AI product teams — track your agents' cost and quality with LLM observability

zh.tag: 1-bit/三值超压缩大模型 Bonsai 的本地运行 demo
zh.what: PrismML 的 Bonsai 系列语言模型官方演示仓库，主打极致量化：1-bit 版每权重约 1.125 bit，27B 模型能塞进现代 iPhone；三值（Ternary）版约 1.7 bit，是质量更高的默认选项。最新 27B 是视觉语言模型，支持看图、tool calling、MCP、256k+ 长上下文和推理努力度调节。
zh.content: 纯 Shell 脚本工程：setup.sh / setup.ps1 一键装依赖下模型，scripts/ 放运行和下载脚本，另有三份白皮书 PDF、AGENTS.md（写给 AI agent 看的配置指南）、VISION/TOOLS 等专题文档与社区 benchmark。
zh.stack: Shell + llama.cpp 服务端，模型托管在 HuggingFace；支持 Mac Metal、CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm 和纯 CPU，Apache-2.0。
zh.hot: 视觉语言模型与 iPhone 端侧演示把技术卖点变得直观，配套脚本也降低了上手与复现实验的门槛。
uses: 手机 / 边缘设备开发者 —— 在 iPhone 上离线跑 27B 视觉语言模型
隐私敏感场景 —— 医疗、法律等数据不出本地的本地 AI 助手
硬件玩家 —— 在树莓派等低功耗设备上体验大模型

en.tag: Local-run demo of Bonsai, the 1-bit / ternary ultra-compressed LLMs
en.what: The official demo repo for PrismML's Bonsai model family, built around extreme quantization: the 1-bit version uses ~1.125 bits per weight so a 27B model fits a modern iPhone; the ternary version (~1.7 bits) is the higher-quality default. The newest 27B is a vision-language model with image input, tool calling, MCP, 256k+ context and adjustable reasoning effort.
en.content: A pure Shell project: setup.sh / setup.ps1 one-liners install dependencies and pull models, scripts/ holds run/download scripts, plus three whitepaper PDFs, an AGENTS.md (a config guide written for AI agents), topical docs (VISION/TOOLS/…) and community benchmarks.
en.stack: Shell + a llama.cpp server, models hosted on HuggingFace; runs on Mac Metal, CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm or plain CPU; Apache-2.0.
en.hot: The vision-language model and on-device iPhone demo make a technically ambitious claim concrete, while the included scripts reduce trial friction.
uses: Mobile / edge developers — run a 27B vision-language model offline on an iPhone
Privacy-sensitive settings — local AI assistants for medical or legal data that can't leave the device
Hardware tinkerers — run LLMs on low-power boards like a Raspberry Pi

zh.tag: 100+ 个能直接跑起来的 AI Agent 和 RAG 应用合集
zh.what: 超大号 LLM 应用模板库：收录 100 多个亲手构建并端到端测试过的 AI agent、agent skill 和 RAG 应用，全部 Apache-2.0 可商用。兼容 Claude、Gemini、GPT、DeepSeek、Llama、Qwen 等主流模型，克隆下来装依赖就能跑，口号「clone, customize, ship」。
zh.content: 按难度和形态分目录：agent_skills/（npx 一键装技能）、starter_ai_agents/（单文件入门）、advanced_ai_agents/（多智能体团队）、voice_ai_agents/、always_on_agents/、RAG 教程等；每个模板配 README 和依赖清单，场景覆盖旅行规划、金融分析、播客生成、房屋装修等。
zh.stack: Python 为主，常见 Streamlit 前端 + 各家模型 SDK，部分用 CrewAI/AG2 等多智能体框架。
zh.hot: 它用大量可运行示例降低 LLM 应用试验成本，并通过 Agent Skill 模板与教程保持对实践者的持续价值。
uses: AI 入门开发者 —— 克隆单文件模板，一天跑通第一个 LLM 应用
创业团队 —— 基于成熟模板二开（旅行规划 / 金融分析 / 播客生成）快速验证 idea
企业技术选型 —— 横向对比 CrewAI / AG2 等框架的真实代码

en.tag: 100+ AI Agent & RAG apps you can actually run
en.what: A giant library of LLM app templates: 100+ hand-built, end-to-end-tested AI agents, agent skills and RAG apps, all Apache-2.0 (commercial use OK). Works with Claude, Gemini, GPT, DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen and more — clone, install deps, run. The motto: 'clone, customize, ship'.
en.content: Organized by difficulty and form: agent_skills/ (one-line npx installs), starter_ai_agents/ (single-file starters), advanced_ai_agents/ (multi-agent teams), voice_ai_agents/, always_on_agents/, RAG tutorials and more; each template ships a README and requirements, covering travel planning, financial analysis, podcast generation, home renovation…
en.stack: Mostly Python, usually a Streamlit frontend over OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic SDKs, some CrewAI/AG2 multi-agent frameworks.
en.hot: Its broad, example-led catalog lowers the cost of trying LLM applications, while agent-skill templates and tutorials keep the collection useful to practitioners.
uses: AI beginners — clone a single-file template and ship your first LLM app in a day
Startup teams — fork mature templates (travel planning, finance analysis, podcast generation) to validate ideas fast
Enterprise evaluators — compare CrewAI / AG2 and other frameworks on real code

zh.tag: 教你从零重写各种技术的教程大合集
zh.what: CodeCrafters 维护的著名教程索引仓库，理念是费曼那句「我不能创造的东西，我就不理解」。收录大量「从零重写某技术」的 step-by-step 教程链接，覆盖数据库、操作系统、Git、Docker、编程语言、神经网络、Web 浏览器等约 30 个类别。
zh.content: 主体是一个巨大的 README 列表，按「Build your own X」分类组织，每条标注所用编程语言和链接（如用 Python 写 LLM、用 C++ 写光线追踪）；无代码本体。
zh.stack: 纯 Markdown 文档；收录的教程本身横跨 C/C++/Python/Go/Rust 等各种语言。
zh.hot: 它用「亲手实现一遍」把抽象的计算机科学原理变成具体项目，学习路径清晰，因此长期具有传播力。
uses: 在校生 / 转行者 —— 按「造一遍」路线真正理解数据库、操作系统原理
资深工程师 —— 面试前用手写 Git / Docker 项目补底层功底
技术布道者 —— 按分类找写作和分享素材

en.tag: The giant collection of 'rebuild your favorite tech from scratch' tutorials
en.what: CodeCrafters' famous tutorial index, founded on Feynman's 'What I cannot create, I do not understand'. It collects step-by-step 'build your own X' tutorial links across ~30 categories: databases, operating systems, Git, Docker, programming languages, neural networks, web browsers and more.
en.content: Essentially one huge README list organized by 'Build your own X' categories, each entry tagged with its language and link (e.g. write an LLM in Python, a raytracer in C++); no code of its own.
en.stack: Pure Markdown; the tutorials themselves span C/C++/Python/Go/Rust and more.
en.hot: Its learn-by-building catalog remains useful because it turns abstract computer-science concepts into concrete implementation projects.
uses: Students & career switchers — truly understand databases and OS internals by building them
Senior engineers — shore up fundamentals before interviews by hand-rolling Git / Docker
Tech writers — find writing and talk material by category

zh.tag: 把 GitHub Copilot 智能体嵌进你自己应用的官方 SDK
zh.what: GitHub 官方出的多语言 SDK：在自己的应用或服务里直接调用 Copilot Agent 的能力。它暴露的是 Copilot CLI 背后同一套经过生产验证的 agent 运行时 —— 你不用自己搭编排层，定义好 agent 行为，规划、工具调用、文件编辑都交给 Copilot 处理。
zh.content: 单仓库 6 套 SDK，按目录分：nodejs/、python/、go/、dotnet/、java/、rust/，另有 docs/、test/ 和 cookbook 示例；各语言经 npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io 分发。
zh.stack: 多语言 monorepo（TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust 六个 SDK），MIT；2026 年 1 月创建，推送非常活跃。
zh.hot: 「Copilot agent 能力开放给第三方应用」的定位自带关注度，GitHub 官方背书。
uses: SaaS 厂商 —— 在产品里内嵌 Copilot 级 AI 助手（IDE、低代码平台等）
企业内部工具 —— 快速给内部系统加 agent 能力，不用自研编排
多语言团队 —— JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust 任选

en.tag: GitHub's official SDK for embedding the Copilot agent in your own apps
en.what: GitHub's official multi-language SDK: call the Copilot Agent's capabilities directly from your own apps and services. It exposes the same production-proven agent runtime behind the Copilot CLI — no need to build your own orchestration layer: define the agent's behavior and let Copilot handle planning, tool calls and file edits.
en.content: Six SDKs in one repo, by directory: nodejs/, python/, go/, dotnet/, java/, rust/, plus docs/, test/ and cookbook examples; distributed via npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io.
en.stack: A multi-language monorepo (TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust), MIT; created January 2026, committing very actively.
en.hot: 'Copilot agent capabilities opened to third-party apps' draws attention by itself — with GitHub's official stamp on it.
uses: SaaS vendors — embed Copilot-grade AI assistance into products (IDEs, low-code platforms)
Internal tooling — add agent capabilities to internal systems without building orchestration
Polyglot teams — pick from JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust

zh.tag: 给设计工程师准备的一套 UI 类 Agent Skills
zh.what: 知名设计工程师 ibelick 出品的 UI 技能包集合：让 AI 编码 agent 按任务自动走对应的 UI 技能流程，跑一行 npx ui-skills start 就能把 agent 路由到合适的技能集。
zh.content: skills/ 目录下 6 个技能：baseline-ui、improve-ui、fixing-accessibility、fixing-metadata、fixing-motion-performance、ui-skills-root；另有 bin/（CLI 入口）和配套网站（Astro + Cloudflare Workers）。
zh.stack: TypeScript，CLI 走 npx 分发，MIT；2026 年 1 月创建，官网 ui-skills.com。
zh.hot: 把设计判断封装成 AI Agent 可复用技能，这一思路对设计工程师直观易懂，也便于立刻试用。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 让 agent 按设计规范生成和改进 UI，告别「能跑但丑」
设计工程师 —— 把无障碍、metadata、动效性能检查自动化
独立开发者 —— 一人兼顾开发和设计时的品味兜底

en.tag: A set of UI Agent Skills for design engineers
en.what: A UI skill-pack collection from well-known design engineer ibelick: routes your AI coding agent through the right UI skill workflow per task — run npx ui-skills start and the agent picks the appropriate skill set.
en.content: Six skills under skills/: baseline-ui, improve-ui, fixing-accessibility, fixing-metadata, fixing-motion-performance and ui-skills-root; plus bin/ (the CLI entry) and the companion site (Astro on Cloudflare Workers).
en.stack: TypeScript, CLI distributed via npx, MIT; created January 2026, site at ui-skills.com.
en.hot: The idea of packaging design judgment as reusable skills for AI agents is easy for design engineers to understand and immediately test.
uses: Frontend developers — let agents generate and improve UI to design standards, no more 'works but ugly'
Design engineers — automate accessibility, metadata and motion-performance checks
Indie hackers — a taste safety net when you cover both dev and design

zh.tag: 你的「AI 团队总管」：把一堆 agent 组织起来 7×24 干活
zh.what: 定位「Chief Agent Operator」：把多个 AI agent 当工作单元统一招聘、调度和汇报。核心功能包括 Agent Builder（描述需求即可自动配置出可用 agent）、Agent Groups（多 agent 并行协作）、Pages/Schedule/Project/Workspace 协作面板，以及白盒可编辑的 Personal Memory；支持接入任意模型和模态，号称 10000+ skills 和 MCP 插件生态。
zh.content: 可自部署的 Web 应用（Vercel/Docker/Zeabur/Sealos 一键部署），仓库含完整中英文档、Changelog、插件体系和本地开发指南；默认分支 canary，今天仍在高频 push。
zh.stack: TypeScript + Next.js 系 Web 应用，Docker 自托管，插件走 MCP 协议；许可证为自定义（非标准）。
zh.hot: 多 Agent 调度与即时通信网关的组合，让这一成熟 AI 应用平台形成了明确的协作化方向。
uses: 一人公司 / 自由职业者 —— 组建 7×24 自动干活的 agent 团队处理重复工作
运营团队 —— 定时调度 agent 做日报、巡检、内容分发
进阶玩家 —— 用 Personal Memory 和 10000+ skills 定制专属助手

en.tag: Your 'Chief Agent Operator' — an AI team working 7×24
en.what: Positioned as a 'Chief Agent Operator': hire, schedule and hear reports from multiple AI agents as work units. Key features: Agent Builder (describe the need, get a configured agent), Agent Groups (parallel multi-agent collaboration), Pages/Schedule/Project/Workspace panels, and a white-box editable Personal Memory; any model and modality, with a claimed 10,000+ skills and MCP plugin ecosystem.
en.content: A self-deployable web app (one-click Vercel/Docker/Zeabur/Sealos), with full bilingual docs, a changelog, the plugin system and local dev guides; default branch canary, still pushing frequently today.
en.stack: TypeScript + Next.js, self-hosted via Docker, plugins over MCP; custom (non-standard) license.
en.hot: Its combination of multi-agent orchestration and messaging gateways gives an established AI application platform a clear collaboration-focused direction.
uses: Solo founders & freelancers — run a 7×24 agent team for repetitive work
Ops teams — schedule agents for daily reports, patrols and content distribution
Power users — craft custom assistants with Personal Memory and 10,000+ skills

zh.tag: 终端里的编程 agent，专为便宜小模型优化
zh.what: 跑在终端里的 AI 编程助手（OpenAI Codex 的 fork），核心思路「换 harness 不换模型」：内置 claude-code、kimi-cli、qwen-code、deepseek-tui 等多种 agent 运行框架，让低成本开源模型也打出好表现。自带 QA 技能，可驱动真实浏览器或原生 App 做界面测试，支持 macOS/Linux/Windows 原生沙箱执行。
zh.content: 完整 Rust 工程：终端 TUI、文档站（openinterpreter.com/docs）、安装脚本；配置与会话存本地 ~/.openinterpreter，支持 /model 切模型、/harness 切框架、MCP、hooks、AGENTS.md。
zh.stack: Rust（2023 年创建的老牌项目，刚从 Python 重写），Apache-2.0；支持 ACP 协议接入编辑器，可接多家模型 provider。
zh.hot: Rust 重写与「低成本模型运行框架」定位，正好契合开发者对更高效编程 Agent 基础设施的需求。
uses: 预算有限的开发者 —— 用 DeepSeek / Qwen 等便宜模型跑编程 agent，成本降一个量级
多工具用户 —— 一套终端切换 claude-code、kimi-cli 等不同框架
QA 团队 —— 让 agent 驱动真实浏览器做界面自动化测试

en.tag: A coding agent in your terminal, tuned for low-cost models
en.what: An AI coding assistant in your terminal (a fork of OpenAI Codex) built on the idea of 'swap the harness, not the model': it bundles multiple agent runtimes — claude-code, kimi-cli, qwen-code, deepseek-tui — so cheap open models still perform well. It ships a QA skill that drives real browsers or native apps for UI testing, with native sandboxing on macOS/Linux/Windows.
en.content: A full Rust project: the terminal TUI, a docs site (openinterpreter.com/docs) and install scripts; config and sessions live in ~/.openinterpreter, with /model to switch models, /harness to switch runtimes, plus MCP, hooks and AGENTS.md support.
en.stack: Rust (a 2023 veteran, freshly rewritten from Python), Apache-2.0; supports ACP (Agent Client Protocol) for editors and multiple model providers.
en.hot: The Rust rewrite and focus on serving as a harness for lower-cost models align with demand for efficient coding-agent infrastructure.
uses: Budget-conscious devs — run coding agents on cheap models like DeepSeek / Qwen, an order of magnitude cheaper
Multi-tool users — swap between claude-code, kimi-cli and other harnesses in one terminal
QA teams — let agents drive real browsers for UI automation testing
